example.en: Smartphones brought a revolution to people's lives.

gloss: to guide; to lead; to direct

example.zh: 老师应该引导学生独立思考。
example.en: Teachers should guide students to think independently.

example.zh: 海边的岩石被海浪冲得很光滑。
example.en: The rocks by the sea have been worn smooth by the waves.

gloss: to puzzle; to confuse; to mislead; puzzled

example.zh: 不要被商品华丽的外表迷惑了。
example.en: Don't be misled by a product's flashy appearance.

gloss: to interfere; to intervene; to meddle

example.zh: 父母不应该过多干涉孩子的选择。
example.en: Parents shouldn't interfere too much in their children's choices.

example.zh: 她在国外获得了硕士学位。
example.en: She obtained a master's degree abroad.

gloss: to dislike; to mind; to complain of; suspicion

example.zh: 他嫌这件衣服太贵，没有买。
example.en: He thought the clothes were too expensive and didn't buy them.

example.zh: 警察还不能排除他的嫌疑。
example.en: The police can't yet rule him out as a suspect.

gloss: to cross; to intersect; to overlap; alternate

example.zh: 这两条路在前面交叉。
example.en: These two roads intersect up ahead.

gloss: to be puzzled; to wonder; bewildered

example.zh: 我很纳闷儿，他为什么突然不理我了。
example.en: I'm puzzled why he has suddenly stopped talking to me.

example.zh: 两国元首在会谈中讨论了经济合作。
example.en: The two heads of state discussed economic cooperation in their talks.

gloss: the human world; the world; on earth
indonesian: dunia manusia; dunia fana; di dunia

example.zh: 这里风景优美，简直是人间天堂。
example.en: The scenery here is beautiful; it's simply a paradise on earth.

example.zh: 看到危险时，人会本能地闭上眼睛。
example.en: When people see danger they instinctively close their eyes.

example.zh: 这幅古画已经被专家修复好了。
example.en: This ancient painting has been restored by experts.

gloss: to firmly believe; to determine; to establish

example.zh: 他认定自己的选择是对的。
example.en: He was firmly convinced that his choice was right.

example.zh: 他高兴地举起拳头，大声喊“加油”。
example.en: He raised his fist happily and shouted, "Come on!"

example.zh: 航班将于晚上八点抵达北京。
example.en: The flight will arrive in Beijing at eight in the evening.

example.zh: 这家酒店的服务是一流的。
example.en: The service at this hotel is first-class.

example.zh: 一个人连梦想都没有，是很悲哀的事。
example.en: It's a sad thing for a person not to have even a dream.

example.zh: 路上有个大坑，开车要小心。
example.en: There's a big pothole in the road, so drive carefully.

gloss: to discover; to realise; to become aware

example.zh: 走到半路，我才发觉忘了带钥匙。
example.en: Only halfway there did I realise I'd forgotten my keys.

gloss: to live; to reside; to dwell

example.zh: 他在这个城市已经居住了十年。
example.en: He has lived in this city for ten years.

gloss: to appear; to present; to emerge; to show

example.zh: 春天到了，公园里呈现出一片生机。
example.en: Spring has arrived, and the park is full of life.

example.zh: 他们在海边买了一栋别墅。
example.en: They bought a villa by the sea.

gloss: to identify; to distinguish; to recognise
meanings: to distinguish; to discern; to identify; to recognize

example.zh: 这个软件可以识别图片中的文字。
example.en: This software can recognise text in images.

example.zh: 请在门外等候，医生马上叫您。
example.en: Please wait outside; the doctor will call you shortly.

gloss: mistake; slip; error; to make a mistake

example.zh: 他在比赛中的一个小失误导致了失败。
example.en: One small mistake of his in the match led to defeat.

meanings: to settle (a dispute out of court)

example.zh: 吵了一架之后，两个好朋友很快就和解了。
example.en: After a quarrel, the two good friends quickly made up.

example.zh: 这件衣服加入了很多中国传统元素。
example.en: This garment incorporates many traditional Chinese elements.

example.zh: 他贪婪地看着桌上的美食。
example.en: He looked greedily at the delicious food on the table.

gloss: to convey; to pass on; to transmit

example.zh: 请把这个消息传达给每一位同事。
example.en: Please pass this message on to every colleague.

example.zh: 遇到突发情况，他依然很镇定。
example.en: He remained calm even in an emergency.

example.zh: 这台电视的画面非常清晰。
example.en: This TV has a very clear picture.

gloss: to pinch; to hold between fingers; to knead; to mould
indonesian: mencubit; menjepit dengan jari; meremas; membentuk
meanings: to hold between the thumb and fingers
to hold (lit. in one's hand and fig.)
to fabricate (a story, a report, etc)

example.zh: 孩子们用彩色的泥捏出了各种小动物。
example.en: The children moulded all kinds of little animals out of coloured clay.

indonesian: bius; anestesi; membius; membuat mati rasa
meanings: to anesthetize; (fig.) to corrupt (sb's mind); to enervate; to numb the mind (to escape from harsh reality)

example.zh: 手术前，医生先给病人做了麻醉。
example.en: Before the operation the doctor first anaesthetised the patient.

example.zh: 生的食物里可能有很多细菌。
example.en: Raw food may contain a lot of bacteria.

gloss: vision; insight; eye; way of looking at things

example.zh: 你挑衣服的眼光真不错。
example.en: You've got a really good eye for choosing clothes.

example.zh: 他为自己当初的无知感到后悔。
example.en: He regrets his former ignorance.

example.zh: 实验室里的仪器都很贵重，请小心使用。
example.en: The instruments in the lab are all valuable, so please use them carefully.

example.zh: 她是一位杰出的女科学家。
example.en: She is an outstanding female scientist.

gloss: to enlarge; to magnify; to amplify

example.zh: 你可以把照片放大一点，看得更清楚。
example.en: You can enlarge the photo a bit to see it more clearly.

gloss: habitually in the past; usually; as usual

example.zh: 他今天比往常起得早一些。
example.en: He got up a bit earlier today than usual.

example.zh: 两个老朋友见了面，亲热地聊个不停。
example.en: When the two old friends met, they chatted warmly non-stop.

example.zh: 我们的语文老师说话很风趣。
example.en: Our Chinese teacher speaks very wittily.

gloss: to be born; to come into being; to emerge

example.zh: 这个伟大的发明诞生于一个小实验室。
example.en: This great invention was born in a small laboratory.

example.zh: 他是这家餐厅的忠实顾客。
example.en: He is a loyal customer of this restaurant.

example.zh: 请在正确答案后面画一个对号符号。
example.en: Please put a tick mark after the correct answer.

gloss: to appoint; to designate; to assign
meanings: to indicate clearly and with certainty

example.zh: 请把车停在指定的位置。
example.en: Please park in the designated spot.

gloss: so that; in order to; so as to

example.zh: 请留下电话号码，以便我们和你联系。
example.en: Please leave your phone number so that we can contact you.

gloss: to appraise; to identify; to authenticate; appraisal

example.zh: 专家鉴定后认为这幅画是真的。
example.en: After appraising it, the experts concluded the painting was genuine.

gloss: to jump; to bounce; to hop

example.zh: 听到这个好消息，孩子高兴得直蹦。
example.en: Hearing the good news, the child jumped for joy.

example.zh: 多吃含纤维的蔬菜对身体有好处。
example.en: Eating plenty of fibre-rich vegetables is good for you.

example.zh: 这家商店最近发生了一起盗窃案。
example.en: A theft recently took place at this shop.

gloss: to market; to sell; to promote

example.zh: 他在一家公司负责推销新产品。
example.en: He is responsible for marketing new products at a company.

gloss: to swear an oath; to take a vow

example.zh: 新医生们在毕业典礼上宣誓。
example.en: The new doctors took an oath at the graduation ceremony.

example.zh: 这家公司根据顾客的需求设计产品。
example.en: This company designs products according to customer needs.

example.zh: 雷达可以帮助船只在大雾中安全航行。
example.en: Radar helps ships sail safely in thick fog.

gloss: to kneel; to go down on one's knees

example.zh: 他跪在地上找掉下去的耳环。
example.en: He knelt on the floor looking for the earring that had dropped.

example.zh: 学习是一个人终身的事情。
example.en: Learning is a lifelong undertaking.

gloss: to pan-fry; to fry in shallow oil; to decoct (medicine)
indonesian: menggoreng (dengan sedikit minyak); menggoreng ceplok; merebus (jamu)

example.zh: 妈妈早上给我煎了两个鸡蛋。
example.en: Mum fried two eggs for me this morning.

gloss: to cause trouble; to make a disturbance; to mess around

example.zh: 上课的时候，请不要捣乱。
example.en: Please don't mess around during class.

gloss: to coax; to humour; to fool; uproar

example.zh: 妈妈哄了半天，孩子才不哭了。
example.en: Mum coaxed the child for ages before he stopped crying.

example.zh: 这家公司的员工福利很好。
example.en: This company's employee benefits are very good.

gloss: to expel; to drive out; to banish

example.zh: 他因为违反规定被驱逐出了俱乐部。
example.en: He was expelled from the club for breaking the rules.

gloss: to involve; to implicate; to drag in

example.zh: 这件事牵扯到很多部门，处理起来很复杂。
example.en: This matter involves many departments, so it's complicated to deal with.

example.zh: 人类一直在探索宇宙的奥秘。
example.en: Humanity has always been exploring the mysteries of the universe.

gloss: to circulate; to cycle; cycle; loop

example.zh: 多运动能促进血液循环。
example.en: Exercising more improves blood circulation.

example.zh: 她在一家公司做财务工作。
example.en: She does finance work at a company.

example.zh: 比赛进入下半场后，局势发生了变化。
example.en: After the second half began, the situation in the match changed.

gloss: to run; to operate; to be in motion; operation
meanings: to move along one's course (of celestial bodies etc)
(fig.) to function; to be in operation
(of a train service etc) to operate; to run

example.zh: 地铁新线路已经开始正式运行了。
example.en: The new metro line has officially started running.

gloss: to stop; to end; to terminate

example.zh: 由于对方违约，我们决定终止合同。
example.en: Because the other side breached the contract, we decided to terminate it.

example.zh: 几年不见，他的模样一点儿也没变。
example.en: I haven't seen him for years, but he looks exactly the same.

example.zh: 这条河从深深的峡谷中流过。
example.en: This river flows through a deep gorge.

example.zh: 你使用这个软件的频率高吗？
example.en: Do you use this app often?

gloss: to land; to come ashore; to log in
meanings: to log in (frequently used erroneous variant of 登录)

example.zh: 台风预计明天上午在南方沿海登陆。
example.en: The typhoon is expected to make landfall on the southern coast tomorrow morning.

example.zh: 这句话的含义很深，需要慢慢体会。
example.en: This sentence has a deep meaning that takes time to appreciate.

gloss: to subsidise; to provide financial aid; to fund

example.zh: 这位企业家资助了很多贫困学生上大学。
example.en: This entrepreneur has funded many poor students through university.

gloss: to excavate; to dig; to unearth; to tap (potential)

example.zh: 老师善于挖掘每个学生的潜力。
example.en: The teacher is good at tapping into each student's potential.

gloss: to delay; to put off; to procrastinate

example.zh: 这件事不能再拖延了，必须今天完成。
example.en: This can't be put off any longer; it must be finished today.

example.zh: 老人和孕妇可以优先上车。
example.en: The elderly and pregnant women may board first.

example.zh: 今年的游客比以往多了很多。
example.en: There are many more tourists this year than in the past.

gloss: to fight over; to compete for; to vie for

example.zh: 两支球队正在争夺冠军。
example.en: The two teams are competing for the championship.

gloss: to give; to entrust; to endow; to confer

example.zh: 这次任务是公司赋予我们的重要责任。
example.en: This assignment is an important responsibility the company has entrusted to us.

gloss: to avoid; to evade; to dodge; to recuse oneself

example.zh: 有问题我们要正视，不能回避。
example.en: We must face problems head-on, not avoid them.

gloss: vigilant; alert; to be on guard against

example.zh: 我们要对网络上的陌生人保持警惕。
example.en: We should stay alert to strangers online.

example.zh: 双方都做出了一些妥协，问题终于解决了。
example.en: Both sides made some compromises and the problem was finally solved.

example.zh: 这个实验需要非常精确的数据。
example.en: This experiment needs very precise data.

example.zh: 他从钱包里掏出几张钞票递给了店员。
example.en: He took a few banknotes out of his wallet and handed them to the shop assistant.

gloss: to deduce; deduction; to interpret; to perform

example.zh: 这位演员成功地演绎了一个复杂的角色。
example.en: This actor successfully portrayed a complex character.

gloss: to depend on; to rely on; dependence

example.zh: 孩子长大了，不能总是依赖父母。
example.en: Once children grow up they can't always rely on their parents.

gloss: to become addicted; to get hooked

example.zh: 这个游戏很容易让人上瘾。
example.en: This game is very easy to get hooked on.

example.zh: 离开房间前，请关掉所有电源。
example.en: Please switch off all power before leaving the room.

example.zh: 你最近气色不错，是不是经常锻炼？
example.en: You've been looking well lately; are you exercising a lot?

example.zh: 我不明白他这样做的意图是什么。
example.en: I don't understand what his intention is in doing this.

example.zh: 她坚定地相信自己一定能成功。
example.en: She firmly believes she will definitely succeed.

example.zh: 好的老师会耐心倾听学生的想法。
example.en: A good teacher listens patiently to students' ideas.

gloss: to play with; to toy with; to manipulate

example.zh: 他总是玩弄别人的感情，没有人再相信他。
example.en: He's always toying with people's feelings, so no one trusts him any more.

example.zh: 新郎和新娘一起向客人敬酒。
example.en: The groom and bride toasted the guests together.

example.zh: 小时候，奶奶每天晚上给我讲童话故事。
example.en: When I was little, Grandma told me a fairy tale every night.

gloss: to instruct; to tell; to order; instructions

example.zh: 妈妈出门前吩咐我按时吃饭。
example.en: Before going out, Mum told me to eat on time.

example.zh: 帮助别人是一种高尚的行为。
example.en: Helping others is a noble act.

example.zh: 我们不应该对别人有偏见。
example.en: We shouldn't be prejudiced against other people.

gloss: to keep; to take care of; certainly; custodian

example.zh: 出门前，我把钥匙交给邻居保管。
example.en: Before leaving, I gave the keys to my neighbour for safekeeping.

gloss: to dismiss; to disband; to dissolve

example.zh: 会议结束后，大家就解散了。
example.en: When the meeting ended, everyone dispersed.

example.zh: 这位明星一出现，就成了大家关注的焦点。
example.en: As soon as the star appeared, she became the focus of everyone's attention.

example.zh: 他偷了别人的作品还说是自己的，真无耻。
example.en: He stole someone else's work and claimed it as his own; how shameless.

example.zh: 公司制定了未来五年的发展战略。
example.en: The company has drawn up a development strategy for the next five years.

gloss: still; as before; to remain the same

example.zh: 虽然下着大雨，他仍旧去上班了。
example.en: Even though it was pouring with rain, he still went to work.

example.zh: 现在首要的任务是找到问题的原因。
example.en: The main task now is to find the cause of the problem.

example.zh: 医生正在给病人量脉搏。
example.en: The doctor is taking the patient's pulse.

gloss: to seal; to close; to close off; closed

example.zh: 这条路正在维修，暂时封闭。
example.en: This road is under repair and temporarily closed.

example.zh: 海关在机场查获了一批走私手表。
example.en: Customs seized a batch of smuggled watches at the airport.

example.zh: 只要肯努力，总会找到出路的。
example.en: As long as you're willing to work hard, you'll always find a way out.

gloss: to take out (from a pocket); to fish out; to dig

example.zh: 他从口袋里掏出手机看了一眼。
example.en: He took his phone out of his pocket and glanced at it.

example.zh: 这条高速公路是连接两个城市的交通动脉。
example.en: This expressway is the main traffic artery connecting the two cities.

gloss: to witness; to see with one's own eyes
meanings: to see with one's own eyes

example.zh: 他亲眼目睹了这座城市几十年来的变化。
example.en: He has witnessed with his own eyes the changes in this city over decades.

example.zh: 病人的情况突然恶化，医生立即进行抢救。
example.en: The patient's condition suddenly worsened, and the doctors acted immediately.

gloss: to hinder; to obstruct; to impede; obstacle

example.zh: 缺乏自信会阻碍你的进步。
example.en: A lack of confidence will hinder your progress.

gloss: to supervise; to monitor; to oversee; supervisor

example.zh: 父母应该监督孩子按时完成作业。
example.en: Parents should make sure their children finish their homework on time.

example.zh: 你都三十岁了，不要再说这么幼稚的话。
example.en: You're thirty already; stop saying such childish things.

example.zh: 宪法是一个国家的根本大法。
example.en: The constitution is a country's fundamental law.

meanings: outer surface; the outside of sth

example.zh: 他很爱面子，不愿意承认自己错了。
example.en: He's very concerned about face and won't admit he was wrong.

gloss: to encourage; to motivate; to inspire; incentive

example.zh: 老师的话激励着我不断努力。
example.en: The teacher's words keep motivating me to work hard.

example.zh: 我们不应该歧视任何人。
example.en: We shouldn't discriminate against anyone.

example.zh: 跑完马拉松，他觉得自己已经到了极限。
example.en: After finishing the marathon, he felt he had reached his limit.

example.zh: 他的父亲对他要求非常严厉。
example.en: His father is very strict with him.

example.zh: 这种花只在特定的季节开放。
example.en: This flower only blooms in a particular season.

example.zh: 这座城市有一个很大的港口，每天都有很多船进出。
example.en: This city has a large port with many ships coming and going every day.

gloss: to expose; to make public; exposure (photography)

example.zh: 这家餐厅的卫生问题被记者曝光了。
example.en: The restaurant's hygiene problems were exposed by a journalist.

gloss: to pounce on; to throw oneself on; to rush at; to flap

example.zh: 孩子一见到妈妈，就扑到了她的怀里。
example.en: As soon as the child saw his mum, he threw himself into her arms.

example.zh: 他在文章中引用了一位作家的话。
example.en: He quoted a writer in his article.

example.zh: 孩子的心灵是最纯洁的。
example.en: A child's heart is the purest of all.

example.zh: 爷爷收藏了很多古董瓷器。
example.en: Grandpa collects a lot of antique porcelain.

example.zh: 天气太冷，我的手冻得失去了知觉。
example.en: It was so cold that my hands went numb.

gloss: to repress; to hold back; to inhibit; oppressive

example.zh: 她压抑着内心的激动，平静地说完了话。
example.en: She held back her excitement and finished speaking calmly.

gloss: to roam; to wander; to drift; homeless

example.zh: 这只流浪狗被一个好心人收养了。
example.en: This stray dog was adopted by a kind-hearted person.

example.zh: 科学家认为人类是从古猿进化来的。
example.en: Scientists believe humans evolved from ancient apes.

gloss: to issue; to publish; to release; to distribute

example.zh: 这位歌手下个月将发行新专辑。
example.en: This singer will release a new album next month.

example.zh: 对他来说，出国留学的梦想已经不再遥远。
example.en: For him, the dream of studying abroad is no longer far away.

gloss: to retrieve; to redeem; to save (a situation)

example.zh: 他想尽办法挽回公司的损失。
example.en: He tried every way to recover the company's losses.

example.zh: 阅读是获取知识的重要途径。
example.en: Reading is an important way to acquire knowledge.

gloss: to set about; to start; to commence
meanings: to put one's hand to it
to start out on a task

example.zh: 我们下周就着手准备这次活动。
example.en: We'll set about preparing for this event next week.

example.zh: 他总喜欢在朋友面前炫耀自己的新手机。
example.en: He always likes to show off his new phone in front of friends.

gloss: to nag; to chatter; to go on and on; talkative

example.zh: 妈妈总是唠叨我要多穿衣服。
example.en: Mum is always nagging me to wear more clothes.

example.zh: 她的目光落在了那幅画上。
example.en: Her gaze fell on that painting.

gloss: to sway; to swing; to waver

example.zh: 小树在风中不停地摇摆。
example.en: The young tree kept swaying in the wind.

example.zh: 遇到紧急情况，一定要保持镇静。
example.en: In an emergency you must stay calm.

gloss: to handle; to deal with; to dispose of; to punish

example.zh: 这批过期的食品已经按规定处置了。
example.en: This batch of expired food has been disposed of according to the rules.

example.zh: 他被大学授予名誉博士学位。
example.en: He was awarded an honorary doctorate by the university.

gloss: to ensure; to guarantee; to safeguard; guarantee

example.zh: 这项政策保障了老人的基本生活。
example.en: This policy guarantees the elderly a basic standard of living.

gloss: to dissect; to analyse; anatomy; dissection

example.zh: 医学院的学生要学习人体解剖。
example.en: Medical students must study human anatomy.

example.zh: 天气太热，水果很容易腐烂。
example.en: In very hot weather fruit rots easily.

gloss: statistics; to count; to add up

example.zh: 请把参加活动的人数统计一下。
example.en: Please count the number of people taking part in the event.

example.zh: 青少年时期会发生很多生理变化。
example.en: Many physiological changes take place during adolescence.

gloss: to bind; to tie; to restrain; measure word for bunches or bundles
indonesian: mengikat; membatasi; kata satuan untuk ikat atau berkas
meanings: classifier for bunches, bundles, beams of light etc

example.zh: 毕业那天，我收到了一束鲜花。
example.en: On graduation day I received a bunch of flowers.

example.zh: 请把剩下的汤倒进这个容器里。
example.en: Please pour the leftover soup into this container.

example.zh: 这个案子属于刑事案件。
example.en: This case is a criminal case.

gloss: to melt; to thaw; to dissolve

example.zh: 太阳出来后，屋顶上的雪慢慢融化了。
example.en: After the sun came out, the snow on the roof slowly melted.

example.zh: 请在空白处写上你的名字。
example.en: Please write your name in the blank space.

gloss: to fish out; to scoop up; to dredge up; to gain (improperly)

example.zh: 他用网把掉进池塘的球捞了上来。
example.en: He fished the ball that had fallen into the pond out with a net.

example.zh: 以前这里的人靠打猎和种地生活。
example.en: In the past people here lived by hunting and farming.

gloss: to step across; to stride; to straddle; to cross (a boundary)

example.zh: 他一步就跨过了那条小沟。
example.en: He stepped over the little ditch in one stride.

example.zh: 在国外留学的时候，她非常想念祖国。
example.en: While studying abroad she missed her homeland very much.

gloss: to dedicate; to devote; to offer; contribution

example.zh: 她把一生都奉献给了教育事业。
example.en: She devoted her whole life to education.

example.zh: 图书馆是学习的好场所，环境很安静。
example.en: The library is a good place to study; it is very quiet.

gloss: extremely; terribly; to drive someone crazy; to cause death
indonesian: setengah mati; luar biasa; menyebalkan; membahayakan nyawa
meanings: (used in complaining about sth) to be a nuisance

example.zh: 今天热得要命，我一点儿也不想出门。
example.en: It's terribly hot today; I don't want to go out at all.

example.zh: 这是我为你精心准备的生日礼物。
example.en: This is a birthday present I carefully prepared for you.

example.zh: 她每周都会换一次床单。
example.en: She changes the bed sheets once a week.

example.zh: 他太固执了，谁的建议都不听。
example.en: He's too stubborn; he won't listen to anyone's advice.

example.zh: 电影里的那个老板看起来很冷酷。
example.en: The boss in the film seems very cold-hearted.

example.zh: 父母是孩子最好的榜样。
example.en: Parents are their children's best role models.

example.zh: 他们一家人生活得很和谐。
example.en: Their family lives together very harmoniously.

meanings: to force sb to do sth

example.zh: 如果你不愿意去，我也不勉强你。
example.en: If you don't want to go, I won't force you.

example.zh: 老师耐心地纠正了我的发音。
example.en: The teacher patiently corrected my pronunciation.

gloss: clause; article; provision (of a contract or law)

example.zh: 签合同前，一定要仔细阅读每一个条款。
example.en: Before signing a contract, be sure to read every clause carefully.

gloss: to look after; to keep an eye on; to notify

example.zh: 我刚来公司，请大家多多关照。
example.en: I'm new to the company; I hope you'll all look after me.

gloss: to damage; to break; to harm

example.zh: 快递公司不小心损坏了我的包裹。
example.en: The courier company accidentally damaged my parcel.

example.zh: 这盒月饼的包装非常精美。
example.en: The packaging of this box of mooncakes is very exquisite.

gloss: to interrupt; to break off; to suspend

example.zh: 因为下大雨，比赛中断了半个小时。
example.en: Because of the heavy rain, the match was suspended for half an hour.

example.zh: 消防员英勇地冲进大楼救出了孩子。
example.en: The firefighter bravely rushed into the building and rescued the child.

gloss: grain; granule; measure word for small round things
indonesian: butir; biji; kata satuan untuk benda kecil bulat

example.zh: 这种药每天饭后吃一粒就可以了。
example.en: Just take one pill of this medicine after meals every day.

gloss: measure word for actions or deeds; time; kind; foreign
indonesian: kali; macam; kata satuan untuk tindakan; asing
meanings: classifier for occurrences (of an event, action or speech utterance)
classifier for iterations: times, -fold (as in twofold etc)

example.zh: 经过一番努力，他终于通过了考试。
example.en: After some hard work, he finally passed the exam.

example.zh: 乘飞机时，随身行李里不能带太多液体。
example.en: When flying, you can't take too much liquid in your carry-on luggage.

gloss: to guarantee; to vouch for; guarantee

example.zh: 我可以担保，他是一个诚实的人。
example.en: I can vouch that he's an honest person.

gloss: to repay; to requite; to reciprocate

example.zh: 我一定要好好学习，报答父母的养育之恩。
example.en: I must study hard to repay my parents for raising me.

gloss: to approve; to accept; to recognise; approval

example.zh: 他的能力得到了大家的认可。
example.en: His ability has been recognised by everyone.

example.zh: 这家公司在本地市场上势力很大。
example.en: This company has great influence in the local market.

example.zh: 这家公司的资产已经超过十亿元。
example.en: This company's assets now exceed one billion yuan.

gloss: to occupy; to capture; to take over
meanings: to capture; to seize; to occupy by force

example.zh: 这款手机很快就占领了年轻人的市场。
example.en: This phone quickly captured the youth market.

example.zh: 爬了一天的山，大家又累又饥饿。
example.en: After climbing all day, everyone was tired and hungry.

gloss: to destroy (by burning or melting); to dispose of

example.zh: 这些过期的文件需要全部销毁。
example.en: All these outdated documents need to be destroyed.

gloss: to gaze at; to watch attentively; to look closely at
meanings: to look attentively at; to closely watch; to gaze at

example.zh: 她静静地注视着窗外的雨。
example.en: She quietly gazed at the rain outside the window.

example.zh: 政府增加了对教育的财政投入。
example.en: The government has increased its financial investment in education.

example.zh: 这件事要先向上级报告。
example.en: This matter must first be reported to the higher-ups.

example.zh: 这批产品存在质量缺陷，需要召回。
example.en: This batch of products has quality defects and needs to be recalled.

gloss: to knock; to bump; to tap
meanings: to knock (mud from boots, ashes from a pipe etc)

example.zh: 他不小心把头磕在了门上。
example.en: He accidentally bumped his head on the door.

gloss: to hold back; to hold in; to suppress; to feel stifled

example.zh: 他憋了半天，终于说出了心里话。
example.en: After holding it in for ages, he finally said what was on his mind.

example.zh: 这两种产品的价格差别不大。
example.en: There's not much difference in price between these two products.

gloss: to stop; to curb; to put a stop to

example.zh: 看到有人在公园乱扔垃圾，他马上上前制止。
example.en: Seeing someone littering in the park, he immediately went over to stop them.

example.zh: 多年过去了，这里的风景依旧美丽。
example.en: Many years have passed, but the scenery here is as beautiful as ever.

meanings: part (esp. of the body, but also of a vegetable (e.g. the root), or a garment (e.g. the sleeve) etc)

example.zh: 请告诉医生你身体哪个部位疼。
example.en: Please tell the doctor which part of your body hurts.

example.zh: 在网上发表言论也要负责任。
example.en: You must also be responsible for the remarks you post online.

example.zh: 他不听劝告，被雨淋湿了，真是活该。
example.en: He ignored the advice and got soaked in the rain; it serves him right.

example.zh: 这个词用在这里不太恰当。
example.en: This word isn't quite appropriate here.

gloss: fat (in the body or food); grease
meanings: fat (in the body, in a plant, or in food)

example.zh: 这种食物脂肪含量太高，不宜多吃。
example.en: This food is too high in fat to eat much of.

example.zh: 现在很少有人用磁带听音乐了。
example.en: Very few people listen to music on cassette tapes now.

gloss: to collapse; to cave in; to sag

example.zh: 雨下得太大，路边的一堵旧墙塌了。
example.en: It rained so hard that an old wall by the road collapsed.

example.zh: 他把那段痛苦的回忆埋葬在心底。
example.en: He buried that painful memory deep in his heart.

gloss: to occupy; to hold; to take up

example.zh: 手机占据了我们太多的时间。
example.en: Phones take up too much of our time.

example.zh: 她穿着一条华丽的长裙参加了晚会。
example.en: She wore a gorgeous long dress to the party.

example.zh: 公司会在三天之内给你答复。
example.en: The company will give you an answer within three days.

example.zh: 他的手上有一道小时候留下的疤。
example.en: He has a scar on his hand from when he was a child.

example.zh: 一棵大树横在路中间，车过不去。
example.en: A big tree was lying across the road, so cars couldn't get through.

example.zh: 无论在什么岗位，他都认真负责。
example.en: Whatever position he's in, he's conscientious and responsible.

example.zh: 健康是做好一切工作的前提。
example.en: Health is the precondition for doing any job well.

example.zh: 大伙儿一起努力，一定能按时完成。
example.en: If everybody works together, we'll definitely finish on time.

example.zh: 太阳的光芒照在湖面上，非常美丽。
example.en: The sun's rays shining on the lake are very beautiful.

example.zh: 小女孩最喜欢粉色的裙子。
example.en: The little girl likes pink dresses best.

gloss: to expose; to unmask; to reveal

example.zh: 这篇报道揭露了一些商家欺骗顾客的行为。
example.en: This report exposed how some businesses cheat their customers.

example.zh: 近来天气变化很大，要注意身体。
example.en: The weather has been changeable lately, so take care of yourself.

gloss: example; analogy; for example; to compare

example.zh: 老师打了一个比方，大家马上就明白了。
example.en: The teacher used an analogy and everyone understood immediately.

gloss: to yield; to give in; to submit

example.zh: 面对困难，他从来没有屈服过。
example.en: He has never given in when facing difficulties.

example.zh: 新买的手机屏幕上贴着一层保护膜。
example.en: There's a protective film on the screen of the newly bought phone.

example.zh: 接到陌生电话要小心，谨防诈骗。
example.en: Be careful with calls from strangers and watch out for fraud.

gloss: right and wrong; truth and falsehood; gossip

example.zh: 孩子要从小学会分辨是非。
example.en: Children should learn from a young age to tell right from wrong.

example.zh: 他穿着一双崭新的运动鞋去上学。
example.en: He went to school in a brand-new pair of trainers.

example.zh: 此方法简单易行，效果亦不错。
example.en: This method is simple and easy, and the results are also good.

example.zh: 这款手表的价格十分昂贵。
example.en: This watch is extremely expensive.

example.zh: 他每周都会买一张彩票，希望能中大奖。
example.en: He buys a lottery ticket every week, hoping to win the jackpot.

gloss: to fulfil; to perform; to carry out (a duty or promise)

example.zh: 签了合同，双方就要履行各自的义务。
example.en: Once the contract is signed, both parties must fulfil their obligations.

example.zh: 他背着沉重的行李走了很久。
example.en: He walked for a long time carrying heavy luggage.

example.zh: 医院只允许病人家属进入病房。
example.en: The hospital only allows patients' family members into the ward.

gloss: to recycle; to reclaim; to recover
indonesian: mendaur ulang; mengumpulkan kembali; menarik kembali

example.zh: 这些塑料瓶可以回收再利用。
example.en: These plastic bottles can be recycled and reused.

gloss: laboratory test; to test (in a lab)

example.zh: 医生让我先去化验一下血。
example.en: The doctor asked me to get a blood test first.

example.zh: 一群蚂蚁正在搬运地上的面包屑。
example.en: A group of ants is carrying away the breadcrumbs on the ground.

gloss: exercise; drill; to practise; to rehearse

example.zh: 学校每学期都会组织一次消防演习。
example.en: The school holds a fire drill every semester.

gloss: to bind; to restrict; to tie down; restriction

example.zh: 不要让传统的观念束缚你的思想。
example.en: Don't let traditional ideas tie down your thinking.

example.zh: 坐了一整天，我的脖子变得很僵硬。
example.en: After sitting all day, my neck became very stiff.

example.zh: 她最近看起来有些忧郁，好像有心事。
example.en: She seems a bit melancholy lately, as if something's on her mind.

example.zh: 他在平凡的岗位上做出了不平凡的成绩。
example.en: He achieved extraordinary results in an ordinary job.

gloss: to go all out; to do one's utmost
indonesian: berusaha sekuat tenaga; mengerahkan segenap kemampuan

example.zh: 这次比赛很重要，我们一定要全力以赴。
example.en: This competition is very important; we must go all out.

example.zh: 我们在黎明时分出发去爬山。
example.en: We set out at dawn to climb the mountain.

example.zh: 这种顽固的污渍很难洗掉。
example.en: This kind of stubborn stain is very hard to wash out.

gloss: to sell; to peddle; to traffic

example.zh: 街上有人在贩卖新鲜的水果。
example.en: Someone on the street is selling fresh fruit.

gloss: paralysis; to be paralysed; to break down (of systems)

example.zh: 大雪导致城市交通几乎瘫痪。
example.en: The heavy snow almost paralysed the city's traffic.

gloss: to splash; to spill; to throw (liquid); shrewish

example.zh: 他不小心把咖啡泼在了衬衫上。
example.en: He accidentally spilled coffee on his shirt.

gloss: metaphor; analogy; figure of speech; to compare

example.zh: 人们常把老师比喻成园丁。
example.en: People often compare teachers to gardeners.

gloss: so as not to; so as to avoid; lest
meanings: so as not to; so as to avoid

example.zh: 多穿件衣服吧，免得感冒。
example.en: Put on another layer so you don't catch a cold.

example.zh: 他在商场门口发传单。
example.en: He hands out flyers at the entrance of the shopping mall.

example.zh: 故宫曾经是中国皇帝住的地方。
example.en: The Forbidden City was once where China's emperors lived.

example.zh: 这件衣服的颜色搭配得很协调。
example.en: The colours of this outfit go together very harmoniously.

example.zh: 收到你的礼物，我感到万分高兴。
example.en: I was extremely happy to receive your gift.

example.zh: 小狗一直跟随在主人身后。
example.en: The puppy kept following behind its owner.

example.zh: 今年冬天下了一场罕见的大雪。
example.en: There was a rare heavy snowfall this winter.

example.zh: 不知什么缘故，他今天没来上班。
example.en: For some reason, he didn't come to work today.

gloss: at first; originally; in the beginning

example.zh: 起初我不太习惯这里的生活，后来慢慢适应了。
example.en: At first I wasn't used to life here, but later I gradually adapted.

meanings: Anning District of Lanzhou City 兰州市, Gansu
Anning City, to the west of Kunming 明, Yunnan

example.zh: 搬到乡下后，他过上了安宁的生活。
example.en: After moving to the countryside, he led a peaceful life.

gloss: to honour (a commitment); to fulfil; to cash (a cheque)

example.zh: 他终于兑现了带孩子去旅游的承诺。
example.en: He finally kept his promise to take the children on a trip.

gloss: to feel awkward; to make things difficult for; embarrassed
meanings: to find things difficult (to do or manage)

example.zh: 这件事让我很为难，不知道该怎么办。
example.en: This puts me in an awkward position; I don't know what to do.

example.zh: 天气热，食物容易腐败变质。
example.en: In hot weather food spoils easily.

example.zh: 这张纸的厚度大约是零点一毫米。
example.en: This sheet of paper is about 0.1 millimetres thick.

gloss: to someone's face; in someone's presence; face to face
indonesian: di hadapan; secara langsung; berhadapan muka

example.zh: 有意见可以当面提，不要在背后说。
example.en: If you have objections, raise them face to face; don't talk behind people's backs.

gloss: on the spot; there and then

example.zh: 他当场就答应了我的请求。
example.en: He agreed to my request on the spot.

gloss: a moment; an instant; a short while

example.zh: 请稍等片刻，经理马上就来。
example.en: Please wait a moment; the manager will be right here.

example.zh: 门刚刷过油漆，请不要碰。
example.en: The door has just been painted, so please don't touch it.

example.zh: 在森林里迷路时，可以用太阳来判断方位。
example.en: If you get lost in a forest, you can use the sun to work out directions.

example.zh: 老同学见面，聊起了很多往事。
example.en: When the old classmates met, they talked about many things from the past.

gloss: to distinguish; to tell apart; to differentiate

example.zh: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，我分辨不出来。
example.en: These twins look so alike that I can't tell them apart.

gloss: rare; hard to come by; seldom
indonesian: langka; jarang ada; sulit didapat; jarang-jarang

example.zh: 这是一次难得的机会，你一定要抓住。
example.en: This is a rare opportunity; you must seize it.

example.zh: 汽车开过，溅了我一身泥水。
example.en: A car drove past and splashed muddy water all over me.

gloss: old grievances; feud; gratitude and resentment
indonesian: dendam lama; perselisihan; budi dan dendam

example.zh: 两家人之间的恩怨已经持续了很多年。
example.en: The feud between the two families has gone on for many years.

example.zh: 这次项目能成功，大家都有功劳。
example.en: Everyone deserves credit for the success of this project.

example.zh: 她在学校的行政部门工作。
example.en: She works in the school's administrative department.

gloss: to find a place for; to settle; to arrange for

example.zh: 新来的员工都被安置在公司宿舍里。
example.en: The new staff have all been housed in the company dormitory.

example.zh: 法院最后支持了原告的要求。
example.en: The court finally upheld the plaintiff's claim.

gloss: to trust; to have faith in; trust

example.zh: 他是一个值得信赖的朋友。
example.en: He's a friend worth trusting.

gloss: to fall; to tumble; to drop (of prices)

example.zh: 最近蔬菜的价格跌了不少。
example.en: Vegetable prices have fallen quite a lot recently.

example.zh: 这场比赛对我们来说是一场关键战役。
example.en: For us this match is a crucial battle.

gloss: to beat up; to hit; assault

example.zh: 他因为在酒吧殴打他人被警察带走了。
example.en: He was taken away by police for beating someone up in a bar.

example.zh: 他是这个领域的权威专家。
example.en: He is a leading authority in this field.

gloss: to repay; to pay back; to reimburse

example.zh: 他用了五年时间才偿还了所有贷款。
example.en: It took him five years to repay all his loans.

gloss: style of work; way of doing things; conduct

example.zh: 他工作作风严谨，大家都很信任他。
example.en: He works meticulously, so everyone trusts him.

example.zh: 由于工人罢工，工厂停产了两天。
example.en: Because the workers went on strike, the factory stopped production for two days.

example.zh: 智商高的人不一定就能成功。
example.en: People with a high IQ will not necessarily succeed.

example.zh: 他迈着轻快的步子走进了教室。
example.en: He strode briskly into the classroom.

gloss: pocket; bag; to wrap up; to move around
meanings: to wrap up or hold in a bag

example.zh: 他把手机放进了裤兜里。
example.en: He put his phone in his trouser pocket.

gloss: to force; to compel; to enforce; compulsory
meanings: to force; to compel; to coerce

example.zh: 开车时必须强制系好安全带。
example.en: Wearing a seat belt while driving is compulsory.

example.zh: 她毕业于一所师范大学，现在是一名中学老师。
example.en: She graduated from a teachers' university and is now a secondary school teacher.

example.zh: 这里交通便利，买东西也很方便。
example.en: Transport here is convenient, and shopping is easy too.

example.zh: 她对中国烹饪非常感兴趣。
example.en: She is very interested in Chinese cooking.

example.zh: 经常锻炼可以提高身体的免疫力。
example.en: Regular exercise can boost the body's immunity.

gloss: to clarify; to clear up; clear
meanings: to become clear (by precipitation of impurities)

example.zh: 他发表声明，澄清了网上的谣言。
example.en: He issued a statement to clear up the rumours online.

gloss: to spread; to diffuse; to proliferate
meanings: to spread; to proliferate; to diffuse

example.zh: 这个消息很快在网上扩散开来。
example.en: The news quickly spread online.

example.zh: 这次活动的效果超出了我们的预期。
example.en: The results of this event exceeded our expectations.

example.zh: 这次事故是由司机的过失造成的。
example.en: This accident was caused by the driver's negligence.

gloss: to do one's utmost; to spare no effort
indonesian: berusaha sekuat tenaga; mengerahkan segala kemampuan
meanings: to spare no effort (idiom); to do one's utmost

example.zh: 医生们竭尽全力抢救病人。
example.en: The doctors did their utmost to save the patient.

gloss: basis; foundation; according to; to go by

example.zh: 你这么说有什么依据吗？
example.en: What is your basis for saying that?

gloss: to twist; to wring; to screw; to pinch

example.zh: 她把湿毛巾拧干后挂了起来。
example.en: She wrung out the wet towel and hung it up.

example.zh: 这块布上的图案非常漂亮。
example.en: The pattern on this cloth is very pretty.

meanings: to draw up a plan; to map out a program

example.zh: 大学生应该早一点做好职业规划。
example.en: University students should do their career planning early.

gloss: good at; expert in; strong point

example.zh: 红烧鱼是我妈妈的拿手菜。
example.en: Braised fish is my mum's speciality.

example.zh: 这块木板上有几个小孔。
example.en: This wooden board has a few small holes in it.

example.zh: 我们要保护环境，为后代留下美丽的地球。
example.en: We must protect the environment and leave a beautiful planet for future generations.

example.zh: 小朋友们都喜欢看卡通片。
example.en: Children all love watching cartoons.

gloss: to sail; to navigate; to fly

example.zh: 这艘船已经在海上航行了三天。
example.en: This ship has been sailing at sea for three days.

gloss: to support; to prop up; to sustain; support

example.zh: 这座老房子靠几根木头支撑着。
example.en: This old house is held up by a few wooden beams.

example.zh: 他对音乐的执着让人感动。
example.en: His dedication to music is touching.

gloss: to drench; to pour; to get wet (in the rain)

example.zh: 我忘了带伞，被雨淋湿了。
example.en: I forgot my umbrella and got soaked by the rain.

example.zh: 在国外遇到同胞，感觉特别亲切。
example.en: Meeting fellow countrymen abroad feels especially warm.

gloss: to accompany; to go along with; to follow

example.zh: 美妙的音乐伴随着我们度过了这个夜晚。
example.en: Beautiful music accompanied us through the evening.

example.zh: 这片沼泽是很多鸟类的家。
example.en: This marsh is home to many kinds of birds.

example.zh: 这些传统是我们的祖先留下来的。
example.en: These traditions were handed down by our ancestors.

example.zh: 她戴着一条珍珠项链，非常优雅。
example.en: She's wearing a pearl necklace and looks very elegant.

meanings: case (of fraud, hepatitis, international cooperation etc); instance; example

example.zh: 老师用一个真实的案例来说明这个问题。
example.en: The teacher used a real case to illustrate this issue.

gloss: to toss and turn; to do over and over; to cause trouble; to torment
meanings: to toss from side to side (e.g. sleeplessly)
to repeat sth over and over again

example.zh: 他折腾了一晚上都没睡着。
example.en: He tossed and turned all night without falling asleep.

example.zh: 他一次次迟到，让老板很恼火。
example.en: His repeated lateness really annoyed the boss.

example.zh: 开车去陌生的地方，最好打开手机导航。
example.en: When driving somewhere unfamiliar, it's best to turn on navigation on your phone.

example.zh: 他想找一份体面的工作。
example.en: He wants to find a respectable job.

gloss: to visit; to call on; to look around

example.zh: 周末我要去医院探望生病的朋友。
example.en: This weekend I'm going to the hospital to visit a sick friend.

example.zh: 这种新药还在进行临床试验。
example.en: This new drug is still undergoing clinical trials.

example.zh: 他年纪大了，反应有点儿迟钝。
example.en: He's getting old, and his reactions are a bit slow.

example.zh: 这个小村庄很少和外界联系。
example.en: This small village has little contact with the outside world.

example.zh: 他的建议颇有道理，我们可以试一试。
example.en: His suggestion makes quite a lot of sense; we could give it a try.

example.zh: 诚实是做人的基本准则。
example.en: Honesty is a basic principle of how to conduct oneself.

example.zh: 如果不及时处理，事态可能会变得更严重。
example.en: If it isn't dealt with promptly, the situation may get more serious.

example.zh: 山顶被厚厚的白雪覆盖着。
example.en: The mountaintop is covered with thick white snow.

example.zh: 我们已经有了一个初步的计划。
example.en: We already have a preliminary plan.

gloss: to demonstrate; to set an example; demonstration
meanings: to show how to do sth

example.zh: 老师先示范了一遍，然后让学生自己练习。
example.en: The teacher demonstrated once first, then let the students practise on their own.

example.zh: 这里比先前干净多了。
example.en: It's much cleaner here than it was before.

example.zh: 这条河是两个省的边界。
example.en: This river is the boundary between the two provinces.

example.zh: 她对吃的东西特别挑剔。
example.en: She's especially picky about food.

gloss: to fly; to soar; to hover

example.zh: 一群海鸟在海面上自由地飞翔。
example.en: A flock of seabirds is flying freely over the sea.

gloss: to issue a wanted notice for; to order the arrest of

example.zh: 那个被通缉的逃犯昨天终于落网了。
example.en: The wanted fugitive was finally caught yesterday.

example.zh: 他借钱不还，还耍无赖。
example.en: He borrows money without paying it back, and acts shamelessly about it.

gloss: so as not to; in order to avoid; lest

example.zh: 出门前检查一下门窗，以免发生意外。
example.en: Check the doors and windows before going out to avoid accidents.

example.zh: 把这些没用的东西统统扔掉吧。
example.en: Throw out all of this useless stuff.

gloss: to match; to pair up; to combine; collocation
meanings: to add sth into a group

example.zh: 这件衬衫和你的裤子搭配得很好。
example.en: This shirt goes very well with your trousers.

gloss: to disturb; to disrupt; to harass

example.zh: 手机铃声扰乱了课堂秩序。
example.en: The ringing phone disrupted order in the classroom.

example.zh: 医生说他应该注意饮食，少吃油腻的东西。
example.en: The doctor said he should watch his diet and eat less greasy food.

example.zh: 计算机是现在很热门的专业。
example.en: Computer science is a very popular major these days.

gloss: to examine; to review; to censor; inspection

example.zh: 你的申请材料正在审查中。
example.en: Your application materials are under review.

gloss: to condemn; to denounce; to criticise

example.zh: 这种浪费食物的行为受到了大家的谴责。
example.en: This wasteful behaviour with food drew everyone's condemnation.

example.zh: 我不喜欢他，因为他很虚伪。
example.en: I don't like him because he's very hypocritical.

example.zh: 工人们正在测量房间的面积。
example.en: The workers are measuring the area of the room.

gloss: to overthrow; to overturn; to topple; to repudiate

example.zh: 新的实验结果推翻了以前的结论。
example.en: The new experimental results overturned the previous conclusion.

example.zh: 这次台风的威力非常大。
example.en: This typhoon was extremely powerful.

gloss: to salute; salute; with best regards

example.zh: 学生们向老师敬礼，表示感谢。
example.en: The students saluted their teacher to express their thanks.

gloss: to brag; to boast; to talk big

example.zh: 他总是吹牛说自己什么都会。
example.en: He always brags that he can do everything.

gloss: to identify; to recognise; to make out

example.zh: 这张照片太旧了，很难辨认上面的人。
example.en: This photo is so old that it's hard to make out the people in it.

example.zh: 我特意为你做了这道菜。
example.en: I made this dish especially for you.

gloss: to arouse; to stimulate; to inspire

example.zh: 好的老师能激发学生的学习兴趣。
example.en: A good teacher can arouse students' interest in learning.

gloss: all day long; all the time

example.zh: 他成天玩电脑，作业都不写。
example.en: He plays on the computer all day long and doesn't do his homework.

example.zh: 我们应该以积极的姿态面对挑战。
example.en: We should face challenges with a positive attitude.

example.zh: 这次考试考得好，妈妈奖赏了我一个新书包。
example.en: I did well in the exam, so Mum rewarded me with a new school bag.

gloss: to get rich; to make a fortune

example.zh: 春节时，人们常说“恭喜发财”。
example.en: At Spring Festival, people often say "Wishing you prosperity".

gloss: to oppress; to press; to constrict; oppression

example.zh: 肿瘤压迫神经，使他感到头疼。
example.en: The tumour presses on a nerve and gives him headaches.

example.zh: 他大学学的是金融专业。
example.en: He majored in finance at university.

example.zh: 工作和生活之间应该有清楚的界限。
example.en: There should be a clear boundary between work and personal life.

gloss: to taste; to sample; to savour

example.zh: 欢迎大家来品尝我们的新产品。
example.en: Everyone is welcome to sample our new products.

gloss: pill; ball; pellet; measure word for pills
indonesian: pil; bulatan kecil; kata satuan untuk pil

example.zh: 这种药丸每天吃两次，每次一丸。
example.en: Take these pills twice a day, one pill each time.

example.zh: 广场中央立着一座巨大的雕塑。
example.en: A huge sculpture stands in the middle of the square.

example.zh: 春天，农民们把种子播进了田里。
example.en: In spring, the farmers sowed the seeds in the fields.

example.zh: 我们需要找到一个可行的解决办法。
example.en: We need to find a workable solution.

gloss: to conceal; to take cover; hidden; covert

example.zh: 他们把车停在了一个很隐蔽的地方。
example.en: They parked the car in a very well-hidden spot.

example.zh: 她做了一个“OK”的手势，表示没问题。
example.en: She made an "OK" gesture to show there was no problem.

example.zh: 法国是一个共和国，没有国王。
example.en: France is a republic; it has no king.

example.zh: 这个房间阳光充足，非常适合养花。
example.en: This room gets plenty of sunlight and is perfect for growing flowers.

indonesian: buatan; buatan manusia; tenaga manusia; kerja manual

example.zh: 这片湖是人工挖出来的，并不是天然的。
example.en: This lake was dug by people; it is not natural.

gloss: the masses; the public; the people

example.zh: 围观的群众越来越多，交通都堵住了。
example.en: More and more onlookers gathered, and the traffic came to a standstill.

example.zh: 工人们正在用水泥修补地面。
example.en: The workers are patching the ground with cement.

gloss: to give off; to emit; to distribute; to hand out

example.zh: 厨房里散发出一股诱人的香味。
example.en: A tempting smell was coming from the kitchen.

gloss: tone (of voice); manner of speaking; implied meaning
indonesian: nada bicara; cara bicara; maksud tersirat

example.zh: 听他的口气，好像对结果不太满意。
example.en: Judging by his tone, he doesn't seem very happy with the result.

example.zh: 她在一家大公司负责公关工作。
example.en: She is in charge of public relations at a big company.

example.zh: 旅游业已经成为当地的支柱产业。
example.en: Tourism has become a pillar industry of the area.

example.zh: 科学家在山上采集了很多植物标本。
example.en: The scientists collected many plant specimens on the mountain.

gloss: to ponder; to mull over; to figure out
meanings: to polish and refine a literary work

example.zh: 这个问题我琢磨了半天也没想明白。
example.en: I turned this problem over for ages and still couldn't figure it out.

example.zh: 她虽然穿得很简单，但气质非常好。
example.en: Although she dresses simply, she carries herself very elegantly.

example.zh: 这首歌的旋律很优美，听一遍就记住了。
example.en: This song has a lovely melody; you remember it after one listen.

meanings: quality (of a product or service, or as in "quality of life", "air quality" etc)

example.zh: 诚实是一个人最重要的品质。
example.en: Honesty is the most important quality a person can have.

example.zh: 他被任命为公司的新经理。
example.en: He was appointed the company's new manager.

example.zh: 这部电影上映后引起了很大的争议。
example.en: The film caused a lot of controversy after its release.

gloss: to turn upside down; to reverse; to invert; confused

example.zh: 你把这两个字的顺序弄颠倒了。
example.en: You've got the order of these two characters reversed.

gloss: to count; to be valid; to keep one's word

example.zh: 你放心，我说话一向算数。
example.en: Don't worry, I always keep my word.

example.zh: 这些茶叶按质量分成三个等级。
example.en: These teas are divided into three grades by quality.

example.zh: 他对自己的现状并不满意，想换个工作。
example.en: He isn't happy with his current situation and wants to change jobs.

gloss: tolerant; lenient; to tolerate; to forgive

example.zh: 对别人的小错误，我们应该宽容一些。
example.en: We should be more tolerant of other people's small mistakes.

example.zh: 这座宫殿已有六百多年的历史。
example.en: This palace is more than six hundred years old.

gloss: prisoner of war; captive; to capture; to captivate

example.zh: 她的笑容俘虏了所有观众的心。
example.en: Her smile captured the hearts of the whole audience.

example.zh: 前面的司机一直按喇叭，吵死了。
example.en: The driver in front kept honking his horn; it was so noisy.

gloss: baffling; inexplicable; for no apparent reason; puzzled
indonesian: membingungkan; tidak masuk akal; tanpa alasan jelas; bingung
meanings: (idiom) baffling; bizarre; without rhyme or reason; inexplicable

example.zh: 他莫名其妙地对我发了一通火。
example.en: He flew into a rage at me for no apparent reason.

example.zh: 运动场四周挂满了各国的旗帜。
example.en: The flags of many countries hung all around the stadium.

example.zh: 申请的期限是本月三十号。
example.en: The deadline for applications is the 30th of this month.

example.zh: 下棋可以帮助孩子开发智力。
example.en: Playing chess can help children develop their intelligence.

gloss: to probe; to detect; to survey; to explore

example.zh: 科学家用卫星探测火星表面的情况。
example.en: Scientists use satellites to survey the surface of Mars.

example.zh: 我们在这个问题上存在一些分歧。
example.en: We have some differences of opinion on this issue.

example.zh: 这款手机的用户已经超过一亿。
example.en: This phone now has more than a hundred million users.

gloss: to be elected; to be chosen

example.zh: 她当选为今年的优秀教师。
example.en: She was chosen as this year's outstanding teacher.

example.zh: 今年冬天天气反常，一点儿也不冷。
example.en: The weather is unusual this winter; it isn't cold at all.

example.zh: 原先这里是一片农田，现在盖满了高楼。
example.en: This used to be farmland; now it is covered with tall buildings.

gloss: written; in writing; in written form
indonesian: tertulis; secara tertulis; dalam bentuk tulisan

example.zh: 请把你的意见用书面形式交给我们。
example.en: Please submit your comments to us in writing.

indonesian: kendali jarak jauh; remot; mengendalikan dari jauh
meanings: to direct operations from a remote location

example.zh: 电视的遥控器又找不到了。
example.en: I can't find the TV remote control again.

gloss: to tremble; to shiver; to shake

example.zh: 她冷得浑身颤抖，说不出话来。
example.en: She was so cold she was shaking all over and couldn't speak.

example.zh: 每天无事可做，他觉得内心很空虚。
example.en: With nothing to do every day, he felt empty inside.

example.zh: 这面墙是用红砖砌成的。
example.en: This wall is built of red bricks.

gloss: to dislike; to be disgusted with; aversion

example.zh: 他说话太傲慢，让人很反感。
example.en: He talks so arrogantly that people find him off-putting.

example.zh: 做这种事一点儿也不光彩。
example.en: There is nothing honourable about doing something like this.

example.zh: 雪地上留下了小动物的踪迹。
example.en: Small animals left tracks in the snow.

example.zh: 她病了好几天，脸色很苍白。
example.en: She has been ill for several days and looks very pale.

gloss: to reject; to exclude; to repel

example.zh: 新来的同学并没有受到大家的排斥。
example.en: The new classmate was not shut out by the others.

example.zh: 忙碌了一整天，他终于可以休息了。
example.en: After a whole busy day, he could finally rest.

gloss: to veto; to vote down; to reject

example.zh: 他的建议在会上被否决了。
example.en: His proposal was voted down at the meeting.

gloss: to explain; to account for; to hand over; to brief
meanings: to give instructions; to tell (sb to do sth)
to explain; to give an account; to brief
to confess; to account for oneself
(jocular) to come to a bad end

example.zh: 走之前，经理把工作都交代清楚了。
example.en: Before leaving, the manager clearly handed over all the work.

gloss: to imagine; to envisage; idea; tentative plan

example.zh: 这只是我的一个初步设想，还需要讨论。
example.en: This is just a preliminary idea of mine; it still needs discussion.

gloss: after all; in the end; eventually
meanings: after all is said and done

example.zh: 孩子终究是孩子，不能要求太高。
example.en: Children are children after all; you can't expect too much.

example.zh: 长时间看手机会影响视力。
example.en: Looking at your phone for long periods can affect your eyesight.

gloss: to continue; to go on; to last

example.zh: 这个传统已经延续了几百年。
example.en: This tradition has continued for several hundred years.

example.zh: 一个人的内在美比外表更重要。
example.en: A person's inner beauty matters more than their looks.

example.zh: 他在这次比赛中获得了一枚铜牌。
example.en: He won a bronze medal in this competition.

example.zh: 新疆种植了大量的棉花。
example.en: Large amounts of cotton are grown in Xinjiang.

example.zh: 请先寄几件样品给我们看看。
example.en: Please send us a few samples to look at first.

gloss: to endure; to bear; to be patient; patience

example.zh: 再忍耐一下，我们马上就到家了。
example.en: Hang on a little longer; we'll be home soon.

gloss: to implement; to carry out; to put into practice

example.zh: 学校从下学期开始实行新的作息时间。
example.en: The school will put a new timetable into practice next term.

gloss: years; time; the passing of time

example.zh: 岁月在他的脸上留下了痕迹。
example.en: The years have left their mark on his face.

gloss: to gnaw; to nibble; to bite; to pore over (a book)

example.zh: 小狗正趴在地上啃骨头。
example.en: The puppy is lying on the ground gnawing a bone.

gloss: to restrict; to bind; to constrain; restraint

example.zh: 每个人都应该用规则约束自己的行为。
example.en: Everyone should restrain their behaviour by the rules.

gloss: to perish; to die out; to be destroyed; extinction

example.zh: 恐龙为什么会灭亡，到现在还是个谜。
example.en: Why the dinosaurs died out is still a mystery today.

example.zh: 每个人都有自己的专长。
example.en: Everyone has their own area of expertise.

gloss: to deploy; to arrange; to plan; deployment

example.zh: 公司已经部署好下一阶段的工作。
example.en: The company has already planned out the next stage of work.

gloss: to justify oneself; to explain away; to defend (one's position)
meanings: to defend (a point of view etc)

example.zh: 错了就是错了，你不用再辩解了。
example.en: Wrong is wrong; there's no need to make excuses.

gloss: to synthesize; to compose; to combine; synthetic

example.zh: 这张照片是用电脑合成的。
example.en: This photo was put together on a computer.

gloss: to be on duty; to work a shift

example.zh: 今天晚上轮到我在医院值班。
example.en: Tonight it's my turn to be on duty at the hospital.

example.zh: 钢笔没墨水儿了，借我一支笔吧。
example.en: My fountain pen is out of ink; lend me a pen.

gloss: to record; to put down in writing; record; account

example.zh: 这本书详细记载了当地的风俗习惯。
example.en: This book records the local customs in detail.

gloss: to remedy; to rectify; to make up for

example.zh: 发现问题后，他立刻想办法补救。
example.en: Once he found the problem, he immediately tried to put it right.

example.zh: 这所大学有完善的教学体系。
example.en: This university has a well-developed teaching system.

example.zh: 加了一周的班，大家都显得很疲惫。
example.en: After a week of overtime, everyone looked exhausted.

gloss: to take effect; to come into force

example.zh: 新的规定从下个月一号起生效。
example.en: The new regulations take effect on the first of next month.

example.zh: 这里气候温和，四季如春。
example.en: The climate here is mild; it is like spring all year round.

gloss: upbringing; good manners; to bring up; to educate
meanings: to educate; to bring up; to nurture

example.zh: 从他说话的方式可以看出，他很有教养。
example.en: You can tell from the way he talks that he is well brought up.

gloss: to lie in wait; to ambush; ambush

example.zh: 猫埋伏在草丛里，等着老鼠出来。
example.en: The cat lay in wait in the grass for the mouse to come out.

example.zh: 城市的用水主要由这座水库供给。
example.en: The city's water is mainly supplied by this reservoir.

gloss: doubt; puzzlement; to feel puzzled; uncertain

example.zh: 听了他的解释，我心里还是有些疑惑。
example.en: Even after hearing his explanation, I still had some doubts.

example.zh: 这篇文章的标题很吸引人。
example.en: The title of this article is very eye-catching.

gloss: to struggle; to fight; to wrestle
meanings: to wrestle; to fight; to struggle

example.zh: 船员们与风浪搏斗了一整夜。
example.en: The crew battled the wind and waves all night.

gloss: to stroke; to caress; to pet

example.zh: 她轻轻抚摸着小猫的头。
example.en: She gently stroked the kitten's head.

gloss: regardless of; in spite of; to disregard

example.zh: 他不顾家人的反对，辞职去创业了。
example.en: Despite his family's objections, he quit his job to start a business.

example.zh: 中午的阳光十分耀眼。
example.en: The midday sun is dazzling.

example.zh: 火药是中国古代四大发明之一。
example.en: Gunpowder is one of the four great inventions of ancient China.

gloss: to pick up; to collect; ten (formal numeral used on cheques)
indonesian: memungut; mengambil (dari tanah); sepuluh (angka resmi pada cek)

example.zh: 他在路上拾到一个钱包，交给了警察。
example.en: He picked up a wallet in the street and handed it to the police.

example.zh: 他感冒了，一直流鼻涕。
example.en: He has a cold and his nose keeps running.

gloss: superstition; to be superstitious about; to have blind faith in
indonesian: takhayul; percaya takhayul; percaya secara membabi buta
meanings: to have a superstitious belief (in sth)

example.zh: 我们不应该盲目迷信专家的话。
example.en: We shouldn't blindly believe everything experts say.

gloss: to curry favour with; to please; to fawn on

example.zh: 他总是想办法讨好老板。
example.en: He is always trying to get on the boss's good side.

example.zh: 孩子们脸上露出灿烂的笑容。
example.en: The children's faces lit up with bright smiles.

example.zh: 清晨的公园里有很多人在锻炼。
example.en: Early in the morning many people exercise in the park.

gloss: family background; origin; to come from (a family)
indonesian: latar belakang keluarga; asal-usul; berasal dari

example.zh: 他出身于一个普通的农民家庭。
example.en: He comes from an ordinary farming family.

example.zh: 他的野心很大，想把公司做成行业第一。
example.en: He is very ambitious and wants to make the company number one in the industry.

gloss: to stare; to glare; to open one's eyes wide

example.zh: 妈妈瞪了他一眼，他马上不说话了。
example.en: His mother glared at him, and he immediately went quiet.

example.zh: 这个季度公司的销售额增长了百分之十。
example.en: The company's sales grew by ten percent this quarter.

example.zh: 请从这些数字中任意选一个。
example.en: Please pick any one of these numbers.

gloss: only natural; as it should be; to be taken for granted
indonesian: sudah sewajarnya; sudah semestinya; dianggap wajar
meanings: as it should be by rights (idiom); proper and to be expected as a matter of course

example.zh: 父母的照顾不是理所当然的，我们要懂得感恩。
example.en: Our parents' care is not something to take for granted; we should be grateful.

example.zh: 读书可以开阔我们的视野。
example.en: Reading can broaden our horizons.

example.zh: 他在公司担任经理职务。
example.en: He holds the position of manager at the company.

gloss: to smash; to shatter; to crush; broken to pieces
meanings: to crush; to smash; to shatter

example.zh: 杯子掉在地上，摔得粉碎。
example.en: The cup fell on the floor and smashed to pieces.

gloss: to remain; to be left over; residue
meanings: to remain; to be left over

example.zh: 蔬菜上可能残留着农药，要洗干净再吃。
example.en: Vegetables may have pesticide residue on them, so wash them before eating.

example.zh: 面对对方的挑衅，他始终保持冷静。
example.en: Faced with the other side's provocation, he kept his cool.

gloss: to drift apart; to become estranged; to keep at a distance; distant

example.zh: 搬家以后，我们的关系慢慢疏远了。
example.en: After the move, we gradually drifted apart.

gloss: to spread out; to share (costs); stall; measure word for puddles

example.zh: 晚饭的钱我们三个人平摊吧。
example.en: Let's split the cost of dinner three ways.

gloss: to set out; to leave (on a journey)

example.zh: 我们明天一早就动身去北京。
example.en: We'll set off for Beijing early tomorrow morning.

example.zh: 这家店的价格很公道。
example.en: This shop's prices are very fair.

gloss: without permission; on one's own authority; unauthorized

example.zh: 员工不能擅自离开工作岗位。
example.en: Employees may not leave their posts without permission.

example.zh: 这支球队曾经有过辉煌的历史。
example.en: This team once had a glorious history.

gloss: to spread; to extend; to creep

example.zh: 没人打理，野草很快蔓延到了整个院子。
example.en: With no one looking after it, weeds soon spread across the whole yard.

meanings: alternative name for 绛 capital of the Jin State during the Spring and Autumn Period (770-475 BC)
area surrounding the bullseye of a target
one of the 28 constellations of Chinese astronomy

example.zh: 这架飞机的左翼出了点小问题。
example.en: There is a minor problem with the plane's left wing.

example.zh: 记者对新闻要有敏锐的观察力。
example.en: A journalist needs a keen eye for news.

gloss: to hold on to; to dig; to strip off; to push aside
meanings: to cling to (sth on which one is climbing)

example.zh: 他扒开人群，挤到了最前面。
example.en: He pushed through the crowd and squeezed to the very front.

example.zh: 人们在废墟上重建了自己的家园。
example.en: People rebuilt their homes on the ruins.

gloss: to devote oneself to; to work for

example.zh: 他多年来一直致力于环境保护工作。
example.en: For many years he has devoted himself to environmental protection.

example.zh: 饼干要放在密封的盒子里才不会受潮。
example.en: Biscuits should be kept in an airtight box so they don't go soft.

gloss: to cause a sensation; to make a stir; sensational
meanings: to create a stir in (a place)

example.zh: 这条新闻轰动了全国。
example.en: This news caused a sensation across the country.

example.zh: 她眨了眨眼睛，好像不明白我的意思。
example.en: She blinked, as if she didn't understand what I meant.

gloss: to try (a case); to hear (a case)

example.zh: 这起合同纠纷将在下周开庭审理。
example.en: This contract dispute will be heard in court next week.

gloss: to call; to call out to; to summon

example.zh: 我听见远处有人在呼唤我的名字。
example.en: I heard someone in the distance calling my name.

example.zh: 她很少戴首饰，打扮得很朴素。
example.en: She rarely wears jewellery and dresses very simply.

gloss: to set up; to establish; to found

example.zh: 学校设立了奖学金，鼓励学生努力学习。
example.en: The school set up a scholarship to encourage students to study hard.

gloss: string (of an instrument); bowstring; spring (of a clock)

example.zh: 吉他的一根弦断了，得换一根新的。
example.en: One of the guitar strings broke; it needs replacing.

gloss: to postpone; to delay; to extend (a deadline)

example.zh: 因为下大雨，运动会延期举行。
example.en: Because of heavy rain, the sports day was postponed.

meanings: the North Pole; the Arctic Pole

example.zh: 北极熊生活在寒冷的北极地区。
example.en: Polar bears live in the cold Arctic region.

gloss: to evaporate; evaporation; to vanish into thin air

example.zh: 天气太热，盆里的水很快就蒸发了。
example.en: It was so hot that the water in the basin quickly evaporated.

gloss: to log in; to sign in; to register

example.zh: 请先登录你的账号，再提交作业。
example.en: Please log in to your account first, then submit your homework.

gloss: vertical; upright; to erect; vertical stroke

example.zh: 路边竖着一块很大的广告牌。
example.en: A huge billboard stands by the roadside.

example.zh: 买东西不能盲目跟风。
example.en: You shouldn't blindly follow trends when you shop.

gloss: to impact; to pound; impact; shock

example.zh: 网上购物对传统商店造成了很大的冲击。
example.en: Online shopping has had a big impact on traditional shops.

example.zh: 最近他频繁地出差，很少在家。
example.en: He has been travelling for work a lot lately and is rarely home.

example.zh: 面对困难，我们不要畏惧。
example.en: We should not be afraid when facing difficulties.

gloss: to control; to dominate; to allocate; to arrange

example.zh: 周末的时间可以由自己自由支配。
example.en: You can spend your weekend time however you like.

example.zh: 通过考试后，你会拿到一张证书。
example.en: After passing the exam, you will receive a certificate.

example.zh: 我时常想起小时候在乡下的生活。
example.en: I often think of my childhood in the countryside.

example.zh: 站在山顶看日出，景色十分壮观。
example.en: Watching the sunrise from the summit is a spectacular sight.

example.zh: 他努力克制自己的情绪，没有发火。
example.en: He tried hard to control his emotions and didn't lose his temper.

example.zh: 原材料涨价，生产成本也提高了。
example.en: Raw materials went up in price, so production costs rose too.

gloss: to miss; to long for; to think of

example.zh: 在国外留学的时候，我常常思念家人。
example.en: When I was studying abroad, I often missed my family.

example.zh: 借的书请在两周内归还。
example.en: Please return borrowed books within two weeks.

example.zh: 这一带都是新建的住宅区。
example.en: This whole area is a newly built residential district.

example.zh: 看到孩子这么懂事，妈妈感到很欣慰。
example.en: Seeing her child so sensible made the mother feel very gratified.

example.zh: 两国签订了友好合作条约。
example.en: The two countries signed a treaty of friendship and cooperation.

gloss: to hold in both hands; to carry in cupped hands; to flatter; measure word for handfuls
indonesian: menatang; memegang dengan kedua tangan; menyanjung; segenggam
meanings: to hold up with both hands

example.zh: 她双手捧着一束鲜花走了进来。
example.en: She came in holding a bunch of flowers in both hands.

gloss: to peel; to pare; to cut; to reduce

example.zh: 他正在给奶奶削苹果。
example.en: He is peeling an apple for his grandma.

example.zh: 他做事一贯很认真，从来不马虎。
example.en: He has always been conscientious and is never careless.

example.zh: 他在这家公司持有百分之二十的股份。
example.en: He holds a twenty percent stake in this company.

example.zh: 这座博物馆记录了那段被侵略的历史。
example.en: This museum documents that period when the country was invaded.

meanings: Fengman district of Jilin city 吉林市, Jilin province

example.zh: 小说里的人物形象非常丰满。
example.en: The characters in the novel are very fully drawn.

indonesian: giok; batu giok; (kiasan) murni dan indah

example.zh: 这只玉镯是奶奶留给她的。
example.en: This jade bracelet was left to her by her grandmother.

gloss: to update; to renew; to replace the old with the new
meanings: to replace the old with new

example.zh: 我的手机系统需要更新了。
example.en: My phone's system needs updating.

gloss: to reason; to infer; reasoning; inference

example.zh: 通过严密的推理，他找到了问题的答案。
example.en: Through careful reasoning, he found the answer to the problem.

gloss: to award; to confer; to grant

example.zh: 学校授予他荣誉博士学位。
example.en: The university awarded him an honorary doctorate.

example.zh: 爷爷年纪大了，走路离不开拐杖。
example.en: Grandpa is old now and can't walk without a walking stick.

example.zh: 这个理论还需要通过实验来验证。
example.en: This theory still needs to be verified by experiment.

example.zh: 鸡蛋和牛奶里含有丰富的蛋白质。
example.en: Eggs and milk are rich in protein.

indonesian: sangat besar; raksasa; luar biasa besar

example.zh: 这个项目需要一笔庞大的资金。
example.en: This project requires an enormous amount of money.

example.zh: 这些水果可以在冰箱里储存一个星期。
example.en: These fruits can be kept in the fridge for a week.

example.zh: 我的衬衫上掉了一颗纽扣儿。
example.en: A button has come off my shirt.

example.zh: 她总是紧跟时尚潮流。
example.en: She always keeps up with the latest fashion trends.

gloss: to carry on one's shoulder; to shoulder (responsibility)
meanings: to raise aloft with both hands
(of two or more people) to carry sth together
(fig.) to take on (a burden, duty etc)

example.zh: 他扛着一袋大米上了五楼。
example.en: He carried a sack of rice on his shoulder up to the fifth floor.

gloss: to pace up and down; to hesitate; to waver; to hover (around a level)

example.zh: 他在门口徘徊了很久，最后还是没有进去。
example.en: He paced outside the door for a long time and in the end didn't go in.

example.zh: 骑车下坡的时候要注意安全。
example.en: Be careful when cycling downhill.

gloss: bundle wrapped in cloth; burden; weight on one's mind

example.zh: 放下思想包袱，轻松地去考试吧。
example.en: Let go of your worries and take the exam in a relaxed frame of mind.

indonesian: sisi; samping; profil; secara tidak langsung

example.zh: 我从侧面了解了一下他的情况。
example.en: I found out about his situation indirectly.

gloss: by fair means or foul; by any means necessary; unscrupulously
indonesian: menghalalkan segala cara; dengan segala cara

example.zh: 他为了赚钱不择手段，最后失去了朋友。
example.en: He would do anything to make money and ended up losing his friends.

example.zh: 他伸出双臂，紧紧地抱住了妈妈。
example.en: He stretched out his arms and hugged his mother tightly.

example.zh: 啤酒倒得太快，杯子里全是泡沫。
example.en: The beer was poured too fast, and the glass was full of foam.

example.zh: 夫妻之间难免会有一些摩擦。
example.en: Some friction between husband and wife is inevitable.

gloss: to defend; to safeguard; to uphold

example.zh: 每个人都有权利捍卫自己的合法权益。
example.en: Everyone has the right to defend their lawful rights and interests.

example.zh: 这篇文章层次清楚，很容易理解。
example.en: This essay is clearly structured and easy to understand.

example.zh: 我把要做的事情都记在手机备忘录里。
example.en: I note down everything I need to do in my phone's memo app.

example.zh: 去之前最好预先打个电话。
example.en: It's best to phone ahead before you go.

example.zh: 老师用图片辅助讲解，学生更容易理解。
example.en: The teacher uses pictures to aid the explanation, so students understand more easily.

gloss: to guard against; to be on the alert; vigilance

example.zh: 她对陌生人总是有很强的戒备心理。
example.en: She is always very wary of strangers.

example.zh: 你知道冰箱的工作原理吗？
example.en: Do you know how a refrigerator works?

gloss: to split; to chop; to cleave; (of lightning) to strike

example.zh: 爷爷每天早上都在院子里劈柴。
example.en: Grandpa chops firewood in the yard every morning.

example.zh: 这篇论文结构严密，逻辑清楚。
example.en: This paper is tightly structured and logically clear.

gloss: to wake up; to regain consciousness; to come to

example.zh: 春天到了，万物开始苏醒。
example.en: Spring has arrived and everything is coming back to life.

example.zh: 我们可以通过多种渠道了解市场信息。
example.en: We can learn about the market through many channels.

example.zh: 他在这家公司工作了将近十年。
example.en: He has worked at this company for nearly ten years.

gloss: to innovate; innovation; to bring forth new ideas
meanings: to bring forth new ideas; to blaze new trails

example.zh: 企业只有不断创新，才能在竞争中生存。
example.en: Only by constantly innovating can a company survive the competition.

example.zh: 当前最重要的任务是提高产品质量。
example.en: The most important task at present is to improve product quality.

gloss: to speed; to gallop; to run quickly

example.zh: 一列火车在草原上奔驰。
example.en: A train is speeding across the grassland.

gloss: to shape; to mould; to portray (a character)
meanings: (fig.) to create (a character, a market, an image etc)

example.zh: 这部电影成功地塑造了一位好老师的形象。
example.en: This film successfully portrays a good teacher.

example.zh: 医生用酒精给伤口消毒。
example.en: The doctor disinfected the wound with alcohol.

example.zh: 这项投资给公司带来了不少收益。
example.en: This investment brought the company considerable returns.

example.zh: 孩子们在海边玩得非常快活。
example.en: The children had a wonderful time playing at the beach.

indonesian: lagi pula; apalagi; di samping itu

example.zh: 天已经黑了，况且又下着雨，你别走了。
example.en: It's already dark, and besides, it's raining, so don't leave.

example.zh: 这条瀑布从几十米高的山上流下来。
example.en: This waterfall pours down from a mountain dozens of metres high.

gloss: to spread; to disseminate; to scatter

example.zh: 不要在网上散布没有根据的消息。
example.en: Don't spread unfounded rumours online.

gloss: to catch; to seize; to capture (an image, opportunity)

example.zh: 摄影师捕捉到了这个美好的瞬间。
example.en: The photographer captured this beautiful moment.

gloss: contrary to expectations; just (of all times); insistently; deliberately
meanings: (indicates that sth turns out just the opposite of what one would wish) unfortunately
(indicates that sth is the opposite of what would be normal or reasonable) stubbornly
(indicates that sb or a group is singled out) precisely

example.zh: 我急着出门，偏偏找不到钥匙。
example.en: I was in a hurry to go out, and of course I couldn't find my keys.

gloss: paralysis; numbness; to lower one's guard; careless

example.zh: 快到终点了，千万不能麻痹大意。
example.en: We're nearly at the finish, so we mustn't let our guard down.

example.zh: 这把刀很锋利，用的时候要小心。
example.en: This knife is very sharp; be careful when you use it.

example.zh: 他第一次做饭，动作显得很笨拙。
example.en: It was his first time cooking, and he looked very clumsy.

gloss: to relieve; to provide relief; relief (aid)
meanings: to help the needy with cash or goods

example.zh: 政府给受灾的家庭发放了救济物资。
example.en: The government handed out relief supplies to families hit by the disaster.

example.zh: 他说话太直，得罪了不少人。
example.en: He speaks so bluntly that he has offended quite a few people.

gloss: outrageous; preposterous; how can this be
indonesian: keterlaluan; tidak masuk akal; masa begitu
meanings: how can this be so? (idiom); preposterous

example.zh: 他借钱不还，还骂人，真是岂有此理！
example.en: He won't pay back the money and swears at people too. It's outrageous!

indonesian: cerdik; pandai; hebat; orang yang ahli
meanings: Gaoming District of Foshan City 市, Guangdong

example.zh: 这个办法真高明，问题一下子就解决了。
example.en: What a brilliant idea; the problem was solved at once.

example.zh: 学校为毕业生举行了隆重的毕业典礼。
example.en: The school held a grand graduation ceremony for the graduates.

gloss: to concede; to give in; to yield; concession

example.zh: 经过讨论，双方都做了一些让步。
example.en: After discussion, both sides made some concessions.

gloss: branch; twig; measure word for long thin objects (pens, flowers)
indonesian: cabang; ranting; kata satuan untuk benda panjang (pena, bunga)
meanings: classifier for sticks, rods, pencils etc

example.zh: 他送了我一枝红玫瑰。
example.en: He gave me a red rose.

example.zh: 机遇只留给有准备的人。
example.en: Opportunity only comes to those who are prepared.

example.zh: 在网上诽谤别人是违法的。
example.en: Slandering people online is against the law.

example.zh: 这场洪水冲毁了很多农田。
example.en: The flood washed away a lot of farmland.

gloss: to reverse; to turn around (a situation); to twist

example.zh: 下半场他们终于扭转了局面。
example.en: In the second half they finally turned the game around.

example.zh: 考试结果完全出乎我的意料。
example.en: The exam result was completely beyond my expectations.

example.zh: 这家餐厅在当地享有很高的声誉。
example.en: This restaurant enjoys a very good reputation locally.

gloss: awkward; uncomfortable; hard to get along with; at odds
indonesian: canggung; tidak nyaman; susah diatur; tidak akur

example.zh: 第一次穿高跟鞋，走起路来很别扭。
example.en: Wearing high heels for the first time, she felt awkward walking.

meanings: sth uniquely enjoyed (or possessed etc) by a certain group of people

example.zh: 这项新技术已经申请了专利。
example.en: A patent has already been applied for on this new technology.

gloss: to choose; to pick; to select; to pick up

example.zh: 她拣了几个最红的苹果放进篮子里。
example.en: She picked out a few of the reddest apples and put them in the basket.

gloss: to heal; to recover; the more ... the more

example.zh: 雨愈下愈大，我们只好在屋里等着。
example.en: The rain got heavier and heavier, so we had to wait indoors.

example.zh: 她脸上露出了喜悦的笑容。
example.en: A joyful smile appeared on her face.

gloss: to distinguish; to differentiate; to tell apart

example.zh: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，很难区分。
example.en: These twins look so alike that it's hard to tell them apart.

example.zh: 这个小男孩很机灵，一教就会。
example.en: This little boy is very bright; he learns as soon as you show him.

example.zh: 这套音响的效果非常好。
example.en: This sound system sounds excellent.

example.zh: 这个盒子做得很精致，我舍不得扔。
example.en: This box is so finely made that I can't bear to throw it away.

example.zh: 他虽然身体有残疾，但从来没有放弃过梦想。
example.en: Although he has a physical disability, he has never given up on his dreams.

gloss: to rescue; to save (a life); to give emergency treatment

example.zh: 经过医生的全力抢救，病人终于脱离了危险。
example.en: After the doctors' all-out efforts, the patient was finally out of danger.

example.zh: 门把手坏了，得找人来修。
example.en: The door handle is broken; we need to get someone to fix it.

example.zh: 为了省钱，我们得减少不必要的开支。
example.en: To save money, we need to cut unnecessary expenses.

gloss: so far; up to now; to date

example.zh: 这是迄今为止我看过的最好的电影。
example.en: This is the best film I have seen so far.

example.zh: 公司明天要召开股东大会。
example.en: The company is holding its shareholders' meeting tomorrow.

gloss: to give birth to; to bear (children); childbearing

example.zh: 现在很多年轻人推迟了生育的年龄。
example.en: Nowadays many young people are putting off having children.

gloss: to consume; to use up; consumption

example.zh: 跑步能消耗大量的热量。
example.en: Running burns a lot of calories.

example.zh: 青少年正处在身体发育的关键时期。
example.en: Teenagers are at a crucial stage of physical development.

example.zh: 他输了比赛，却很有风度地祝贺对手。
example.en: He lost the match but graciously congratulated his opponent.

gloss: to let down; to fail to live up to; to disappoint
meanings: to fail to live up (to expectations)

example.zh: 我一定努力学习，不辜负父母的期望。
example.en: I will study hard and not let my parents down.

example.zh: 开了一天的会，他感到十分疲倦。
example.en: After a whole day of meetings, he felt very tired.

example.zh: 警察很快就抓住了那个歹徒。
example.en: The police soon caught the criminal.

example.zh: 这只小鹿身上有白色的斑点。
example.en: This fawn has white spots on its body.

gloss: to decompose; to break down; to resolve; to explain

example.zh: 塑料袋需要几百年才能分解。
example.en: Plastic bags take hundreds of years to break down.

gloss: as always; as before; just as in the past
meanings: just as in the past (idiom); as before

example.zh: 我们会一如既往地为顾客提供优质服务。
example.en: As always, we will provide our customers with quality service.

example.zh: 这些奖学金专门用来帮助贫困学生。
example.en: These scholarships are specifically for helping poor students.

example.zh: 离开故乡二十年，他终于回来了。
example.en: After twenty years away from his hometown, he finally came back.

example.zh: 秦朝建立了中国第一个统一的中央政权。
example.en: The Qin dynasty established China's first unified central government.

example.zh: 他的爷爷曾经是一名海军司令。
example.en: His grandfather was once a naval commander.

gloss: to refute; to retort; to rebut

example.zh: 他的话很有道理，我一时不知道怎么反驳。
example.en: What he said made a lot of sense; for a moment I didn't know how to argue back.

example.zh: 阳光照在湖面上，反射出耀眼的光。
example.en: Sunlight falls on the lake and reflects a dazzling light.

indonesian: cerita di balik layar; informasi orang dalam

example.zh: 记者调查出了这件事的内幕。
example.en: The reporter uncovered the inside story of this affair.

gloss: hammer; to hammer; weight (of a steelyard)
meanings: weight (e.g. of a steelyard or balance)

example.zh: 他用锤子把钉子钉进了墙里。
example.en: He used a hammer to drive the nail into the wall.

example.zh: 历史上很多科学家因为坚持真理而受到迫害。
example.en: In history, many scientists were persecuted for standing up for the truth.

gloss: everyone; ladies and gentlemen; all of you

example.zh: 感谢诸位今天来参加我们的活动。
example.en: Thank you all for coming to our event today.

example.zh: 他因为生病缺席了今天的会议。
example.en: He missed today's meeting because he was ill.

example.zh: 早饭我喜欢喝一碗热粥。
example.en: For breakfast I like a bowl of hot congee.

gloss: to flee; to scurry; to dash; to alter (a text)
indonesian: lari kocar-kacir; melesat; berlari cepat; mengubah (teks)

example.zh: 一只老鼠从厨房里窜了出来。
example.en: A mouse darted out of the kitchen.

gloss: to depict; to describe; to portray

example.zh: 这幅画描绘了江南水乡的美丽风景。
example.en: This painting depicts the beautiful scenery of the southern water towns.

example.zh: 这两条路是平行的，永远不会相交。
example.en: These two roads are parallel and will never meet.

gloss: to intervene; to interfere; to meddle; intervention

example.zh: 父母不应该过多干预孩子的选择。
example.en: Parents shouldn't interfere too much in their children's choices.

example.zh: 演出结束后，演员们向观众鞠躬致谢。
example.en: After the show, the actors bowed to the audience in thanks.

gloss: harmonious; on friendly terms; in harmony
meanings: on good terms with one another

example.zh: 我们办公室的气氛很融洽。
example.en: The atmosphere in our office is very harmonious.

gloss: as before; all the same; still; to follow a model
indonesian: tetap; sama seperti biasa; tetap saja; mengikuti contoh

example.zh: 就算下雨，比赛照样进行。
example.en: Even if it rains, the match will go ahead as usual.

gloss: to hug; to embrace; to hold in one's arms
meanings: to gather up (one's gown, sleeves etc)

example.zh: 妈妈把孩子搂在怀里。
example.en: The mother held the child in her arms.

example.zh: 按照惯例，新员工要先培训一个月。
example.en: As usual practice, new employees first train for a month.

gloss: to compete; to have a contest; to pit one's strength against; contest

example.zh: 两支球队在决赛中展开了激烈的较量。
example.en: The two teams fought a fierce contest in the final.

gloss: to go out (of a fire or light); to extinguish; to put out

example.zh: 晚上十一点，宿舍的灯全部熄灭了。
example.en: At eleven at night, all the lights in the dorm went out.

gloss: to rub; to knead; to massage

example.zh: 他揉了揉眼睛，好像还没睡醒。
example.en: He rubbed his eyes as if he wasn't quite awake yet.

example.zh: 我们请了一位当地的向导带我们爬山。
example.en: We hired a local guide to take us up the mountain.

gloss: to freeze (assets, prices); to freeze (of water); frozen

example.zh: 他的银行账户被冻结了。
example.en: His bank account has been frozen.

gloss: to decide; to make the decision; to take charge

example.zh: 这件事我可以做主，你就放心吧。
example.en: I can make the call on this, so don't worry.

gloss: to despise; to look down on; to disdain

example.zh: 我们不应该鄙视任何一种诚实的劳动。
example.en: We shouldn't look down on any kind of honest work.

meanings: to make an item of clothing

example.zh: 她请裁缝做了一件旗袍。
example.en: She had a tailor make her a qipao.

gloss: to inspect; to investigate on the spot; to examine; field study

example.zh: 专家们到山区考察当地的教育情况。
example.en: Experts went to the mountain area to look into local education.

example.zh: 为了健康，她开始吃素食。
