example.en: For her health, she started eating vegetarian food.

gloss: to submerge; to flood; to drown out

example.zh: 他的声音被热烈的掌声淹没了。
example.en: His voice was drowned out by the warm applause.

example.zh: 太阳不断地向四周放射出光和热。
example.en: The sun constantly radiates light and heat in all directions.

gloss: to form a partnership; to team up; partnership

example.zh: 他和朋友合伙开了一家咖啡馆。
example.en: He went into partnership with a friend and opened a café.

example.zh: 他这次是因为公务来上海的。
example.en: He came to Shanghai this time on official business.

example.zh: 月亮的光辉洒满了整个院子。
example.en: Moonlight filled the whole courtyard.

gloss: scenery; view; glorious; grand (of an occasion)

example.zh: 这里的风光非常美丽，吸引了很多游客。
example.en: The scenery here is beautiful and attracts many tourists.

gloss: to violate; to offend; to infringe

example.zh: 他的行为已经触犯了公司的规定。
example.en: His behaviour has already broken company rules.

example.zh: 请把会议的要点记下来。
example.en: Please write down the key points of the meeting.

gloss: to go to court; to file a lawsuit; to litigate

example.zh: 为了这件小事打官司，太不值得了。
example.en: Going to court over such a small matter isn't worth it.

gloss: crumbs; bits; scraps; to deign to
indonesian: remah; serpihan; sudi (dalam 不屑 = tidak sudi)

example.zh: 吃完点心，桌子上全是饼干屑。
example.en: After the snack, the table was covered in biscuit crumbs.

gloss: to serve; to wait upon; to look after

example.zh: 奶奶生病了，妈妈每天在医院伺候她。
example.en: Grandma is ill, and Mum looks after her at the hospital every day.

gloss: to entertain (guests); to treat cordially; hospitality

example.zh: 谢谢你们的热情款待。
example.en: Thank you for your warm hospitality.

example.zh: 他被评为全市的劳动模范。
example.en: He was named a model worker for the whole city.

gloss: to conceive; to plan out (a piece of writing or art); conception

example.zh: 写作文之前，最好先构思一下。
example.en: Before writing an essay, it's best to plan it out first.

gloss: to break off; to sever; to cut off

example.zh: 大雪断绝了山里和外面的交通。
example.en: The heavy snow cut off transport between the mountains and the outside.

gloss: to bring along; to take along (for someone); to pass on (a message)

example.zh: 你去超市的时候，帮我捎一瓶牛奶回来。
example.en: When you go to the supermarket, bring me back a bottle of milk.

gloss: might as well; there is no harm in
indonesian: tidak ada salahnya; sebaiknya; boleh saja

example.zh: 这个方法你不妨试一试。
example.en: There's no harm in giving this method a try.

gloss: to pay attention to; to attach importance to; to emphasize

example.zh: 这所学校很注重培养学生的动手能力。
example.en: This school puts great emphasis on developing students' practical skills.

indonesian: jerih payah; segenap tenaga dan pikiran

example.zh: 这本书凝聚了他十年的心血。
example.en: This book represents ten years of his painstaking effort.

example.zh: 他不愿意和人交流，在班上很孤立。
example.en: He doesn't like talking to people and is quite isolated in class.

gloss: to have an accident (crash, wreck); to crash

example.zh: 这次飞机失事的原因还在调查中。
example.en: The cause of this plane crash is still under investigation.

example.zh: 病人疼得不停地呻吟。
example.en: The patient was in such pain that he kept groaning.

gloss: to follow; to abide by; to adhere to
meanings: to follow; to abide by; to comply with

example.zh: 做实验必须遵循科学的方法。
example.en: Experiments must follow scientific methods.

example.zh: 比赛的胜负并不重要，重要的是参与。
example.en: Winning or losing isn't important; what matters is taking part.

gloss: to plunder; to rob; to loot

example.zh: 过度开发就是对自然资源的掠夺。
example.en: Overdevelopment amounts to plundering natural resources.

gloss: cannot bear; unbearable; utterly (after negative words)

example.zh: 连续工作了三天，他已经疲惫不堪。
example.en: After working three days straight, he was utterly exhausted.

indonesian: mati rasa; kebas; acuh tak acuh

example.zh: 在外面站了太久，我的脚都冻麻木了。
example.en: I stood outside so long that my feet went numb with cold.

gloss: to be proficient in; to master; to have a good command of

example.zh: 她精通三种语言，是一名优秀的翻译。
example.en: She is fluent in three languages and is an excellent translator.

example.zh: 根据气象部门的预报，明天有大雨。
example.en: According to the weather service, there will be heavy rain tomorrow.

example.zh: 印度尼西亚曾经是荷兰的殖民地。
example.en: Indonesia was once a Dutch colony.

gloss: to extend; to stretch; to spread

example.zh: 这条公路一直延伸到海边。
example.en: This highway stretches all the way to the coast.

example.zh: 对学生来说，买这么贵的包太奢侈了。
example.en: For a student, buying such an expensive bag is too extravagant.

gloss: to pant; to gasp for breath; to take a breather
meanings: to breathe deeply; to pant; to gasp
to take a breather; to catch one's breath

example.zh: 他一口气跑上了十楼，累得直喘气。
example.en: He ran up to the tenth floor in one go and was gasping for breath.

gloss: to publish (in a newspaper or magazine); to carry (a story)
meanings: to publish (in a newspaper or magazine)

example.zh: 她的文章刊登在今天的报纸上。
example.en: Her article appears in today's newspaper.

example.zh: 小溪里的水清得可以看见鱼。
example.en: The water in the stream is so clear you can see the fish.

example.zh: 我们要加快步伐，按时完成任务。
example.en: We need to pick up the pace to finish the task on time.

example.zh: 人生难免会遇到挫折，关键是不要放弃。
example.en: Setbacks are unavoidable in life; the key is not to give up.

example.zh: 妈妈做菜的手艺特别好。
example.en: Mum is a really skilled cook.

example.zh: 这个故事给了我很大的启示。
example.en: This story taught me a great lesson.

gloss: to be found everywhere; to spread all over

example.zh: 这家咖啡店的分店遍布全国。
example.en: This coffee chain has branches all over the country.

gloss: to neglect; to overlook; negligence; oversight

example.zh: 由于一时疏忽，他把数字写错了。
example.en: Through a moment's carelessness, he wrote the number wrong.

example.zh: 他每天都关注股市的动态。
example.en: He follows developments in the stock market every day.

gloss: to make a policy decision; decision; policy decision

example.zh: 这个决策关系到公司的未来。
example.en: This decision concerns the future of the company.

gloss: to forgive; to pardon; to spare

example.zh: 请你饶恕我这一次吧。
example.en: Please forgive me just this once.

example.zh: 这是一家全国连锁的超市。
example.en: This is a nationwide supermarket chain.

example.zh: 孩子们在海边捡了很多贝壳。
example.en: The children picked up lots of shells at the beach.

example.zh: 这则广告里有很多虚假信息。
example.en: This advertisement contains a lot of false information.

gloss: to despise; to look down on; to treat with contempt

example.zh: 他藐视规则，最后吃了大亏。
example.en: He scorned the rules and paid dearly for it in the end.

gloss: to put to good use; to display (one's talent); to give full play to

example.zh: 这份工作让他有机会施展自己的才能。
example.en: This job gives him a chance to put his talents to use.

gloss: to fall; to drop; to hang down; pendant

example.zh: 一颗流星从天空坠落下来。
example.en: A shooting star fell from the sky.

example.zh: 他把身上的零钱都给了路边的乞丐。
example.en: He gave all his loose change to the beggar by the road.

indonesian: tulus; sepenuh hati; dari lubuk hati

example.zh: 衷心感谢大家对我的帮助。
example.en: My heartfelt thanks to everyone for your help.

example.zh: 这么重要的事情，不能草率决定。
example.en: Something this important can't be decided hastily.

example.zh: 时间紧迫，我们必须马上出发。
example.en: Time is short; we must set off right away.

gloss: to boil; boiling; to seethe (with excitement)

example.zh: 听到这个好消息，全场沸腾了。
example.en: When they heard the good news, the whole place erupted.

gloss: to try every means; to do everything possible
indonesian: berusaha dengan segala cara; mencari segala jalan
meanings: to think up every possible method (idiom); to devise ways and means
to try this, that and the other

example.zh: 他想方设法帮助有困难的同学。
example.en: He does everything he can to help classmates in difficulty.

gloss: to pretend to be; to pass oneself off as; to impersonate

example.zh: 有人冒充银行工作人员打电话骗钱。
example.en: Someone posed as a bank employee and phoned people to swindle money.

example.zh: 春节吃饺子是北方的习俗。
example.en: Eating dumplings at Spring Festival is a northern custom.

gloss: to go sightseeing; to tour; sightseeing

example.zh: 每年都有很多外国游客来这里观光。
example.en: Every year many foreign tourists come here to sightsee.

example.zh: 两家公司因为合同问题发生了纠纷。
example.en: The two companies got into a dispute over the contract.

example.zh: 重要的文件一定要备份。
example.en: Important files must always be backed up.

example.zh: 学校周边有很多小吃店。
example.en: There are lots of snack shops around the school.

example.zh: 退休以后，她的生活过得很充实。
example.en: Since retiring, she has led a very full life.

gloss: reserves; to store up; to stockpile

example.zh: 我们要为将来储备足够的知识。
example.en: We need to build up enough knowledge for the future.

example.zh: 他对下属很关心，大家都很尊敬他。
example.en: He cares about his staff, and everyone respects him.

example.zh: 中国的领土面积约为九百六十万平方公里。
example.en: China's territory covers about 9.6 million square kilometres.

example.zh: 我去领事馆办理了签证。
example.en: I went to the consulate to get my visa.

gloss: to award; to issue; to promulgate

example.zh: 校长为获奖学生颁发了证书。
example.en: The principal presented certificates to the winning students.

gloss: to permeate; to seep; to infiltrate; to penetrate
meanings: (of a product, idea etc) to penetrate (in a population)

example.zh: 雨水渗透到了地下室。
example.en: Rainwater seeped into the basement.

gloss: to publicize; to propagate; to make widely known
meanings: to publicize; to advertise; to spread far and wide

example.zh: 他做了好事，却从来不到处宣扬。
example.en: He does good deeds but never broadcasts them.

example.zh: 经理让我起草一份工作计划。
example.en: The manager asked me to draft a work plan.

gloss: origin; to originate; to come from

example.zh: 你知道这个节日的起源吗？
example.en: Do you know the origin of this festival?

example.zh: 现在人人都离不开智能手机。
example.en: Nowadays nobody can do without a smartphone.

example.zh: 事情已经安排妥当，你放心吧。
example.en: Everything has been properly arranged, so don't worry.

gloss: to yearn for; to long for; to look forward to

example.zh: 我一直很向往海边的生活。
example.en: I have always longed for life by the sea.

gloss: misgiving; worry; scruple; to worry about

example.zh: 有什么顾虑你就直说吧。
example.en: If you have any concerns, just say so.

example.zh: 祝你们婚姻美满，白头到老。
example.en: Wishing you a happy marriage and a long life together.

example.zh: 这个研究项目缺少经费。
example.en: This research project is short of funding.

example.zh: 父母不要给孩子施加太大的压力。
example.en: Parents shouldn't put too much pressure on their children.

example.en: As children grow up, they should learn to make their own decisions.

example.en: This novel sold extremely well as soon as it came out.

example.en: The scenery here is like a beautiful painting.

example.en: Some sellers advertise like crazy, but their products are actually mediocre.

example.zh: 墙上挂着一幅爷爷的肖像。
example.en: A portrait of Grandpa hangs on the wall.

example.en: Sunlight shines over the whole campus, and everyone is in a good mood.

example.en: Every month he puts part of his salary into savings.

example.en: The city is building a new subway line.

example.en: An eagle circled above the mountaintop for a long time.

example.en: Unwilling to live an ordinary life, he decided to go out and try his luck.

example.en: She set the vase on the table with great care.

example.en: The food Mum makes is very tasty.

example.en: She has always quietly supported her husband's career.

example.en: The subject of this film comes from a true story.

example.en: Even if you can't finish it, don't waste food.

example.zh: 大家都陶醉在美妙的音乐中。
example.en: Everyone was enchanted by the beautiful music.

gloss: to give as a present; to present

example.zh: 商店向每位顾客赠送一份小礼品。
example.en: The shop gives every customer a small gift.

example.en: In summer we often go to the seaside on holiday.

example.en: The puppy came running over with a slipper in its mouth.

example.en: Every student who takes part in the contest gets a souvenir.

gloss: to bake; to dry or warm by a fire

meanings: by chance; as chance would have it

gloss: to found; to establish; to create

example.en: He founded this company twenty years ago.

example.en: Hearing the good news, she couldn't help laughing.

example.en: These achievements are the result of everyone's hard work.

gloss: to pedal; to press down with the foot; to step on

example.zh: 他用力蹬着自行车，很快就到了学校。
example.en: He pedalled hard and soon reached the school.

example.zh: 这座大楼看起来很有气势。
example.en: This building looks very imposing.

meanings: to call on (sb to do sth)

example.zh: 专家呼吁大家少用塑料袋。
example.en: Experts are calling on everyone to use fewer plastic bags.

example.zh: 他的回答很含糊，让人听不明白。
example.en: His answer was vague and hard to understand.

example.zh: 他是个君子，从来不说别人的坏话。
example.en: He's a gentleman who never speaks ill of others.

gloss: reverse side; back; opposite; negative side
meanings: the other side (of a problem etc)

example.zh: 请把答案写在试卷的反面。
example.en: Please write your answers on the back of the test paper.

example.zh: 她因卓越的研究成果获得了大奖。
example.en: She won a major award for her outstanding research.

gloss: to serve as; to act as; to play the role of

example.zh: 在这次会议上，他充当翻译。
example.en: At this meeting he acted as interpreter.

gloss: to be worthy of; to deserve to be called

example.zh: 他不愧是全国有名的厨师，做的菜真好吃。
example.en: He truly deserves his fame as a top chef; his food is delicious.

gloss: to comprehend; to grasp; to realise

example.zh: 经过老师的讲解，他终于领悟了其中的道理。
example.en: After the teacher's explanation, he finally grasped the principle.

gloss: to satisfy a craving; to enjoy oneself to the full; satisfying
meanings: to get a kick out of sth

example.zh: 这场球赛看得真过瘾！
example.en: That match was so satisfying to watch!

example.zh: 年轻就是你最大的资本。
example.en: Being young is your greatest asset.

gloss: to screen; to select; to filter

example.zh: 公司从一百多份简历中筛选出十个人参加面试。
example.en: From over a hundred CVs the company shortlisted ten people for interviews.

example.zh: 他穿上西装显得很潇洒。
example.en: He looks very dashing in a suit.

gloss: to put; to place; to put aside

example.zh: 你把行李先搁在门口吧。
example.en: Just put your luggage by the door for now.

example.en: She specialises in contemporary Chinese literature.

example.en: This kind of stone is very hard and difficult to cut.

example.zh: 这种植物的生长周期大约是三个月。
example.en: This plant's growth cycle is about three months.

meanings: to work with a common purpose (idiom); to make concerted efforts

example.zh: 只要大家齐心协力，就一定能按时完成任务。

example.zh: 这位医生的医术十分高超。
example.en: This doctor's medical skill is superb.

gloss: to surge; to run high; upsurge

example.zh: 比赛快开始了，观众的情绪越来越高涨。
example.en: As the match was about to begin, the crowd grew more and more excited.

example.zh: 她以顽强的毅力战胜了疾病。
example.en: She beat the illness with tenacious willpower.

gloss: to meet; to come across; every time (on)
meanings: (of a calendar event) to come along
(of an event) to fall on (a particular day)

example.zh: 每逢春节，我们全家都会聚在一起。
example.en: Every Spring Festival our whole family gets together.

example.zh: 他是一位资深记者，采访过很多名人。
example.en: He is a veteran journalist who has interviewed many celebrities.

example.zh: 我经常在网上论坛和别人交流学习经验。
example.en: I often share study tips with others on online forums.

example.en: This company puts great emphasis on employees' overall quality.

example.zh: 有了文凭不等于有了能力。

meanings: to place (one's hope, energy etc) in
a thing in which you invest (your hope, energy etc)

example.en: His parents placed all their hopes on him.

example.zh: 我们要透过现象看实质。
example.en: We must look past the appearance to the essence.

example.zh: 奶奶坐在窗边，脸上带着安详的微笑。

gloss: third (in a series); C (grade); third of the ten Heavenly Stems
indonesian: ketiga (dalam urutan); C (nilai); batang langit ketiga

example.en: He only got a C on this exam and felt very upset.

gloss: to take office; to assume a post

example.zh: 新经理上任以后，做了很多改革。

example.zh: 专家可以鉴别这幅画是不是真的。

example.en: He solemnly apologised to everyone.

meanings: to use anywhere, anytime (card, ticket etc)
to be used by everyone (language, textbook etc)

example.en: The manager adopted my suggestion.

example.zh: 这座城市的人口密度非常高。
example.en: This city has a very high population density.

meanings: the "human way", one of the stages in the cycle of reincarnation (Buddhism)

example.zh: 这样对待动物太不人道了。
example.en: Treating animals like this is really inhumane.

gloss: to understand; to grasp; to comprehend

example.en: I didn't fully understand what the teacher meant.

example.en: A gust of wind blew, and the ground was covered with petals.

gloss: to infer; to deduce; inference; conclusion

example.en: From these data we can draw an inference.

example.en: Never be careless in an exam; check carefully.

example.en: This book is the essence of the author's years of research.

gloss: to spend; to pay out; expenditure; expenses

example.en: Roads are slippery on rainy days, so watch your step.

example.zh: 保护生态环境是每个人的责任。
example.en: Protecting the ecological environment is everyone's responsibility.

example.en: I said hello to him, but he ignored me.

example.zh: 学生们在课上观察了昆虫标本。
example.en: The students examined insect specimens in class.

example.zh: 这家饭馆的菜分量很足。
example.en: The portions at this restaurant are generous.

gloss: to gaze at; to stare at

example.zh: 她凝视着窗外的大海，一句话也不说。
example.en: She gazed at the sea outside the window without saying a word.

example.en: This shop has a good reputation, so customers feel confident.

example.zh: 黄昏时，很多老人在公园里散步。
example.en: At dusk many elderly people stroll in the park.

gloss: to consult; to ask for advice

example.zh: 遇到不懂的问题，你可以向老师请教。
example.en: When you meet a problem you don't understand, you can ask the teacher.

example.zh: 学生不能私自离开学校。
example.en: Students may not leave the school without permission.

gloss: to lose heart; to be discouraged; disappointing

example.zh: 失败一次没关系，千万别泄气。

example.zh: 他把父母留下的钱都挥霍光了。

example.en: When the river rose, the crops along the bank were ruined.

gloss: to leave behind; to hand down; left over

example.zh: 这些都是历史遗留下来的问题。
example.en: These are all problems left over from history.

gloss: to restore (to original state); to recreate; to reduce (chemistry)
indonesian: mengembalikan ke keadaan semula; memulihkan; reduksi (kimia)
meanings: to restore to the original state

example.zh: 这部电影真实地还原了当时的生活。
example.en: This film faithfully recreates life at that time.

example.en: Maths is my weakest subject.

example.zh: 这台精密仪器价格非常昂贵。
example.en: This precision instrument is very expensive.

example.zh: 学习语言要打下牢固的基础。
example.en: When learning a language, you need to lay a solid foundation.

example.zh: 孩子们看杂技表演看得入了迷。
example.en: The children were spellbound by the acrobatics show.

example.zh: 做决定的时候要考虑全局。
example.en: When making decisions, consider the big picture.

meanings: (in modern fiction) fairy, elf, leprechaun etc

example.zh: 他退休后过着神仙一样的生活。

meanings: to collapse; to disintegrate; to crumble

example.zh: 由于内部矛盾，这个团队很快就瓦解了。
example.en: Because of internal conflicts, the team soon fell apart.

gloss: to dry in the air or sun; to ignore (someone)

example.zh: 天气好的时候，她喜欢把被子拿出去晾一晾。
example.en: When the weather is good, she likes to air the quilts outside.

example.zh: 采用新方法以后，效果十分显著。
example.en: After adopting the new method, the results were remarkable.

meanings: to promote to a higher job

example.zh: 他工作能力强，很快就被提拔为主管。
example.en: He is very capable and was soon promoted to supervisor.

example.zh: 小王是经理最得力的助手。
example.en: Xiao Wang is the manager's most capable assistant.

example.zh: 长期熬夜会削弱身体的抵抗力。
example.en: Staying up late for long periods weakens the body's resistance.

meanings: Lantern Festival, the final event of the Spring Festival 春节, on 15th of first month of the lunar calendar

example.zh: 元宵节的时候，我们一家人一起吃汤圆。
example.en: At the Lantern Festival our family eats sweet dumplings together.

gloss: so that; with the result that (usually bad)
meanings: to such an extent as to

example.zh: 他平时不努力，以致考试没有通过。
example.en: He didn't work hard normally, so he failed the exam.

example.zh: 这次火灾是人为造成的。
example.en: This fire was caused by people.

gloss: once; for a time; at one time

example.zh: 他一度想放弃学习汉语。
example.en: At one point he wanted to give up learning Chinese.

example.zh: 我收到了朋友婚礼的请柬。
example.en: I received an invitation to my friend's wedding.

gloss: to lay off staff; to cut jobs; layoffs

example.zh: 由于经营困难，公司决定裁员。
example.en: Because of business difficulties, the company decided to cut staff.

example.zh: 这本词典是几代学者心血的结晶。
example.en: This dictionary is the fruit of several generations of scholars' work.

example.zh: 春节期间，很多城市限制燃放烟花爆竹。
example.en: During Spring Festival, many cities restrict setting off fireworks and firecrackers.

example.zh: 海上起风了，波浪越来越大。
example.en: The wind picked up at sea and the waves grew bigger and bigger.

example.zh: 这次捐款的数额超过了一百万元。
example.en: The amount donated this time exceeded one million yuan.

example.zh: 他为自己当年的错误感到悔恨。
example.en: He feels deep remorse for his mistakes back then.

example.zh: 记者提出了一个很尖锐的问题。
example.en: The reporter asked a very pointed question.

example.zh: 图中这两条直线互相垂直。
example.en: The two straight lines in the diagram are perpendicular to each other.

gloss: to take leave; to say goodbye

example.zh: 时间不早了，我该告辞了。
example.en: It's getting late; I should take my leave.

example.zh: 他靠写作获得了一笔可观的收入。
example.en: He earns a considerable income from writing.

example.zh: 这家超市的商品种类非常齐全。
example.en: This supermarket has a complete range of goods.

example.zh: 这个城市以生产陶瓷闻名。
example.en: This city is famous for making ceramics.

example.zh: 请接受我们最诚挚的感谢。
example.en: Please accept our most sincere thanks.

example.zh: 第一次上台演讲时，他有些胆怯。
example.en: The first time he gave a speech on stage, he felt a little timid.

gloss: rather; a bit too; truly (expresses mild criticism)

example.zh: 你这样说未免太过分了。
example.en: Saying that is rather going too far.

example.zh: 指南针是中国古代的四大发明之一。
example.en: The compass is one of ancient China's four great inventions.

example.zh: 这些鸟在大树上筑了巢穴。
example.en: These birds built nests in the big tree.

example.zh: 明天局部地区有小雨。
example.en: Tomorrow there will be light rain in some areas.

example.zh: 做数学题要先记住这些公式。
example.en: To do maths problems you first need to memorise these formulas.

gloss: to carve; to engrave; carving; sculpture

example.zh: 这块木头上雕刻着精美的花纹。
example.en: Fine patterns are carved into this piece of wood.

example.zh: 这本书描写了社会各个阶层的生活。
example.en: This book depicts the lives of every social class.

example.zh: 新员工要先熟悉公司的规章制度。
example.en: New employees first need to get familiar with company rules and regulations.

example.zh: 那座老房子的木门已经腐朽了。
example.en: The wooden door of that old house has rotted.

example.zh: 你知道这个节日的来历吗？
example.en: Do you know the origin of this festival?

gloss: to rub (with the hands); to roll between the hands
meanings: to rub or roll between the hands or fingers

example.zh: 天太冷了，他不停地搓手。
example.en: It was so cold that he kept rubbing his hands.

meanings: suspense in a movie, play etc

example.zh: 这部小说充满悬念，让人一口气读完。
example.en: This novel is full of suspense; you read it in one sitting.

example.zh: 山上有一座有几百年历史的寺庙。
example.en: On the mountain there is a temple several hundred years old.

indonesian: diakui secara umum; diakui semua orang

example.zh: 他是大家公认的最好的老师。
example.en: He is generally recognised as the best teacher.

gloss: to obstruct; to thwart; to stand in the way

example.zh: 父母一开始阻挠他们结婚，后来才同意。
example.en: At first their parents stood in the way of their marriage, but later agreed.

gloss: interval; gap; to be separated by
meanings: to leave a gap of (two weeks, three meters etc)

example.zh: 两次服药之间要间隔四个小时。
example.en: There should be an interval of four hours between doses.

example.zh: 公司每个月给员工发交通补贴。
example.en: The company gives employees a monthly transport allowance.

example.zh: 生活是艺术创作的源泉。
example.en: Life is the source of artistic creation.

gloss: in short; in a word; all in all

example.zh: 总而言之，这次旅行非常愉快。
example.en: All in all, the trip was very enjoyable.

gloss: to warn; to admonish; to exhort

example.zh: 父亲告诫我做人一定要诚实。
example.en: My father warned me always to be honest.

indonesian: makna yang terkandung; isi; kedalaman batin

example.zh: 这首诗的内涵很丰富。
example.en: This poem is rich in meaning.

gloss: to negotiate; to take up a matter with

example.zh: 经过多次交涉，对方终于同意退款。
example.en: After repeated negotiation, the other side finally agreed to a refund.

gloss: research topic; project; problem to solve

example.zh: 他正在研究一个关于环境保护的课题。
example.en: He is working on a research project on environmental protection.

gloss: to be reluctant to leave; to miss; to yearn for
meanings: to hate to have to go

example.zh: 毕业时，大家都很留恋校园生活。
example.en: At graduation everyone was reluctant to leave campus life behind.

example.zh: 农民每天早上都要喂牲畜。
example.en: Farmers have to feed the livestock every morning.

gloss: to eat hot pot (dipping food in boiling broth)
indonesian: makan hotpot; mencelup makanan ke kuah hotpot

example.zh: 冬天和朋友一起涮火锅特别舒服。
example.en: Having hot pot with friends in winter is especially cosy.

example.zh: 会议的气氛很沉闷，没人愿意发言。
example.en: The atmosphere at the meeting was dull, and no one wanted to speak.

gloss: to distort; to misrepresent; to twist

example.zh: 这篇报道歪曲了事实。
example.en: This report distorts the facts.

meanings: slow to take effect (e.g. a slow poison)

example.zh: 长期抽烟容易引起慢性病。
example.en: Long-term smoking can easily cause chronic illness.

gloss: to maintain; to keep in good repair; to take care of (health)
meanings: to take good care of (or conserve) one's health

example.zh: 汽车要定期保养才能用得久。
example.en: A car needs regular maintenance to last.

meanings: to bring parties to an agreement

example.zh: 经过朋友的调解，两人终于和好了。
example.en: Through a friend's mediation, the two finally made up.

example.zh: 人老了以后，记忆力会逐渐衰退。
example.en: As people age, their memory gradually declines.

example.zh: 这部电影的立体效果非常好。
example.en: This film's 3D effects are very good.

example.zh: 大家纷纷为灾区捐赠物资。
example.en: Everyone donated supplies to the disaster area.

gloss: to ponder; to be lost in thought; contemplation

example.zh: 他坐在窗前，陷入了沉思。
example.en: He sat by the window, lost in thought.

example.zh: 这家酒店的档次很高，价格也贵。
example.en: This hotel is very upmarket, and the prices are high too.

gloss: to be eager to; to wish earnestly; can't wait to
indonesian: sangat berharap; ingin sekali; tidak sabar

example.zh: 孩子们巴不得早点放暑假。
example.en: The children can't wait for the summer holidays to start.

gloss: to give up halfway; to leave unfinished
indonesian: berhenti di tengah jalan; menyerah setengah jalan
meanings: to give up halfway (idiom); leave sth unfinished

example.zh: 学习要坚持下去，不能半途而废。
example.en: You must keep studying and not give up halfway.

gloss: to brew; to ferment; to mull over; to prepare

example.zh: 这个计划已经酝酿了很长时间。
example.en: This plan has been in the making for a long time.

example.zh: 中国的航天事业发展得很快。
example.en: China's space industry is developing rapidly.

example.zh: 这件事引起了社会舆论的广泛关注。
example.en: This matter attracted wide public attention.

example.zh: 用完水请记得关好水龙头。
example.en: Please remember to turn off the tap after using water.

gloss: measure word for plants and trees; plant
indonesian: kata satuan untuk tanaman dan pohon; batang

example.zh: 院子里种了几株桃树。
example.en: Several peach trees are planted in the yard.

meanings: to correspond (to); to be equivalent to; to be a counterpart to

example.zh: 每个汉字都对应一个音节。
example.en: Each Chinese character corresponds to one syllable.

gloss: to go bad; to deteriorate; to spoil
meanings: (of food) to go bad; to go off

example.zh: 天气太热，牛奶很容易变质。
example.en: When it's very hot, milk goes bad easily.

example.zh: 老板不应该剥削员工的劳动。
example.en: Bosses shouldn't exploit their employees' labour.

example.zh: 双方希望通过谈判解决争端。
example.en: Both sides hope to settle the dispute through negotiation.

gloss: mainstream; main trend; main current (of a river)

example.zh: 网上购物已经成为消费的主流。
example.en: Online shopping has become the mainstream of consumption.

indonesian: di depan; di dekat; di sisi
meanings: (of children, parents etc) at one's side

example.zh: 孩子们都围在奶奶跟前听她讲故事。
example.en: The children gathered around Grandma to hear her stories.

meanings: to plant false evidence against sb

example.zh: 他被人诬陷偷了东西，心里很委屈。
example.en: He was falsely accused of stealing and felt badly wronged.

gloss: to weave; to knit; to braid
meanings: to weave; to knit; to plait; to braid
(fig.) to create (sth abstract, e.g. a dream, a lie etc)

example.zh: 奶奶正在给我编织一件毛衣。
example.en: Grandma is knitting a sweater for me.

example.zh: 他们用力划着桨，小船很快就到了对岸。
example.en: They rowed hard, and the little boat soon reached the other shore.

gloss: to make trouble for no reason; to be deliberately provocative
indonesian: membuat onar tanpa alasan; rewel tanpa alasan
meanings: to make trouble without reason (idiom); to be deliberately provocative

example.zh: 你别无理取闹了，大家都在等你。
example.en: Stop making a fuss for no reason; everyone is waiting for you.

gloss: to be stunned; to be dumbfounded; rash

example.zh: 听到这个消息，他一下子愣住了。
example.en: Hearing the news, he was stunned.

example.zh: 吃饭时要细细咀嚼，有利于消化。
example.en: Chew carefully when eating; it helps digestion.

gloss: to stop; to obstruct; to bar the way

example.zh: 他想走，可是朋友们把他阻拦住了。
example.en: He wanted to leave, but his friends stopped him.

example.zh: 这本书写得很有趣味，孩子们都爱看。
example.en: This book is written in a fun way; the children all love it.

example.zh: 他大学学的是考古专业。
example.en: He studied archaeology at university.

gloss: to go through the motions; to do perfunctorily; to fob off
meanings: to do sth half-heartedly or just for show

example.zh: 对待工作要认真，不能敷衍。
example.en: You should take work seriously, not just go through the motions.

gloss: to tie up; to bind; to bundle

example.zh: 他用绳子把这些旧书捆绑在一起。
example.en: He tied the old books together with string.

gloss: to claim reimbursement; to be reimbursed; to write off

example.zh: 出差的车费可以回公司报销。
example.en: Fares for business trips can be reimbursed by the company.

example.zh: 报名将于本月三十号截止。
example.en: Registration closes on the 30th of this month.

gloss: to fill the air; to permeate; to spread everywhere
meanings: to saturate (the air with fog, smoke etc)

example.zh: 厨房里弥漫着饭菜的香味。
example.en: The smell of food filled the kitchen.

example.zh: 这个行业有着广阔的发展前景。
example.en: This industry has broad prospects for development.

example.zh: 不能只凭容貌去判断一个人。
example.en: You can't judge a person by looks alone.

gloss: to hold; to accommodate; to have capacity for; to tolerate

example.zh: 这个体育馆可以容纳五万名观众。
example.en: This stadium can hold fifty thousand spectators.

example.zh: 现在很多家庭都用天然气做饭。
example.en: Many households now cook with natural gas.

meanings: to rent; to lease; to hire

example.zh: 这家公司专门提供汽车租赁服务。
example.en: This company specialises in car rental services.

example.zh: 考虑到他的特殊情况，学校破例让他补考。
example.en: Given his special circumstances, the school made an exception and let him resit the exam.

example.zh: 春天来了，到处都充满了生机。
example.en: Spring has come, and everything is full of life.

gloss: worthy of the name; living up to its name
meanings: not just in name only, but also in reality (idiom)

example.zh: 他是一位名副其实的好医生。
example.en: He is a good doctor in every sense of the word.

gloss: to teach; to pass on (knowledge, skills); to impart
meanings: to impart; to pass on; to teach

example.zh: 老师傅把手艺传授给了年轻人。
example.en: The old master passed his craft on to the young people.

meanings: to talk about (whatever comes to mind)

example.zh: 别在背后说别人的闲话。
example.en: Don't gossip about people behind their backs.

example.zh: 请把申请表连同照片一起交上来。
example.en: Please hand in the application form together with your photo.

example.zh: 这家店的北京烤鸭味道很正宗。
example.en: The Peking duck at this place tastes very authentic.

gloss: ill at ease; constrained; to restrict

example.zh: 来我家就像在自己家一样，别拘束。
example.en: Make yourself at home here; don't feel awkward.

meanings: to restrict sth within set boundaries

example.zh: 我们的眼光不能只局限于眼前的利益。
example.en: Our view shouldn't be limited to immediate gains.

example.zh: 政府采取了很多措施帮助大学生就业。
example.en: The government has taken many measures to help graduates find jobs.

example.zh: 我们公司的宗旨是顾客第一。
example.en: Our company's guiding principle is "customer first".

gloss: to respond to; to answer (a call)

example.zh: 同学们积极响应学校的号召，参加了植树活动。
example.en: The students responded actively to the school's call and joined the tree planting.

example.zh: 他们一家人相处得非常和睦。
example.en: Their family gets along very harmoniously.

example.zh: 他是这次奖项的候选人之一，最后获了奖。
example.en: He was one of the candidates for the award and won in the end.

gloss: upper reaches (of a river); advanced position

example.zh: 这座城市位于长江上游。
example.en: This city lies on the upper reaches of the Yangtze River.

example.zh: 学习汉字也有一些窍门。
example.en: There are some tricks to learning Chinese characters too.

example.zh: 今天天气晴朗，适合出去爬山。
example.en: It's sunny today, good for going hiking.

example.zh: 他是一个很有抱负的年轻人。
example.en: He is a young man of great ambition.

example.zh: 她性格开朗，大家都喜欢和她交朋友。
example.en: She is cheerful, and everyone likes being friends with her.

example.zh: 年轻人工作起来干劲十足。
example.en: Young people work with tremendous drive.

example.zh: 每天刷牙有助于保持口腔健康。
example.en: Brushing your teeth every day helps keep your mouth healthy.

gloss: to solidify; to congeal; to set

example.zh: 水在零度以下会凝固成冰。
example.en: Water freezes into ice below zero degrees.

example.zh: 读课文时要注意句子之间的停顿。
example.en: When reading texts aloud, mind the pauses between sentences.

example.zh: 他专程从上海赶来参加我的婚礼。
example.en: He made a special trip from Shanghai to attend my wedding.

example.zh: 这个官员因为贪污被撤职了。
example.en: This official was dismissed for embezzlement.

gloss: to wind; to twine; to entangle

example.zh: 墙上缠绕着绿色的藤。
example.en: Green vines are winding around the wall.

example.zh: 有这么孝顺的孩子，真是您的福气。
example.en: It's truly your good fortune to have such dutiful children.

example.zh: 糖很容易在热水里溶解。
example.en: Sugar dissolves easily in hot water.

gloss: to correct; to make a correction; correction

example.zh: 报纸第二天就更正了这个错误。
example.en: The newspaper corrected the error the next day.

gloss: increasingly; day by day; more and more
meanings: more and more with each passing day

example.zh: 人们的生活水平日益提高。
example.en: People's living standards are rising day by day.

example.zh: 我最近在读一本名人传记。
example.en: Recently I've been reading a celebrity biography.

gloss: to ease; to relieve; to alleviate; mild

example.zh: 他讲了个笑话，紧张的气氛缓和了下来。
example.en: He told a joke, and the tense atmosphere eased.

example.zh: 他才三十岁，头就有点秃了。
example.en: He's only thirty but already going a bit bald.

example.zh: 这家公司去年盈利两千万元。
example.en: The company made a profit of twenty million yuan last year.

example.zh: 这座建筑的设计左右对称，非常美观。
example.en: The building is symmetrical left and right and very attractive.

example.zh: 他看着成绩单，忍不住叹气。
example.en: Looking at his report card, he couldn't help sighing.

gloss: within one's power; to the best of one's ability
meanings: as far as one's capabilities extend (idiom); to the best of one's ability

example.zh: 孩子应该做一些力所能及的家务。
example.en: Children should do housework that is within their ability.

example.zh: 面对记者的提问，他显得十分从容。
example.en: Facing the reporters' questions, he appeared very calm.

gloss: dictatorship; autocratic; to rule as a dictator

example.zh: 他在家里很独裁，什么事都要自己决定。
example.en: He's a real dictator at home; he decides everything himself.

example.zh: 遇到紧急情况一定要沉着冷静。
example.en: In an emergency you must stay calm and composed.

example.zh: 他对这件事的态度很暧昧。
example.en: His attitude towards this matter is very ambiguous.

gloss: to feel regret (for another); to sympathise; to pity
meanings: to feel that it is a great pity

example.zh: 他没能参加决赛，大家都很惋惜。
example.en: Everyone felt it was a pity he couldn't take part in the final.

meanings: to extract (ore or other resource from a mine)

example.zh: 这里正在开采一座大型煤矿。
example.en: A large coal mine is being worked here.

example.zh: 这里地理位置优越，交通十分方便。
example.en: The location here is excellent and transport is very convenient.

example.zh: 这幅画的颜色非常鲜明。
example.en: The colours of this painting are very bright.

example.zh: 他说话很有条理，大家一听就懂。
example.en: He speaks in a very orderly way; everyone understands at once.

example.zh: 她举止文雅，说话也很温和。
example.en: She has refined manners and speaks gently.

gloss: to shield; to cover up for; to harbour

example.zh: 父母不应该包庇孩子的错误。
example.en: Parents shouldn't cover up their children's mistakes.

example.zh: 这张圆桌的直径是两米。
example.en: This round table is two metres in diameter.

example.zh: 这条胡同很狭窄，汽车开不进去。
example.en: This alley is too narrow for cars to get in.

gloss: moist; to moisten; to nourish; comfortable (life)

example.zh: 这种面霜可以滋润皮肤。
example.en: This face cream moisturises the skin.

example.zh: 这条街已经没有了昔日的热闹。
example.en: This street has lost the bustle of former days.

example.zh: 经过一年的努力，我们的工作取得了明显的成效。
example.en: After a year's effort, our work has produced clear results.

example.zh: 这款手机性能好，价格也不贵。
example.en: This phone performs well and isn't expensive.

gloss: totally willing; gladly; of one's own free will
indonesian: dengan rela hati; dengan senang hati

example.zh: 为了孩子，她心甘情愿做任何事情。
example.en: For her child, she would gladly do anything.

example.zh: 他很有钱，但是非常吝啬。
example.en: He's very rich but extremely stingy.

example.zh: 时间、地点和人物是记叙文的基本要素。
example.en: Time, place and characters are the basic elements of a narrative.

example.zh: 我很怀念小时候无忧无虑的日子。
example.en: I really miss the carefree days of my childhood.

gloss: to struggle; to fight hard; to go all out

example.zh: 为了实现梦想，他一直在努力拼搏。
example.en: He has been fighting hard to make his dream come true.

example.zh: 参加面试时要穿得庄重一点。
example.en: Dress a bit more formally for a job interview.

example.zh: 这座宫殿看起来非常宏伟。
example.en: This palace looks truly magnificent.

gloss: to be pregnant with; to breed; to nurture; to give birth to
meanings: to nurture (a development, school of thought, artwork etc)

example.zh: 黄河孕育了古老的中华文明。
example.en: The Yellow River gave birth to ancient Chinese civilisation.

gloss: to rush about; to be busy running around
meanings: to be constantly on the move

example.zh: 为了生活，他每天都在外面奔波。
example.en: To make a living, he's out rushing around every day.

example.zh: 他做事向来很认真，从不马虎。
example.en: He has always been conscientious in his work and is never sloppy.

gloss: to have the courage to; to dare to

example.zh: 我们要勇于承认自己的错误。
example.en: We should have the courage to admit our mistakes.

example.zh: 祝你在新的工作中一帆风顺！
example.en: I wish you smooth sailing in your new job!

example.zh: 这些设备已经很陈旧了，需要更换。
example.en: This equipment is very outdated and needs replacing.

indonesian: luas tak bertepi; tak terhingga; samar-samar

example.zh: 一条小船在茫茫大海上漂着。
example.en: A small boat drifted on the boundless sea.

example.zh: 妈妈在枕头上绣了一朵花。
example.en: Mum embroidered a flower on the pillow.

example.zh: 她做事非常细致，从来不出错。
example.en: She works very meticulously and never makes mistakes.

example.zh: 春天的田野一片绿色，美极了。
example.en: The fields in spring are a sea of green, extremely beautiful.

gloss: to devastate; to wreck; to ruin (health etc.)

example.zh: 长期熬夜严重摧残了他的身体。
example.en: Staying up late for years has seriously wrecked his health.

example.zh: 出国前要注意哪些事项？
example.en: What matters should you pay attention to before going abroad?

example.zh: 这台电脑的运算速度非常快。
example.en: This computer's calculating speed is very fast.

example.zh: 他整天发牢骚，说工作太累。
example.en: He grumbles all day that work is too tiring.

meanings: fig. to forge ahead in the face of hardships and danger

example.zh: 他们花了两天时间攀登上了山顶。
example.en: It took them two days to climb to the summit.

example.zh: 他每个周末都去看望岳母。
example.en: He visits his mother-in-law every weekend.

gloss: to mobilise; to arouse; to persuade

example.zh: 老师动员大家参加学校的运动会。
example.en: The teacher encouraged everyone to take part in the school sports meet.

gloss: to condense; to gather; to embody; cohesion

example.zh: 这本书凝聚了他一生的心血。
example.en: This book embodies his whole life's effort.

example.zh: 饮食要有节制，不能想吃多少就吃多少。
example.en: Eat in moderation; don't eat as much as you like.

example.zh: 打开窗户让空气流通一下。
example.en: Open the windows to let the air circulate.

example.zh: 请大家按次序排队进场。
example.en: Please queue in order to enter.

example.zh: 我们要用批判的眼光看待网上的信息。
example.en: We should view online information with a critical eye.

example.zh: 他性格急躁，遇到事情容易发火。
example.en: He has an impatient temper and flares up easily.

example.zh: 他思索了很久，才回答这个问题。
example.en: He thought it over for a long time before answering.

example.zh: 这家公司专门研究尖端科技。
example.en: This company specialises in cutting-edge technology.

example.zh: 我们站在海边看夕阳慢慢落下。
example.en: We stood by the sea watching the sun slowly set.

meanings: Fuxing district of Handan city 邯郸市, Hebei
Fuxing or Fuhsing township in Taoyuan county 桃园县, north Taiwan

example.zh: 这个古镇正在努力复兴传统手工艺。
example.en: This old town is working to revive traditional crafts.

example.zh: 这台电脑体积小，携带方便。
example.en: This computer is small and easy to carry.

example.zh: 他虽然很有成就，但是为人很谦逊。
example.en: Although very accomplished, he is very modest.

example.zh: 今年公司的资金还有很大的缺口。
example.en: There's still a big funding shortfall at the company this year.

example.zh: 冰箱里有现成的饭菜，热一下就能吃。
example.en: There's ready-made food in the fridge; just heat it up.

gloss: to lead; to head; to command

example.zh: 校长率领代表团出国访问。
example.en: The principal led a delegation abroad on a visit.

example.zh: 他说这些话，无非是想让你高兴。
example.en: He said those things simply to make you happy.

example.zh: 这次项目让他充分展示了自己的才干。
example.en: This project allowed him to fully show his abilities.

example.zh: 教育可以帮助人们摆脱愚昧。
example.en: Education can help people escape ignorance.

example.zh: 新年到了，我们一起展望美好的未来。
example.en: The New Year has come; let's look ahead to a bright future together.

example.zh: 这片森林是城市的天然屏障。
example.en: This forest is a natural barrier for the city.

example.zh: 我嫂子做的菜特别好吃。
example.en: The food my sister-in-law cooks is especially delicious.

example.zh: 他的伤口发炎了，得马上去医院。
example.en: His wound got inflamed; he has to go to hospital right away.

example.zh: 她看着乐谱，认真地弹起了钢琴。
example.en: Reading the sheet music, she played the piano carefully.

example.zh: 他迟疑了一下，最后还是答应了。
example.en: He hesitated a moment but agreed in the end.

example.zh: 每年秋天，很多鸟都会向南方迁徙。
example.en: Every autumn many birds migrate south.

example.zh: 面对这么多选择，他感到一片茫然。
example.en: Faced with so many choices, he felt completely at a loss.

gloss: to talk on and on; to pour out words endlessly

example.zh: 一谈起足球，他就滔滔不绝。
example.en: Once he starts on football, he talks on and on.

example.zh: 这条山路又窄又曲折，很难走。
example.en: This mountain path is narrow and winding, and hard to walk.

gloss: to alarm; to disturb; to startle

example.zh: 他轻轻地走进房间，怕惊动熟睡的孩子。
example.en: He walked softly into the room, afraid of disturbing the sleeping child.

gloss: to compress; to reduce; to cut down

example.zh: 我们要压缩开支，节约用钱。
example.en: We need to cut spending and save money.

example.zh: 越来越多的人环保意识开始觉醒。
example.en: More and more people are waking up to environmental awareness.

gloss: to ask for; to demand; to request

example.zh: 你可以向工作人员索取免费的地图。
example.en: You can ask the staff for a free map.

gloss: to signal; to gesture; to hint

example.zh: 老师示意我们安静下来。
example.en: The teacher signalled for us to be quiet.

example.zh: 父亲对我的爱是深沉的。
example.en: My father's love for me runs deep.

example.zh: 下课后要及时复习，巩固学过的知识。
example.en: Review promptly after class to consolidate what you've learned.

gloss: to expound; to set forth; to elaborate

example.zh: 他在论文中详细阐述了自己的观点。
example.en: He set out his views in detail in his paper.

example.zh: 这里的气候很适宜种茶。
example.en: The climate here is well suited to growing tea.

gloss: to concern oneself with; to take an interest in; to get involved

example.zh: 这是我的私事，请你不要过问。
example.en: This is my private business; please don't get involved.

gloss: to ruin; to corrupt; to undermine; corrupt

example.zh: 这种行为会败坏学校的名声。
example.en: This kind of behaviour will ruin the school's reputation.

example.zh: 他亲自把请帖送到了每位客人手中。
example.en: He personally delivered the invitation to every guest.

gloss: to consume; to expend; to waste

example.zh: 这项工作耗费了我们大量的时间。
example.en: This work consumed a great deal of our time.

gloss: to flood; to overflow; to spread unchecked

example.zh: 网上的虚假信息泛滥，要学会辨别。
example.en: False information is rampant online; you need to learn to tell it apart.

meanings: the first Chinese dialect dictionary, edited by Yang Xiong 扬雄 in 1st century, containing over 9000 characters

example.zh: 我听不懂这个地方的方言。
example.en: I can't understand the local dialect here.

gloss: to cultivate; to breed; to nurture

example.zh: 科学家培育出了一种新的水稻品种。
example.en: Scientists have bred a new variety of rice.

gloss: to stagnate; to be at a standstill

example.zh: 由于缺少资金，这个项目停滞不前。
example.en: Due to a lack of funds, the project has stalled.

example.zh: 加油站附近严禁吸烟。
example.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited near petrol stations.

indonesian: titik balik; perubahan arah; berbalik arah
meanings: shift in the trend of events

example.zh: 这次比赛是他人生的一个重要转折。
example.en: This competition was an important turning point in his life.

gloss: to commend; to honour; to cite

example.zh: 学校表彰了一批优秀教师。
example.en: The school honoured a group of outstanding teachers.

example.zh: 公司计划在若干年内开设十家分店。
example.en: The company plans to open ten branches within a number of years.

gloss: to hold back; to contain; to tie down

example.zh: 他总觉得工作受到很多方面的牵制。
example.en: He always feels his work is held back by many factors.

example.zh: 孩子还没回家，妈妈焦急地等着。
example.en: The child wasn't home yet, and Mum waited anxiously.

example.zh: 夏天这里非常炎热，最高温度超过四十度。
example.en: Summers here are scorching, with highs over forty degrees.

gloss: to weigh (up); to balance (pros and cons)

example.zh: 他权衡了利弊，最后决定换工作。
example.en: After weighing the pros and cons, he decided to change jobs.

example.zh: 床边有一个插座，可以给手机充电。
example.en: There's a socket by the bed for charging your phone.

gloss: to size up; to look someone up and down; to reckon
indonesian: memperhatikan dari atas sampai bawah; mengamati; mengira
meanings: to look sb up and down

example.zh: 她上下打量着这位新来的同事。
example.en: She looked the new colleague up and down.

gloss: to socialise; to entertain; social engagement
meanings: to engage in social activities; to socialize

example.zh: 他工作上的应酬太多，很少在家吃饭。
example.en: He has so many work dinners that he rarely eats at home.

example.zh: 科学家们一直在探索宇宙的奥秘。
example.en: Scientists keep exploring the mysteries of the universe.

example.zh: 他回答问题的声音很响亮。
example.en: He answered the question in a loud, clear voice.

gloss: to divide; to partition; to differentiate

example.zh: 老师把全班划分成五个小组。
example.en: The teacher divided the class into five groups.

example.zh: 他在一所大学附属医院工作。
example.en: He works at a university-affiliated hospital.

example.zh: 因为个子矮，他一直有点自卑。
example.en: Because he's short, he has always felt a bit inferior.

example.zh: 老师让我们背诵这首古诗。
example.en: The teacher asked us to recite this classical poem.

example.zh: 公园里的樱花都盛开了。
example.en: The cherry blossoms in the park are in full bloom.

example.zh: 河水汹涌，船只暂时不能通行。
example.en: The river is surging, so boats can't pass for now.

example.zh: 学好一门外语需要很大的毅力。
example.en: Mastering a foreign language takes great perseverance.

gloss: dedicated to one's work; professional dedication

example.zh: 他是一位非常敬业的老师，经常加班备课。
example.en: He is a very dedicated teacher who often stays late preparing lessons.

gloss: to spoil things through excessive enthusiasm (lit. pulling up shoots to help them grow)
indonesian: terburu-buru sehingga merusak; memaksakan hasil cepat
meanings: to spoil things through excessive enthusiasm (idiom)

example.zh: 教育孩子要有耐心，不能拔苗助长。
example.en: Raising children takes patience; you can't force their growth.

indonesian: prioritas utama; hal yang paling mendesak

example.zh: 当务之急是先把病人送到医院。
example.en: The top priority is to get the patient to hospital first.

gloss: to oppose; to be opposed; opposite

example.zh: 他们的观点完全对立，谁也说服不了谁。
example.en: Their views are completely opposed; neither can convince the other.

example.zh: 孩子的到来给家里增添了很多欢乐。
example.en: The baby's arrival has added a lot of joy to the family.

example.zh: 多沟通可以消除两代人之间的隔阂。
example.en: More communication can remove the gulf between generations.

gloss: for example; for instance; such as

example.zh: 我喜欢很多运动，譬如游泳、跑步和打球。
example.en: I like many sports, for example swimming, running and ball games.

example.zh: 他吃了不干净的东西，结果腹泻了。
example.en: He ate something unclean and ended up with diarrhoea.

example.zh: 这个月的销售指标已经完成了。
example.en: This month's sales target has been met.

example.zh: 这个节目内容庸俗，观众不喜欢。
example.en: The content of this programme is vulgar; audiences don't like it.

example.zh: 请把这些文件妥善保管。
example.en: Please keep these documents safe.

example.zh: 良好的习惯为成功打下了坚实的基础。
example.en: Good habits lay a solid foundation for success.

gloss: notice; announcement (posted or in a newspaper)
meanings: announcement (written, on billboard, letter, newspaper or website)

example.zh: 他在报纸上登了一则寻物启事。
example.en: He placed a lost-property notice in the newspaper.

example.zh: 她在学校负责后勤工作。
example.en: She is in charge of support services at the school.

example.zh: 这几年，这座城市的面貌发生了很大变化。
example.en: In recent years the look of this city has changed enormously.

gloss: male and female; victory and defeat
indonesian: jantan dan betina; kalah atau menang

example.zh: 这种鸟的雌雄很难分辨。
example.en: It's hard to tell the males and females of this bird apart.

meanings: reduplication (in Chinese grammar, e.g. 步 to have a stroll)

example.zh: 这两门课的上课时间重叠了。
example.en: The class times of these two courses overlap.

gloss: to differ; difference; to be apart

example.zh: 我和哥哥的年龄相差五岁。
example.en: My brother and I are five years apart in age.

example.zh: 这本书的内容太深奥了，我看不懂。
example.en: This book's content is too abstruse for me to understand.

example.zh: 出发前，他们制订了周密的计划。
example.en: Before setting off, they drew up a thorough plan.

example.zh: 那只狗看起来很凶恶，其实很温顺。
example.en: That dog looks fierce but is actually very docile.

meanings: to cast (pour metal into a mold)

example.zh: 这口大钟是用铜铸造的。
example.en: This big bell was cast in bronze.

example.zh: 好几天没浇水，花都枯萎了。
example.en: The flowers withered after several days without water.

gloss: to throw; to hurl; to toss
meanings: to throw sth a long distance

example.zh: 他在运动会上参加了铅球投掷比赛。
example.en: He took part in the shot put event at the sports meet.

example.zh: 最近气温急剧下降，大家要注意保暖。
example.en: Temperatures have dropped sharply recently; keep warm.

example.zh: 父母都希望孩子将来有出息。
example.en: All parents hope their children will make something of themselves.

example.zh: 她以优异的成绩考上了名牌大学。
example.en: She got into a top university with outstanding results.

meanings: specific topic (addressed by a book, lecture, TV program etc)
article, report or program etc on a specific topic

example.zh: 电视台正在播放一个关于环保的专题节目。
example.en: The TV station is broadcasting a special programme on the environment.

gloss: to agitate; to incite; to encourage; to arouse
meanings: to urge (an activity that may be beneficial, harmful or neutral); to encourage; to agitate; to instigate; to incite
to beat; to flap (wings, a fan etc)

example.zh: 在朋友的鼓动下，他报名参加了马拉松。
example.en: Egged on by his friends, he signed up for the marathon.

gloss: one disaster after another; to make things worse
indonesian: sudah jatuh tertimpa tangga; memperburuk keadaan

example.zh: 他刚丢了工作，又生了病，真是雪上加霜。
example.en: He just lost his job and then fell ill; misfortune never comes singly.

gloss: to transfer (ownership); to make over; to sell (rights, shop)

example.zh: 这家小店因为老板要出国，准备转让。
example.en: The owner is moving abroad, so this little shop is up for transfer.

example.zh: 这个问题不属于我们讨论的范畴。
example.en: This question falls outside the scope of our discussion.

gloss: to make a speech (on a formal occasion); address
meanings: to express in words or writing
to make a speech (esp. short introduction, vote of thanks, afterword, funeral homily etc)

example.zh: 在开幕式上，校长向来宾致辞。
example.en: At the opening ceremony, the principal addressed the guests.

example.zh: 他从小就喜欢田径运动，特别是短跑。
example.en: He has loved athletics since childhood, especially sprinting.

gloss: to grope for; to feel one's way; to explore

example.zh: 经过多年的摸索，他终于找到了适合自己的学习方法。
example.en: After years of trial and error, he finally found a study method that suits him.

meanings: to emit; to discharge (exhaust gas, waste water etc)
(of animals) to ovulate; to discharge semen

example.zh: 工厂不能把污水直接排放到河里。
example.en: Factories may not discharge waste water straight into rivers.

example.zh: 冰是水在低温下的固体形态。
example.en: Ice is the solid form of water at low temperatures.

gloss: aunt (wife of father's elder brother); polite term for a friend's mother
indonesian: bibi (istri kakak ayah); tante (sebutan sopan untuk ibu teman)
meanings: (polite form of address for a woman who is about the age of one's mother)

example.zh: 伯母，您做的菜太好吃了！
example.en: Auntie, the food you made is delicious!

gloss: to raise; to rear; to keep (animals)

example.zh: 他在农村饲养了几百只鸡。
example.en: He raises several hundred chickens in the countryside.

gloss: to accommodate; to give in to; to humour

example.zh: 父母不能什么事都迁就孩子。
example.en: Parents can't give in to their children on everything.

example.zh: 我们坐轮船去了对面的岛上。
example.en: We took a steamer to the island across the water.

gloss: to disintegrate; to break up; to collapse

example.zh: 这个乐队成立不到两年就解体了。
example.en: The band broke up less than two years after forming.

example.zh: 端午节的时候，很多地方都有龙舟比赛。
example.en: During the Dragon Boat Festival, many places hold dragon boat races.

example.zh: 这条鱼不新鲜，闻起来很腥。
example.en: This fish isn't fresh; it smells very fishy.

gloss: to improve; to reform; to ameliorate

example.zh: 科学家正在改良这种水果的品种。
example.en: Scientists are improving the variety of this fruit.

example.zh: 这套房子的布局很合理。
example.en: The layout of this flat is very sensible.

example.zh: 今年的国际博览会吸引了很多游客。
example.en: This year's international expo attracted many visitors.

example.zh: 中国人民一向勤劳勇敢。
example.en: The Chinese people have always been hardworking and brave.

gloss: gains and losses; advantages and disadvantages

example.zh: 他把其中的利害关系分析得很清楚。
example.en: He analysed the stakes involved very clearly.

gloss: to become invalid; to be nullified; to void

example.zh: 这张优惠券已经过期作废了。
example.en: This coupon has expired and is no longer valid.

example.zh: 这部电影的演员阵容非常强大。
example.en: This film has a very strong cast.

example.zh: 这种零件的规格必须符合要求。
example.en: The specifications of these parts must meet the requirements.

gloss: to plan as a whole and take all factors into account
indonesian: merencanakan secara menyeluruh dan memperhatikan semua pihak
meanings: an overall plan taking into account all factors

example.zh: 制订计划时要统筹兼顾，照顾各方面的利益。
example.en: When drawing up plans, consider everything and look after all interests.

gloss: simple and crude; shabby; poorly equipped
indonesian: sederhana dan seadanya; reyot; kurang lengkap

example.zh: 学校的条件虽然简陋，但老师们很认真。
example.en: Although the school's conditions are basic, the teachers are very dedicated.

example.zh: 政府简化了办理签证的手续。
example.en: The government has simplified the visa application procedures.

example.zh: 遇到问题时，他总是能果断地作出决定。
example.en: When problems arise, he always makes decisions decisively.

gloss: to extract; to refine; to purify; to distil (ideas)

example.zh: 这种油是从植物中提炼出来的。
example.en: This oil is extracted from plants.

example.zh: 大家都来了，唯独他没来。
example.en: Everyone came except him.

gloss: to reflect on; to introspect; reflection

example.zh: 考试失败后，他认真反思了自己的学习方法。
example.en: After failing the exam, he seriously reflected on his study methods.

example.zh: 你这么晚才回家，也不打个电话，太不像话了！
example.en: Coming home this late without even calling is outrageous!

example.zh: 请查看邮件里的附件。
example.en: Please see the attachment in the email.

example.zh: 这次发明是科技史上的一座里程碑。
example.en: This invention is a milestone in the history of technology.

example.zh: 这一带以前很荒凉，现在建起了很多高楼。
example.en: This area used to be desolate; now many tall buildings stand here.

gloss: to cause; to result in; so that

example.zh: 大雾致使很多航班推迟起飞。
example.en: The heavy fog caused many flights to be delayed.

example.zh: 奶奶从果园里摘了一筐苹果。
example.en: Grandma picked a basket of apples from the orchard.

example.zh: 光靠空想是不能实现梦想的。
example.en: You can't achieve your dreams by daydreaming alone.

gloss: in a sorry plight; in an embarrassing situation; awkward
indonesian: serba susah; dalam keadaan memalukan; kacau

example.zh: 突然下起大雨，没带伞的我狼狈极了。
example.en: It suddenly poured, and without an umbrella I was in a sorry state.

example.zh: 这条小河的水清澈见底。
example.en: The water of this stream is so clear you can see the bottom.

example.zh: 请按照规定的格式填写申请表。
example.en: Please fill in the application form in the required format.

example.zh: 公司的发展方针很明确。
example.en: The company's development policy is very clear.

gloss: to speculate; opportunistic; congenial (getting on well)

example.zh: 我们俩谈得很投机，一聊就是几个小时。
example.en: We got along so well that we chatted for hours.

example.zh: 今年这个地区发生了严重的干旱。
example.en: This region suffered a severe drought this year.

example.zh: 他是一名地质学家，经常去野外考察。
example.en: He is a geologist and often does fieldwork.

example.zh: 中秋节是家人团圆的日子。
example.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for family reunion.

example.zh: 车站里人很多，非常嘈杂。
example.en: The station is crowded and very noisy.

gloss: to call on; to appeal; call

example.zh: 学校号召学生节约用水。
example.en: The school is calling on students to save water.

gloss: to stare blankly; to be in a daze; to space out

example.zh: 他坐在窗前发呆，不知道在想什么。
example.en: He sat staring blankly by the window, lost in who knows what.

gloss: to share profits; to pay dividends; dividend; bonus

example.zh: 公司年底会给员工分红。
example.en: The company shares profits with employees at the end of the year.

example.zh: 老人一个人住，晚年生活很凄凉。
example.en: Living alone, the old man had a lonely, dreary old age.

gloss: to promulgate; to issue; to announce (law, regulations)

example.zh: 政府颁布了新的环境保护法。
example.en: The government issued a new environmental protection law.

indonesian: terus terang; blak-blakan; segar; dengan senang hati

example.zh: 我请他帮忙，他爽快地答应了。
example.en: I asked him for help, and he readily agreed.

example.zh: 他昨晚没睡好，今天上课无精打采的。
example.en: He didn't sleep well last night and was listless in class today.

gloss: to refer to; to consult; to use as a reference

example.zh: 你可以参照这个例子来完成作业。
example.en: You can refer to this example to do your homework.

example.zh: 科学家在这里发现了恐龙化石。
example.en: Scientists found dinosaur fossils here.

example.zh: 我们要采取切实可行的措施解决问题。
example.en: We must take practical, feasible measures to solve the problem.

gloss: bumper harvest; to have a good harvest

example.zh: 今年雨水充足，粮食获得了丰收。
example.en: With plenty of rain this year, there was a bumper grain harvest.

gloss: to form a complete set; supporting; matching
indonesian: menjadi satu set; pelengkap; fasilitas pendukung

example.zh: 这个小区的配套设施非常完善。
example.en: The supporting facilities in this residential area are very complete.

example.zh: 这位著名作家去年因病逝世。
example.en: This famous writer passed away from illness last year.

gloss: to burst out; to burst forth

example.zh: 听到这个消息，观众中迸发出热烈的掌声。
example.en: On hearing the news, the audience burst into warm applause.

meanings: chairman of the board of directors

example.zh: 董事长下午要召开一个重要会议。
example.en: The chairman is holding an important meeting this afternoon.

example.zh: 事实证明，经理的决定是英明的。
example.en: Events proved the manager's decision was wise.

example.zh: 请你简要地介绍一下自己。
example.en: Please briefly introduce yourself.

example.zh: 卖菜的阿姨用秤称了称这些西红柿。
example.en: The woman selling vegetables weighed the tomatoes on her scale.

gloss: to rectify; to reorganise; to consolidate

example.zh: 公司决定对管理制度进行整顿。
example.en: The company decided to overhaul its management system.

gloss: to obliterate; to write off; to deny (achievements)

example.zh: 一次失败不能抹杀他多年的努力。
example.en: One failure can't wipe out his years of hard work.

example.zh: 他一个人的收入比我们三个人的总和还多。
example.en: His income alone is more than the three of ours combined.

example.zh: 我的父母很开明，尊重我的选择。
example.en: My parents are very open-minded and respect my choices.

example.zh: 今年房价上涨的幅度很大。
example.en: House prices have risen by a large margin this year.

example.zh: 他穿上警服显得特别威风。
example.en: He looks especially imposing in his police uniform.

gloss: to press; to squeeze; to exploit; to extract by pressing
meanings: to extract juice, oil etc by squeezing

example.zh: 这种油是用花生压榨出来的。
example.en: This oil is pressed from peanuts.

indonesian: budi pekerti; kepribadian yang baik; pengetahuan dan keterampilan

example.zh: 他是一个很有修养的人，从不大声说话。
example.en: He is a very well-mannered person who never raises his voice.

meanings: misfortune not visible from the surface

example.zh: 这栋老楼存在很多安全隐患。
example.en: This old building has many hidden safety hazards.

example.zh: 他们之间有着真挚的友谊。
example.en: They share a sincere friendship.

gloss: to declare (to customs); to report (to authorities); to apply

example.zh: 入境时，贵重物品要向海关申报。
example.en: When entering the country, valuables must be declared to customs.

example.zh: 我们不能用狭隘的眼光看问题。
example.en: We can't look at problems from a narrow point of view.

gloss: capital; principal; asset (what one can rely on)
meanings: (fig.) asset; advantage; the means (to do sth)

example.zh: 身体健康是努力工作的本钱。
example.en: Good health is the capital you need to work hard.

example.zh: 这家公司几乎垄断了整个市场。
example.en: This company has almost monopolised the entire market.

example.zh: 这种茶有帮助消化的功效。
example.en: This tea has the effect of aiding digestion.

example.zh: 她买名牌包只是为了满足虚荣心。
example.en: She buys designer bags just to satisfy her vanity.

gloss: to settle accounts; to close an account; settlement

example.zh: 我们每个月月底结算一次工资。
example.en: We settle wages once at the end of each month.

gloss: to be stranded; to be held up; to stay behind
meanings: (of a person) to remain in (a place) (due to circumstances that prevent one leaving); to be stranded
(of sth that would typically dissipate, e.g. floodwater, pollutants) to remain; to linger

example.zh: 因为大雪，很多旅客滞留在机场。
example.en: Because of heavy snow, many travellers were stranded at the airport.

gloss: to govern; to administer; to bring under control; to tackle

example.zh: 这座城市花了很大力气治理空气污染。
example.en: The city has put great effort into tackling air pollution.

example.zh: 这辆卡车用的是柴油。
example.en: This truck runs on diesel.

meanings: free; no charge; at no cost

example.zh: 很多志愿者无偿为老人提供服务。
example.en: Many volunteers serve the elderly free of charge.

gloss: metabolism; the new superseding the old
indonesian: metabolisme; yang baru menggantikan yang lama

example.zh: 多运动可以促进身体的新陈代谢。
example.en: Exercising more can boost the body's metabolism.

example.zh: 今天最高气温是三十五摄氏度。
example.en: Today's high is thirty-five degrees Celsius.

gloss: one after another; in succession; in a row

example.zh: 他接连三天都没来上班。
example.en: He hasn't come to work for three days in a row.

gloss: to stir up trouble; to cause trouble

example.zh: 这孩子太调皮了，总是惹祸。
example.en: This child is so naughty; he's always getting into trouble.

gloss: fork (in a road); to branch off; to change (the subject)
meanings: branch in road, river, mountain range etc

example.zh: 走到前面的岔路口，你要往左拐。
example.en: When you reach the fork in the road ahead, turn left.

example.zh: 他们家的媳妇又能干又孝顺。
example.en: Their daughter-in-law is both capable and dutiful.

indonesian: susah payah; memerlukan banyak tenaga; capek

example.zh: 爷爷年纪大了，爬楼梯越来越吃力。
example.en: Grandpa is getting old, and climbing stairs is getting harder and harder for him.

gloss: to give advice; adviser; staff officer

example.zh: 我想买台电脑，你帮我参谋一下吧。
example.en: I want to buy a computer; could you give me some advice?

gloss: to collude with; to collaborate secretly; to gang up
indonesian: bersekongkol; berkomplot; bekerja sama secara diam-diam

example.zh: 这家公司被发现与供应商勾结抬高价格。
example.en: The company was found colluding with suppliers to push up prices.

example.zh: 市场动荡的时候，投资要格外小心。
example.en: When the market is turbulent, you must be especially careful with investments.

example.zh: 他每天坚持锻炼，所以精力很充沛。
example.en: He exercises every day, so he is full of energy.

example.zh: 两家公司的负责人下周将在上海会晤。
example.en: The heads of the two companies will meet in Shanghai next week.

example.zh: 她在这次全国比赛中获得了亚军。
example.en: She came second in this national competition.

example.zh: 每个国家都有权维护自己的主权。
example.en: Every country has the right to safeguard its own sovereignty.

gloss: to host; to organize; to sponsor (an event)
meanings: to host (a conference or sports event)

example.zh: 这次国际会议由我们学校主办。
example.en: This international conference is hosted by our school.

gloss: to narrow one's eyes; to squint; to take a nap
indonesian: menyipitkan mata; memicingkan mata; tidur sebentar

example.zh: 阳光太刺眼，他不由得眯起了眼睛。
example.en: The sunlight was so glaring that he couldn't help squinting.

gloss: to be in vogue; to be prevalent; to be popular
meanings: to be in vogue; to be popular; to be prevalent

example.zh: 近年来，网上购物在年轻人中十分盛行。
example.en: In recent years, online shopping has become very popular among young people.

example.zh: 下班高峰过后，这条路就畅通了。
example.en: After the evening rush hour, this road is clear.

indonesian: kaku karena lama tidak berlatih; tidak terbiasa; asing

example.zh: 好几年没弹钢琴了，手指都生疏了。
example.en: I haven't played the piano for years, and my fingers are rusty.

gloss: altitude; elevation; height above sea level
indonesian: ketinggian di atas permukaan laut; elevasi

example.zh: 这座山海拔三千多米，山顶常年积雪。
example.en: This mountain is over 3,000 metres high, and its peak is snow-covered all year.

indonesian: sopan dan halus; berbudaya; lemah lembut

example.zh: 他戴着眼镜，说话很斯文。
example.en: He wears glasses and speaks in a gentle, refined way.

example.zh: 大厅的墙上悬挂着一幅山水画。
example.en: A landscape painting hangs on the wall of the hall.

gloss: to pile up; to accumulate; to heap up

example.zh: 假期结束后，桌上堆积了很多文件。
example.en: After the holiday, lots of documents had piled up on the desk.

example.zh: 她凭着坚韧的意志完成了马拉松。
example.en: She finished the marathon through sheer tenacity.

gloss: to spurn; to despise; to cast aside

example.zh: 不讲诚信的商家最终会被顾客唾弃。
example.en: Dishonest merchants will eventually be spurned by customers.

gloss: awareness; consciousness; to come to understand; enlightenment

example.zh: 大家的环保觉悟越来越高了。
example.en: People's environmental awareness is getting higher and higher.

gloss: spontaneous; voluntary; of one's own accord

example.zh: 居民们自发组织起来清理小区垃圾。
example.en: The residents spontaneously organized themselves to clean up the rubbish in the neighbourhood.

indonesian: celah; ruang kosong; jeda; waktu luang
meanings: gap in time between two events

example.zh: 他利用工作的空隙看了几页书。
example.en: He read a few pages in the gaps between work.

gloss: heartless; cruel; to harden one's heart; to make a painful decision

example.zh: 她狠心把心爱的小狗送给了朋友。
example.en: She steeled herself and gave her beloved puppy to a friend.

example.zh: 中国画有很多不同的派别。
example.en: There are many different schools of Chinese painting.

gloss: to overcome; to conquer (a difficulty); to capture

example.zh: 科学家们终于攻克了这个技术难题。
example.en: The scientists finally overcame this technical problem.

example.zh: 双方已经签订了合作意向书。
example.en: Both sides have signed a letter of intent to cooperate.

gloss: to open up; to develop; to pioneer

example.zh: 公司正在积极开拓海外市场。
example.en: The company is actively opening up overseas markets.

indonesian: unik; khas; menarik dan lain daripada yang lain

example.zh: 这家咖啡馆的装修风格很别致。
example.en: This café is decorated in a very distinctive style.

gloss: to start a business; to found an enterprise; to build up
indonesian: memulai usaha; merintis bisnis; membangun usaha

example.zh: 他大学毕业后就和朋友一起创业了。
example.en: After graduating from university, he started a business with friends.

gloss: troublesome; to cause a headache; knotty
meanings: to find sth a real headache

example.zh: 孩子不爱吃饭，真让父母伤脑筋。
example.en: The child won't eat, which is a real headache for the parents.

gloss: to last (for a period); to be scheduled for

example.zh: 这次培训为期两周，下周一开始。
example.en: This training lasts two weeks and starts next Monday.

example.zh: 通货膨胀导致物价不断上涨。
example.en: Inflation has caused prices to keep rising.

gloss: upright; proper; correct; to correct (an attitude)

example.zh: 只有端正学习态度，成绩才能提高。
example.en: Only by correcting your attitude to study can your grades improve.

example.zh: 对我来说，家永远是最温暖的港湾。
example.en: For me, home will always be the warmest haven.

example.zh: 写论文之前，要先查阅大量相关文献。
example.en: Before writing a thesis, you must first consult a lot of relevant literature.

example.zh: 学生们对这位老教授充满了崇敬。
example.en: The students are full of reverence for this old professor.

gloss: to compare; to contrast; to check against
meanings: to place side by side for comparison (as parallel texts)

example.zh: 请对照原文检查一下译文有没有错误。
example.en: Please check the translation against the original for errors.

example.zh: 语言是人们交流思想的媒介。
example.en: Language is the medium through which people exchange ideas.

gloss: to punish; to discipline; disciplinary action

example.zh: 他因为考试作弊受到了学校的处分。
example.en: He was disciplined by the school for cheating in an exam.

example.zh: 这家店的老板说话很和气。
example.en: The owner of this shop speaks in a very friendly way.

meanings: evil as opposed to the Way of the King 王道

example.zh: 他太霸道了，从来不听别人的意见。
example.en: He is too domineering and never listens to other people's opinions.

gloss: to praise highly; to marvel at; to exclaim in admiration

example.zh: 游客们看到这里的美景都赞叹不已。
example.en: The tourists all marvelled at the beautiful scenery here.

example.zh: 听到这个消息，他脸上露出苦涩的笑容。
example.en: Hearing the news, a bitter smile appeared on his face.

gloss: to shrug; to tower; to rise high

example.zh: 他耸了耸肩，表示自己也不知道。
example.en: He shrugged to show that he didn't know either.

example.zh: 在所有考试科目中，我最擅长数学。
example.en: Of all the exam subjects, I'm best at maths.

gloss: to embellish; to adorn; to decorate

example.zh: 几盆鲜花把房间点缀得很漂亮。
example.en: A few pots of flowers made the room look very pretty.

gloss: to sing the praises of; to extol; to eulogize

example.zh: 这首歌歌颂了母亲伟大的爱。
example.en: This song celebrates a mother's great love.

example.zh: 杂交水稻大大提高了粮食产量。
example.en: Hybrid rice has greatly increased grain output.

gloss: for the time being; for now; temporarily
indonesian: untuk sementara; sementara ini; untuk saat ini

example.zh: 这个问题我们暂且不讨论，先吃饭吧。
example.en: Let's put this issue aside for now and eat first.

gloss: to tell; to instruct; to exhort

example.zh: 出门前，妈妈嘱咐我路上注意安全。
example.en: Before I left, Mum told me to be careful on the way.

gloss: to treat coldly; to snub; to leave out in the cold; desolate

example.zh: 他忙着工作，冷落了家里人。
example.en: Busy with work, he neglected his family.

gloss: meticulous; scrupulous; not the least bit careless
indonesian: sangat teliti; cermat; tidak ceroboh sedikit pun
meanings: not one thread loose (idiom); strictly according to the rules
not one hair out of place

example.zh: 王老师批改作业总是一丝不苟。
example.en: Teacher Wang is always meticulous when marking homework.

example.zh: 由于资金不足，工程进展十分迟缓。
example.en: Due to lack of funds, the project is progressing very slowly.

gloss: meaningful glance; wink; signal with the eyes

example.zh: 妈妈给我使了个眼色，让我别再说了。
example.en: Mum gave me a look, telling me not to say any more.

gloss: to soak; to steep; to immerse

example.zh: 做饭前，先把豆子浸泡一个晚上。
example.en: Before cooking, soak the beans overnight.

gloss: column (in a newspaper); programme (on TV); section
meanings: regular column or segment (in a publication or broadcast program)

example.zh: 这个电视栏目很受老年观众欢迎。
example.en: This TV programme is very popular with elderly viewers.

example.zh: 虽然工作很多，她却安排得有条不紊。
example.en: Although there was a lot of work, she arranged it all in an orderly way.

gloss: to express sympathy; to extend greetings; to console
indonesian: menyampaikan simpati; mengunjungi untuk menghibur; menyampaikan salam
meanings: to express sympathy, greetings, consolation etc

example.zh: 春节前，公司领导去慰问了退休员工。
example.en: Before Spring Festival, company leaders visited the retired staff to extend their greetings.

meanings: Weixin county in Zhaotong 通, Yunnan

example.zh: 李校长在学生中很有威信。
example.en: Principal Li has great prestige among the students.

indonesian: jelas sekali pandang; langsung terlihat jelas

example.zh: 用图表说明，数据就一目了然了。
example.en: With a chart, the data is clear at a glance.

gloss: self-reliance; to rely on one's own efforts

example.zh: 他从小就学会了自力更生。
example.en: He learned to be self-reliant from a young age.

example.zh: 过年的时候，家家户户都挂起了红灯笼。
example.en: At New Year, every household hangs up red lanterns.

meanings: current trends; the present situation; how things are going

example.zh: 爸爸每天晚上都会看时事新闻。
example.en: Dad watches the current affairs news every evening.

example.zh: 这个广告的创意非常新颖。
example.en: The idea behind this advert is very original.

example.zh: 孩子们兴高采烈地去公园春游了。
example.en: The children went off to the park for a spring outing in high spirits.

gloss: to anchor; to moor; to berth

example.zh: 港口里停泊着几十艘渔船。
example.en: Dozens of fishing boats are moored in the harbour.

indonesian: keras kepala; tidak mau mengalah; teguh

example.zh: 这孩子很倔强，从来不肯认错。
example.en: This child is very stubborn and never admits he is wrong.

gloss: to look down at; to overlook
indonesian: memandang ke bawah; melihat dari atas

example.zh: 从山顶俯视，整个城市尽收眼底。
example.en: Looking down from the summit, you can take in the whole city.

example.zh: 他们家世代都住在这个小村子里。
example.en: His family has lived in this small village for generations.

gloss: to draw close; to move closer together; to close ranks

example.zh: 拍合影的时候，请大家往中间靠拢一点。
example.en: When we take the group photo, please move a bit closer to the middle.

gloss: steady and sure; down-to-earth; free from anxiety; at ease
indonesian: tekun dan sungguh-sungguh; membumi; tenang hati

example.zh: 他工作很踏实，领导很放心。
example.en: He works steadily and reliably, so the boss trusts him.

gloss: to gain a foothold; to establish oneself; to base oneself on

example.zh: 想在大城市立足，并不是件容易的事。
example.en: Establishing yourself in a big city is not an easy thing.

example.zh: 水管坏了，快给物业打个电话吧。
example.en: The water pipe is broken; quickly call property management.

indonesian: air tawar; air yang tidak asin
meanings: Tamsui or Danshui, district of New Taipei City 市, Taiwan
potable water (water with low salt content)

example.zh: 地球上可以直接利用的淡水很少。
example.en: There is very little fresh water on Earth that can be used directly.

example.zh: 利用杠杆原理，可以轻松地搬动重物。
example.en: Using the principle of the lever, you can move heavy objects easily.

example.zh: 她虽然很有钱，但穿着十分朴素。
example.en: Although she is rich, she dresses very plainly.

gloss: to open up; to start; to develop

example.zh: 航空公司新开辟了一条直飞航线。
example.en: The airline has opened a new direct route.

gloss: known to every household; widely known; a household name
indonesian: dikenal setiap orang; terkenal luas; sudah menjadi rahasia umum

example.zh: 这个故事在中国家喻户晓。
example.en: This story is known to every household in China.

example.zh: 经过一番周折，他终于办好了签证。
example.en: After a lot of trouble, he finally got his visa.

gloss: cluster; thicket; clump; measure word for clumps of plants
indonesian: rumpun; semak; kelompok; kata satuan untuk rumpun tanaman

example.zh: 院子里种着一丛丛的月季花。
example.en: Clumps of Chinese roses are planted in the courtyard.

gloss: and then; further; going a step further

example.zh: 先学好基础知识，进而提高实际能力。
example.en: First master the basics, and then improve your practical skills.

gloss: to ask for instructions; to request approval (from a superior)

example.zh: 这件事我得先向经理请示一下。
example.en: I need to ask the manager for instructions on this first.

indonesian: semena-mena; tanpa kendali; tanpa rasa takut

example.zh: 他在会上肆无忌惮地批评同事。
example.en: He criticized his colleagues brazenly at the meeting.

gloss: to establish; to set up; to fix

example.zh: 上大学后，他确立了自己的人生目标。
example.en: After going to university, he established his goals in life.

gloss: great kindness; warm hospitality; boundless enthusiasm
indonesian: keramahan yang besar; kebaikan hati; sambutan hangat

example.zh: 谢谢你们的盛情款待，我们玩得很开心。
example.en: Thank you for your warm hospitality; we had a great time.

gloss: to wolf down; to gobble up; to eat greedily
indonesian: makan dengan rakus; melahap; makan terburu-buru

example.zh: 他饿坏了，端起碗就狼吞虎咽起来。
example.en: He was starving, and as soon as he picked up the bowl he started wolfing it down.

example.zh: 写文章前，最好先搭好整体框架。
example.en: Before writing an essay, it's best to first set up the overall framework.

example.zh: 这条公路又宽又平坦，开车很舒服。
example.en: This road is wide and flat, so it's comfortable to drive on.

example.zh: 一场突如其来的冰雹砸坏了不少庄稼。
example.en: A sudden hailstorm damaged a lot of crops.

example.zh: 他接到电话，随即离开了会议室。
example.en: He took the call and immediately left the meeting room.

example.zh: 今年公司的财务出现了赤字。
example.en: The company's finances went into deficit this year.

gloss: draft (of a plan, law, etc.); draft proposal

example.zh: 这份合同草案还需要进一步修改。
example.en: This draft contract still needs further revision.

gloss: to simplify; to streamline; to cut down

example.zh: 为了提高效率，公司决定精简办事程序。
example.en: To improve efficiency, the company decided to streamline its procedures.

meanings: swelling or lump on skin; pimple

example.zh: 被蚊子咬了以后，胳膊上起了个小疙瘩。
example.en: After being bitten by a mosquito, a small lump appeared on my arm.

gloss: sometimes; from time to time; now ... now ...

example.zh: 今天的天气时而晴天，时而下雨。
example.en: Today the weather is sunny one moment and rainy the next.

example.zh: 我很喜欢读朱自清的散文。
example.en: I really like reading Zhu Ziqing's essays.

example.zh: 这些竹制工艺品都是手工做的。
example.en: These bamboo handicrafts are all handmade.

gloss: to neglect (talent); to stifle; to bury

example.zh: 他很有才华，不应该被埋没。
example.en: He is very talented and should not be overlooked.

example.zh: 选择朋友时，品德比能力更重要。
example.en: When choosing friends, character is more important than ability.

example.zh: 他对这件事的理解有些偏差。
example.en: His understanding of this matter is somewhat off.

example.zh: 倘若明天下雨，比赛就推迟举行。
example.en: If it rains tomorrow, the match will be postponed.

gloss: easy to; convenient for; to facilitate

example.zh: 这种包装很小，便于携带。
example.en: This packaging is small and easy to carry.

example.zh: 站在长城上，我感受到了它的雄伟。
example.en: Standing on the Great Wall, I felt its grandeur.

example.zh: 这本书用通俗的语言解释了科学知识。
example.en: This book explains scientific knowledge in plain, accessible language.

gloss: to load and unload; to assemble and disassemble

example.zh: 工人们正在码头上装卸货物。
example.en: The workers are loading and unloading goods at the dock.

gloss: to set off; to serve as a foil to; to highlight
indonesian: menonjolkan; memperindah dengan kontras; menjadi latar

example.zh: 在绿叶的衬托下，红花显得更加鲜艳。
example.en: Set off by the green leaves, the red flowers look even brighter.

gloss: to assess; to examine; to check (performance); appraisal

example.zh: 新员工要经过三个月的考核才能转正。
example.en: New employees have to pass a three-month assessment before becoming permanent.

example.zh: 这条街是全市最繁华的商业区。
example.en: This street is the busiest commercial district in the city.

example.zh: 他的母语是印尼语，但汉语说得也很好。
example.en: His mother tongue is Indonesian, but he speaks Chinese very well too.

gloss: to the extent that; so much so that; up to
meanings: to such an extent as to ...

example.zh: 他看书太专心，以至忘了吃饭。
example.en: He was so absorbed in his book that he forgot to eat.

gloss: to play a decisive role; of great importance; pivotal
indonesian: sangat berpengaruh; memegang peran penting; menentukan

example.zh: 他在公司里是个举足轻重的人物。
example.en: He is a very influential figure in the company.

example.zh: 远处隐约传来了音乐声。
example.en: Faint music could be heard in the distance.

gloss: to mediate; to reconcile; harmonious; to mix

example.zh: 他俩吵架了，你去调和一下吧。
example.en: Those two have quarrelled; go and smooth things over between them.

gloss: error (in measurement); margin of error; inaccuracy

example.zh: 这台仪器的测量误差非常小。
example.en: This instrument's measurement error is very small.
