gloss: to demonstrate; to prove; argumentation; reasoning

example.zh: 这个方案还需要专家进一步论证。
example.en: This plan still needs further evaluation by experts.

example.zh: 农民们用河水灌溉农田。
example.en: The farmers use river water to irrigate the fields.

meanings: to annotate; to add a comment

example.zh: 这本古书的注释写得很详细。
example.en: The annotations in this ancient book are very detailed.

meanings: (neologism c. 2017) (of a middle-aged man) obnoxious; pretentious; vulgar

example.zh: 医生建议他少吃油腻的食物。
example.en: The doctor advised him to eat less greasy food.

example.zh: 论文的摘要不能超过三百字。
example.en: The thesis abstract must not exceed three hundred characters.

gloss: for the moment; tentatively; for the time being
indonesian: untuk sementara; sementara waktu; boleh dicoba dulu

example.zh: 这个办法不太好，但姑且试一试吧。
example.en: This method isn't great, but let's try it for now.

example.zh: 他从小就对天文非常感兴趣。
example.en: He has been very interested in astronomy since childhood.

gloss: on the whole; roughly; in general; general principle
indonesian: secara garis besar; pada umumnya; kurang lebih
meanings: in general; more or less; in rough terms; basically; on the whole
cadaver for dissection in training medical students

example.zh: 我们的看法大体上是一致的。
example.en: Our views are broadly the same.

example.zh: 家里发生变故后，他变得成熟了许多。
example.en: After misfortune struck his family, he became much more mature.

gloss: to carry forward; to develop; to promote (a tradition or virtue)

example.zh: 我们要发扬团结互助的精神。
example.en: We should carry forward the spirit of unity and mutual help.

gloss: to ask in reply; to answer a question with a question; rhetorical question
indonesian: balik bertanya; menjawab dengan pertanyaan; pertanyaan retoris
meanings: to answer a question with a question

example.zh: 我问他去不去，他反问我为什么不去。
example.en: I asked him whether he was going, and he asked me back why I wasn't.

gloss: to try to make a good showing; to live up to expectations
indonesian: berusaha tidak mengecewakan; membanggakan; memenuhi harapan

example.zh: 儿子很争气，考上了理想的大学。
example.en: The son lived up to expectations and got into his dream university.

gloss: equally matched; about the same; neck and neck

example.zh: 这两个队的实力不相上下。
example.en: The two teams are evenly matched.

gloss: to come out; to be published; to appear on the market

example.zh: 这款新手机将于下个月问世。
example.en: This new phone will come out next month.

gloss: to make something good even better; icing on the cake
indonesian: membuat yang baik menjadi lebih baik; pelengkap yang menyempurnakan

example.zh: 这条项链配上你的裙子真是锦上添花。
example.en: This necklace with your dress is the icing on the cake.

gloss: to study intensively; to delve into; to dig into

example.zh: 他花了很多年钻研中医。
example.en: He spent many years studying traditional Chinese medicine in depth.

gloss: to mourn; to commemorate (the dead); memorial
meanings: to mourn; to pay last respects

example.zh: 很多人参加了老教授的追悼会。
example.en: Many people attended the old professor's memorial service.

gloss: to sprout; to bud; germ; beginning

example.zh: 春天到了，小草开始萌芽了。
example.en: Spring has come and the grass has begun to sprout.

gloss: cube (of a number); cubic; cubic metre

example.zh: 这个水池能装下十立方的水。
example.en: This pool can hold ten cubic metres of water.

example.zh: 海上波涛汹涌，渔船都回港了。
example.en: The sea was raging with huge waves, and the fishing boats all returned to port.

meanings: to plant (maize etc) by sowing seed

example.zh: 春天是农民播种的季节。
example.en: Spring is the season when farmers sow seeds.

gloss: to exchange greetings; small talk; pleasantries

example.zh: 两人寒暄了几句，就开始谈正事。
example.en: The two exchanged a few pleasantries and then got down to business.

gloss: by every possible means; to do everything possible
indonesian: dengan segala cara; berusaha sekuat tenaga
meanings: lit. thousand ways, a hundred plans (idiom); by every possible means

example.zh: 父母千方百计地为孩子创造好的条件。
example.en: Parents do everything possible to create good conditions for their children.

gloss: to intensify; to aggravate; to exacerbate

example.zh: 行业之间的竞争正在不断加剧。
example.en: Competition within the industry is constantly intensifying.

example.zh: 这个小姑娘聪明伶俐，大家都喜欢她。
example.en: This little girl is bright and clever, and everyone likes her.

example.zh: 爷爷每天早上都要练一个小时书法。
example.en: Grandpa practises calligraphy for an hour every morning.

gloss: to strive to improve; to make progress; ambitious

example.zh: 她是个很上进的年轻人，下班后还去学英语。
example.en: She's a very motivated young person who studies English after work.

gloss: to display; to exhibit; to lay out

example.zh: 博物馆里陈列着许多珍贵的文物。
example.en: Many precious cultural relics are displayed in the museum.

gloss: to inlay; to embed; to set (jewels)
meanings: to set (e.g. a jewel in a ring)

example.zh: 这枚戒指上镶嵌着一颗钻石。
example.en: This ring is set with a diamond.

meanings: equator (of the earth or a celestial body)

example.zh: 印度尼西亚位于赤道附近，全年炎热。
example.en: Indonesia lies near the equator and is hot all year round.

gloss: mind; breadth of mind; heart; to cherish (ideals)

example.zh: 做领导的应该有宽广的胸怀。
example.en: A leader should be broad-minded.

indonesian: tak berujung; tak habis-habisnya; tak terbatas

example.zh: 读书给我带来了无穷无尽的快乐。
example.en: Reading has brought me endless joy.

gloss: to lean on (a stick); to prop oneself up with

example.zh: 奶奶拄着拐杖慢慢地走进了公园。
example.en: Grandma slowly walked into the park, leaning on her walking stick.

gloss: to love dearly; to feel sorry for; to be distressed (by a loss)
indonesian: sayang; merasa kasihan; merasa sayang (atas kerugian)

example.zh: 看到孩子累成这样，妈妈很心疼。
example.en: Seeing her child so exhausted, the mother felt heartbroken.

gloss: to fawn on; to curry favour with; to suck up to

example.zh: 他总是想方设法巴结领导。
example.en: He is always trying every way to curry favour with the boss.

gloss: to strive to; to make every effort to; to do one's best to
indonesian: berusaha sekuat tenaga; berupaya keras untuk

example.zh: 我们力求把每一个细节都做好。
example.en: We strive to get every detail right.

gloss: to disdain; to consider beneath one's notice; to scorn
indonesian: memandang rendah; tidak sudi melirik; meremehkan

example.zh: 他对别人的建议总是不屑一顾。
example.en: He always dismisses other people's suggestions with disdain.

gloss: to curb; to contain; to restrain

example.zh: 政府采取措施遏制房价过快上涨。
example.en: The government took measures to curb the rapid rise in house prices.

gloss: to urge; to supervise and urge on; to push (someone to finish)
meanings: to supervise and urge completion of a task

example.zh: 妈妈每天督促我按时完成作业。
example.en: Mum urges me every day to finish my homework on time.

gloss: to emphasize; to stress; to focus on
meanings: to put emphasis on; to stress

example.zh: 老师着重讲了这道题的解题思路。
example.en: The teacher stressed the approach to solving this problem.

gloss: to stamp; to affix a seal

example.zh: 这份申请表需要单位盖章才有效。
example.en: This application form is only valid with your employer's stamp.

example.zh: 这个地区有很多美丽的湖泊。
example.en: There are many beautiful lakes in this region.

example.zh: 会议室里放着一张椭圆形的桌子。
example.en: There is an oval table in the meeting room.

gloss: to work hard; to toil; to look after (affairs)

example.zh: 母亲为这个家操劳了一辈子。
example.en: Mother toiled her whole life for this family.

gloss: what one has learned; insights; experience gained
indonesian: pengalaman yang diperoleh; hasil pemahaman; kesan
meanings: what one has learned (through experience, reading etc)

example.zh: 请你谈谈学习汉语的心得。
example.en: Please tell us what you've learned from studying Chinese.

example.zh: 他的论文发表在一家学术刊物上。
example.en: His paper was published in an academic journal.

meanings: the seven cervical vertebrae in the neck of humans and most mammals

example.zh: 长时间低头看手机对颈椎不好。
example.en: Looking down at your phone for a long time is bad for your neck.

gloss: head-on; in one's face; directly towards one
indonesian: dari arah depan; berhadapan; langsung ke muka

example.zh: 一出门，一阵冷风迎面吹来。
example.en: As soon as I went out, a gust of cold wind blew right in my face.

indonesian: lega; senang dan nyaman; bebas dari beban

example.zh: 考完试以后，我心情特别舒畅。
example.en: After the exams, I felt especially relaxed and happy.

gloss: rules; regulations; charter; constitution (of an organization)

example.zh: 加入协会前，请先阅读协会章程。
example.en: Before joining the association, please read its charter.

gloss: cocky; putting on airs; spirited; expression

example.zh: 他穿上新军装，显得特别神气。
example.en: He looked very smart and proud in his new uniform.

gloss: to cultivate; to grow; to train (talent)

example.zh: 感谢公司多年来对我的栽培。
example.en: Thank you to the company for nurturing me over the years.

gloss: day and night; around the clock

example.zh: 工人们昼夜不停地抢修道路。
example.en: The workers repaired the road day and night without stopping.

gloss: to be hostile to; to regard as an enemy; hostility

example.zh: 他们两家因为一点小事互相敌视。
example.en: The two families became hostile to each other over a trifle.

gloss: to recruit; to take in; to enrol

example.zh: 这所大学今年计划招收三千名新生。
example.en: This university plans to admit 3,000 new students this year.

gloss: to flatter; to puff up; to laud excessively

example.zh: 别听他们吹捧，要清楚自己的不足。
example.en: Don't listen to their flattery; be clear about your own shortcomings.

gloss: ranking; position in a list; place
meanings: position in a ranking of names

example.zh: 比赛重在参与，名次并不重要。
example.en: Taking part is what matters in the competition; the ranking isn't important.

gloss: to advocate; to promote; to initiate
meanings: to be a proponent of (an idea or school of thought)

example.zh: 学校倡导学生养成节约的好习惯。
example.en: The school encourages students to develop the good habit of thrift.

indonesian: sudah jelas dengan sendirinya; tidak perlu dikatakan lagi
meanings: it goes without saying; it is self-evident

example.zh: 健康的重要性是不言而喻的。
example.en: The importance of health goes without saying.

example.zh: 听说他辞职了，大家都很诧异。
example.en: Everyone was astonished to hear that he had resigned.

example.zh: 这个小岛上的居民大多是渔民。
example.en: Most of the residents on this small island are fishermen.

gloss: to check in (luggage); to consign for shipment

example.zh: 这个箱子太大，必须托运。
example.en: This suitcase is too big; it has to be checked in.

example.zh: 对不起，我不是成心要让你难堪的。
example.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to embarrass you.

gloss: taboo; to avoid as taboo; to avoid

example.zh: 在中国，送礼时忌讳送钟。
example.en: In China, giving a clock as a gift is taboo.

gloss: orientation; guidance; to lead to; to direct towards

example.zh: 企业应该以市场需求为导向。
example.en: Enterprises should be market-oriented.

example.zh: 他说话太啰唆，半天说不到重点。
example.en: He's so long-winded; it takes him ages to get to the point.

example.zh: 这些老照片记录了城市的变迁。
example.en: These old photos record the changes in the city.

gloss: to restrict; to constrain; to condition

example.zh: 资金不足制约了公司的发展。
example.en: Lack of funds has constrained the company's development.

gloss: to list; to enumerate; to cite (examples)
indonesian: menyebutkan satu per satu; mendaftar; memberi (contoh)

example.zh: 请列举几个保护环境的好方法。
example.en: Please list a few good ways to protect the environment.

example.zh: 出国留学需要把毕业证书拿去公证。
example.en: To study abroad, you need to have your diploma notarized.

example.zh: 年夜饭桌上摆满了美味佳肴。
example.en: The New Year's Eve table was covered with delicious dishes.

gloss: to treat unfairly; to treat shabbily

example.zh: 你好好干，公司绝不会亏待你。
example.en: Work hard and the company will never treat you unfairly.

example.zh: 新经理做事很有魄力。
example.en: The new manager acts with great boldness and decisiveness.

example.zh: 听到这个好消息，大家顿时欢呼起来。
example.en: On hearing the good news, everyone immediately cheered.

gloss: to spur on; to urge on; to encourage
meanings: to encourage sb (e.g. to make progress)

example.zh: 老师的话一直鞭策着我努力学习。
example.en: My teacher's words have always spurred me on to study hard.

example.zh: 雨越下越大，我们索性不走了。
example.en: The rain got heavier and heavier, so we simply decided not to leave.

example.zh: 他最喜欢听相声，常常笑得停不下来。
example.en: He loves listening to crosstalk and often can't stop laughing.

gloss: to emerge in large numbers; to spring up; to come to the fore

example.zh: 近几年涌现出了许多优秀的年轻作家。
example.en: In recent years many outstanding young writers have emerged.

example.zh: 这里的村民朴实热情。
example.en: The villagers here are simple, honest and warm-hearted.

gloss: admittedly; it is true that; of course

example.zh: 成绩固然重要，但身体健康更重要。
example.en: Grades are certainly important, but good health is more important.

gloss: to whistle; to howl; to roar
meanings: to whistle; to scream; to whiz

example.zh: 窗外北风呼啸，屋里却很暖和。
example.en: Outside the window the north wind howled, but inside it was warm.

example.zh: 在中国人眼里，红色是吉祥的颜色。
example.en: In the eyes of Chinese people, red is an auspicious colour.

gloss: to sneer at; to ridicule; to deride

example.zh: 我们不应该讥笑别人的缺点。
example.en: We shouldn't ridicule other people's shortcomings.

example.zh: 蔚蓝的天空中飘着几朵白云。
example.en: A few white clouds drift in the azure sky.

example.zh: 这种植物的茎很细，但非常结实。
example.en: This plant's stem is very thin but extremely sturdy.

gloss: to defend (a thesis); to reply (to charges); oral defence

example.zh: 下个月我要参加毕业论文答辩。
example.en: Next month I have to defend my graduation thesis.

gloss: kindly; benevolent (esp. of elderly people); kind-looking
indonesian: ramah dan penuh kasih; welas asih (terutama orang tua)

example.zh: 奶奶脸上总是带着慈祥的笑容。
example.en: Grandma always has a kindly smile on her face.

gloss: daily family life; home-style (food); small talk about home
indonesian: kehidupan sehari-hari keluarga; masakan rumahan; obrolan santai
meanings: the daily life of a family

example.zh: 这家小饭馆的家常菜做得很地道。
example.en: This little restaurant's home-style dishes are very authentic.

example.zh: 他的学说对后世影响很大。
example.en: His theory had a great influence on later generations.

example.zh: 黄山的日出景色十分壮丽。
example.en: The sunrise at Huangshan is truly magnificent.

gloss: turnover; cash flow; to have enough to go round

example.zh: 公司最近资金周转有些困难。
example.en: The company has recently had some cash-flow difficulties.

example.zh: 祝你们的生意越来越兴旺！
example.en: Wishing your business ever greater prosperity!

gloss: to learn from; to draw on (others' experience); reference
indonesian: mengambil pelajaran dari; mencontoh; meniru (pengalaman orang lain)
meanings: to learn from (how others do things)
lesson to be learned (by observing others)

example.zh: 我们可以借鉴其他国家的成功经验。
example.en: We can draw on the successful experience of other countries.

gloss: to flutter; to wave (in the wind); to fly

example.zh: 运动场上彩旗飘扬，非常热闹。
example.en: Coloured flags flutter over the sports ground; it's very lively.

example.zh: 这个城市的纺织业非常发达。
example.en: This city's textile industry is highly developed.

gloss: vertical and horizontal; crisscross; freely; unrestrained
meanings: lit. warp and weft in weaving; vertically and horizontal
abbr. for 合纵连横, School of Diplomacy during the Warring States Period (475-221 BC)

example.zh: 城市里道路纵横，交通十分方便。
example.en: The city is crisscrossed with roads, making transport very convenient.

gloss: to skip class; to play truant; to cut school
indonesian: bolos sekolah; membolos; tidak masuk kelas

example.zh: 他这学期已经旷课三次了。
example.en: He has already skipped class three times this term.

gloss: literature and art; the arts; artsy
indonesian: sastra dan seni; kesenian; berjiwa seni

example.zh: 学校每年都会举办文艺晚会。
example.en: The school holds an arts evening every year.

gloss: up to (a time); as of; by

example.zh: 截至昨天，报名人数已经超过五百人。
example.en: As of yesterday, the number of applicants had exceeded five hundred.

example.zh: 这位医生在当地享有很高的威望。
example.en: This doctor enjoys great prestige locally.

gloss: to be mixed with; to be mingled with; to be interspersed with

example.zh: 他说话时常常夹杂着几句英语。
example.en: He often mixes a few English words into his speech.

gloss: heroic; brave; glorious (esp. of a sacrifice)

example.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个壮烈的历史故事。
example.en: This film tells a heroic story from history.

gloss: conversely; on the other hand; otherwise

example.zh: 努力就会进步，反之就会落后。
example.en: If you work hard you'll progress; otherwise you'll fall behind.

example.zh: 中国人历来重视家庭教育。
example.en: Chinese people have always valued family education.

gloss: sense of propriety; proper limits; tact
indonesian: batas kewajaran; takaran yang pas; kebijaksanaan

example.zh: 开玩笑也要注意分寸。
example.en: Even when joking, you need to know where to draw the line.

gloss: to jeer; to create a disturbance; to tease (in a group)

example.zh: 他一上台，同学们就开始起哄。
example.en: As soon as he went on stage, his classmates started jeering and cheering.

gloss: to implement; to carry out; to put into practice

example.zh: 新的规定必须认真贯彻执行。
example.en: The new regulations must be conscientiously implemented.

gloss: to contain; to hold in store; to have latent (resources)

example.zh: 这片土地下蕴藏着丰富的石油。
example.en: This land holds rich oil reserves.

gloss: equal; to be equal to; equivalent

example.zh: 这两个房间的面积大致相等。
example.en: The two rooms are roughly equal in area.

gloss: bank (of a river or lake); side; edge

example.zh: 我们在湖畔找了一家安静的小旅馆。
example.en: We found a quiet little hotel by the lake.

gloss: coastal; along the coast; coastal area

example.zh: 沿海城市的经济发展得比较快。
example.en: The economy of coastal cities has developed relatively quickly.

gloss: to slander; to smear; to vilify

example.zh: 你没有证据，不能随便污蔑别人。
example.en: You have no evidence; you can't just slander others.

example.zh: 教育孩子要讲道理，不能靠棍棒。
example.en: Raise children with reason, not with the stick.

example.zh: 一只小鸟站在树梢上唱歌。
example.en: A little bird is singing at the top of the tree.

example.zh: 新生们正在操场上进行队列操练。
example.en: The new students are doing formation drills on the sports field.

gloss: to support by the arm; to help (someone) along; to mix
meanings: to take by the arm and assist

example.zh: 他搀着老人慢慢地过了马路。
example.en: He helped the old man slowly across the road, holding his arm.

gloss: to draw up; to draft; to formulate

example.zh: 我们已经拟定了下半年的工作计划。
example.en: We have drawn up the work plan for the second half of the year.

gloss: wide gap; great disparity; widely different

example.zh: 两个队实力悬殊，比赛毫无悬念。
example.en: The two teams were so unevenly matched that the result was never in doubt.

example.zh: 学生恭敬地向老师鞠了一躬。
example.en: The student bowed respectfully to the teacher.

gloss: in the final analysis; ultimately; when all is said and done

example.zh: 归根到底，成功还是要靠自己的努力。
example.en: In the final analysis, success still depends on your own efforts.

example.zh: 这则寓言告诉我们做事不能骄傲。
example.en: This fable teaches us not to be arrogant.

example.zh: 现在年轻人的生活方式越来越多元化。
example.en: Young people's lifestyles are becoming more and more diverse.

gloss: to make a racket; noisy; uproar

example.zh: 图书馆里请保持安静，不要大声喧哗。
example.en: Please keep quiet in the library and don't make a noise.

gloss: to breastfeed; to suckle; to nurse

example.zh: 鲸鱼虽然生活在海里，却是哺乳动物。
example.en: Although whales live in the sea, they are mammals.

gloss: to enlighten; to teach the basics to beginners; enlightenment

example.zh: 我的音乐启蒙老师是我的母亲。
example.en: My first music teacher was my mother.

example.zh: 俗话说得好，熟能生巧。
example.en: As the saying goes, practice makes perfect.

gloss: to go the wrong way; to drive against the traffic

example.zh: 在单行道上逆行是很危险的。
example.en: Driving the wrong way on a one-way street is very dangerous.

example.zh: 这个词带有贬义，用的时候要小心。
example.en: This word has a negative connotation, so be careful when using it.

gloss: to be completed (of a building); completion

example.zh: 新图书馆将于明年春天落成。
example.en: The new library will be completed next spring.

gloss: to keep as a souvenir; to keep as a memento

example.zh: 毕业那天，我们在校门口拍照留念。
example.en: On graduation day, we took photos at the school gate as a keepsake.

gloss: to consider carefully; to deliberate; to weigh
meanings: to fill up a cup to the brim

example.zh: 这件事很重要，你要好好斟酌一下。
example.en: This matter is important; you should think it over carefully.

gloss: to sow discord; to incite; to stir up trouble

example.zh: 别听他的，他是在挑拨我们的关系。
example.en: Don't listen to him; he's trying to sow discord between us.

gloss: to contract (for a job); to undertake; contract

example.zh: 这个工程由一家建筑公司承包。
example.en: This project has been contracted to a construction company.

example.zh: 在批发市场买东西比商店便宜多了。
example.en: Buying things at the wholesale market is much cheaper than in shops.

example.zh: 他的汉语基础打得很扎实。
example.en: He has a very solid foundation in Chinese.

example.zh: 我们要打破固有的思维方式。
example.en: We need to break out of our established ways of thinking.

example.zh: 这家工厂已经连续三年亏损了。
example.en: This factory has been losing money for three years in a row.

indonesian: sangat dingin; dingin yang menggigit; musim dingin yang parah

example.zh: 冬天这里非常严寒，气温常常在零下二十度。
example.en: Winters here are bitterly cold, often twenty degrees below zero.

example.zh: 这个城市的手机市场已经基本饱和了。
example.en: This city's mobile phone market is already basically saturated.

example.zh: 这条山路十分陡峭，大家要小心。
example.en: This mountain path is very steep, so everyone be careful.

example.zh: 他谢绝了朋友的帮助，决定自己解决。
example.en: He politely declined his friend's help and decided to solve it himself.

example.zh: 取得一点成绩就自满，是不会进步的。
example.en: If you get complacent after a little success, you won't make progress.

gloss: to smear; to apply (cream, paint); to scribble

example.zh: 出门前，记得在脸上涂抹防晒霜。
example.en: Before going out, remember to put sunscreen on your face.

gloss: legal person; legal entity; legal representative

example.zh: 他是这家公司的法人代表。
example.en: He is the legal representative of this company.

indonesian: barang cacat; produk di bawah standar

example.zh: 如果买到次品，可以要求退换。
example.en: If you buy a defective product, you can ask for a refund or exchange.

gloss: terrain; topography; lie of the land

example.zh: 中国的地势西高东低。
example.en: China's terrain is high in the west and low in the east.

gloss: worthwhile; cost-effective; a good deal; to reckon up

example.zh: 买年卡比每次买票合算多了。
example.en: Buying an annual pass is much better value than buying a ticket each time.

gloss: to strive for; to work hard for; to argue strongly
indonesian: berusaha keras meraih; berjuang untuk; bersikeras berargumen

example.zh: 我们力争在年底前完成这个项目。
example.en: We are striving to finish this project before the end of the year.

meanings: secretary (chief official of a branch of a socialist or communist party)

example.zh: 村里的书记每天都很忙。
example.en: The village Party secretary is very busy every day.

gloss: to shelter from; to block; to keep out

example.zh: 窗帘可以遮挡强烈的阳光。
example.en: The curtains can keep out the strong sunlight.

example.zh: 天冷了，出门多穿件衣裳。
example.en: It's getting cold; put on an extra layer when you go out.

gloss: meat or fish dish; non-vegetarian food
indonesian: makanan berdaging; lauk daging atau ikan

example.zh: 他不吃荤，只吃素菜。
example.en: He doesn't eat meat or fish, only vegetarian dishes.

example.zh: 枝头上长满了粉红色的花蕾。
example.en: The branches are covered in pink flower buds.

example.zh: 港口里停着几艘巨大的舰艇。
example.en: Several huge naval vessels are docked in the port.

example.zh: 这个部门的主要职能是管理人事。
example.en: The main function of this department is managing personnel.

meanings: to have a strong interest in

example.zh: 他对中国历史有浓厚的兴趣。
example.en: He has a strong interest in Chinese history.

example.zh: 双方正在洽谈合作的具体细节。
example.en: The two sides are negotiating the specific details of the cooperation.

example.zh: 这套房子的格局设计得很合理。
example.en: The layout of this flat is very well designed.

indonesian: berurat berakar; mendarah daging; sudah mengakar

example.zh: 有些传统观念在人们心中根深蒂固。
example.en: Some traditional ideas are deeply rooted in people's minds.

gloss: to tremble; to shiver; to quiver

example.zh: 外面太冷了，他冻得直哆嗦。
example.en: It was so cold outside that he was shivering non-stop.

gloss: as early as possible; before it is too late; promptly
meanings: at the earliest possible time; as soon as possible

example.zh: 身体不舒服要及早去医院检查。
example.en: If you feel unwell, get checked at the hospital as early as possible.

gloss: to cut the ribbon; ribbon-cutting ceremony
meanings: to cut the ribbon (at a launching or opening ceremony)

example.zh: 市长亲自为新商场开业剪彩。
example.en: The mayor personally cut the ribbon at the opening of the new shopping mall.

example.zh: 站在辽阔的草原上，心情格外舒畅。
example.en: Standing on the vast grassland, you feel especially carefree.

example.zh: 雨季过后，山上的树木长得很茂盛。
example.en: After the rainy season, the trees on the mountain grow lush.

example.zh: 这里土地肥沃，适合种植水稻。
example.en: The land here is fertile and suitable for growing rice.

gloss: unprecedented and unrepeatable; unique in history
indonesian: belum pernah ada dan tak akan terulang; satu-satunya dalam sejarah
meanings: unprecedented and never to be duplicated

example.zh: 那场演唱会的盛况可以说是空前绝后。
example.en: The scale of that concert could be called unprecedented and never to be repeated.

gloss: self-criticism; to examine oneself critically; to review

example.zh: 他迟到了好几次，被要求写检讨。
example.en: He was late several times and was asked to write a self-criticism.

gloss: meticulous; in every possible way; thoughtful to the smallest detail
indonesian: penuh perhatian sampai hal terkecil; sangat teliti

example.zh: 护士对病人的照顾无微不至。
example.en: The nurses take care of the patients in every possible way.

gloss: to carry on one's arm; to carry over one's shoulder or at one's side
indonesian: menenteng di lengan; menyandang di bahu
meanings: to carry (esp. slung over the arm, shoulder or side)

example.zh: 她挎着一个篮子去菜市场买菜。
example.en: She went to the market with a basket on her arm.

gloss: to stand side by side; to be juxtaposed; tied (in ranking)

example.zh: 这次比赛，他们两人并列第一。
example.en: In this competition, the two of them tied for first place.

gloss: good value; affordable; practical; material benefit

example.zh: 这家餐厅的菜又好吃又实惠。
example.en: The food at this restaurant is both tasty and good value.

gloss: is bound to; will certainly; inevitably
indonesian: pasti akan; mau tidak mau; tak terelakkan

example.zh: 不按时吃饭，势必会影响健康。
example.en: Not eating on time is bound to affect your health.

gloss: to keep up the good work; to make persistent efforts
indonesian: terus berusaha lebih keras; pertahankan dan tingkatkan
meanings: to continue the struggle (idiom); to persist

example.zh: 这次考得不错，希望你再接再厉。
example.en: You did well on this exam; keep up the good work.

meanings: Xinglong county in Chengde 德, Hebei

example.zh: 祝您生意兴隆，财源广进！
example.en: Wishing you a thriving business and abundant wealth!

gloss: general mood; prevailing practice; social atmosphere
indonesian: suasana umum; kebiasaan yang berlaku; iklim sosial

example.zh: 我们班的学习风气很好。
example.en: Our class has a very good study atmosphere.

example.zh: 明天上午有零星小雨。
example.en: There will be scattered light showers tomorrow morning.

example.zh: 这家公司资金雄厚，技术先进。
example.en: This company has abundant funds and advanced technology.

gloss: to link up; to connect; to join
meanings: to link up; to connect; to join

example.zh: 这两段文字衔接得不太自然。
example.en: These two passages don't link up very naturally.

example.zh: 这双鞋虽然贵，但是很耐用。
example.en: These shoes are expensive, but very durable.

gloss: attractive; pleasing to the eye; good-looking

example.zh: 这款家具既美观又实用。
example.en: This furniture is both attractive and practical.

gloss: to love something too much to put it down; to treasure
indonesian: sangat menyukai sampai tidak mau melepaskannya; sangat menyayangi
meanings: (idiom) to like sth so much that one is reluctant to put it down; to find sth utterly irresistible

example.zh: 这本小说太好看了，我读得爱不释手。
example.en: This novel is so good that I can't put it down.

gloss: eyes brimming with tears; deeply moved
indonesian: mata berlinang air mata; sangat terharu
meanings: eyes brimming with tears of excitement (idiom)

example.zh: 看到久别的父母，她激动得热泪盈眶。
example.en: Seeing her parents after so long, she was so moved that her eyes filled with tears.

gloss: to slight; to neglect (a guest); to treat coldly
indonesian: mengabaikan; kurang melayani (tamu); memperlakukan dengan dingin

example.zh: 招待不周，怠慢了各位，请多包涵。
example.en: Forgive us if we haven't looked after you all properly.

example.zh: 他虽然出身贫寒，但很有志气。
example.en: Although he came from a poor family, he was full of ambition.

meanings: systemic problem (sometimes refers specifically to corrupt practices)

example.zh: 这种管理方式存在很多弊端。
example.en: This management approach has many drawbacks.

gloss: to hem and haw; to mumble; to speak hesitantly
indonesian: berbicara terbata-bata; ragu-ragu; tidak terus terang

example.zh: 有话直说，别这么吞吞吐吐的。
example.en: If you have something to say, say it straight out; don't hem and haw.

gloss: conscientious and diligent; dedicated; cautious and meticulous
indonesian: tekun dan teliti; penuh dedikasi; bekerja dengan sungguh-sungguh

example.zh: 他在这个岗位上兢兢业业工作了二十年。
example.en: He worked conscientiously in this post for twenty years.

gloss: to increase day by day; to grow with each passing day
indonesian: bertambah dari hari ke hari; terus meningkat
meanings: to grow with each passing day

example.zh: 随着年龄增长，他对家乡的思念与日俱增。
example.en: As he grows older, his longing for his hometown grows day by day.

gloss: to echo; to chime in with; to go along with

example.zh: 他没有自己的看法，只会附和别人。
example.en: He has no views of his own and just echoes what others say.

gloss: to adjust; to regulate; to make up for shortages; to vary
meanings: to make up a medical prescription

example.zh: 周末出去走走，可以调剂一下生活。
example.en: Going out at the weekend can add some variety to life.

gloss: to act bravely for a just cause; to do the right thing courageously
indonesian: berani membela kebenaran; bertindak berani demi keadilan
meanings: to see what is right and act courageously (idiom, from Analects); to stand up bravely for the truth
acting heroically in a just cause

example.zh: 他见义勇为，帮助警察抓住了小偷。
example.en: He bravely stepped in and helped the police catch the thief.

gloss: to one's heart's content; perfectly satisfactory; just as one wishes
indonesian: sesuai keinginan; memuaskan hati; sesuai harapan
meanings: (idiom) after one's own heart; gratifying; satisfactory; everything one could wish

example.zh: 他终于找到了一份称心如意的工作。
example.en: He finally found a job that was just what he wanted.

example.zh: 这幅画把老人的神态画得栩栩如生。
example.en: This painting captures the old man's expression vividly.

gloss: to break in; to wear in; to adapt to each other
indonesian: saling menyesuaikan diri; masa adaptasi; inreyen (mesin)

example.zh: 新同事之间需要一段时间来磨合。
example.en: New colleagues need some time to get used to working with each other.

example.zh: 他跑得太快，呼吸变得十分短促。
example.en: He ran so fast that his breathing became very short.

gloss: to abound in; to be rich in; to produce in abundance
indonesian: banyak menghasilkan; kaya akan; penghasil utama

example.zh: 这个地区盛产苹果和葡萄。
example.en: This region produces apples and grapes in abundance.

example.zh: 这座建筑设计得很有气魄。
example.en: This building is designed on a grand scale.

gloss: to expand; to augment; to extend

example.zh: 图书馆计划扩充藏书数量。
example.en: The library plans to expand its collection of books.

gloss: at someone's invitation; to accept an invitation

example.zh: 他应邀参加了朋友的婚礼。
example.en: He attended his friend's wedding at their invitation.

example.zh: 他屡次迟到，被经理批评了。
example.en: He was late repeatedly and was criticized by the manager.

example.zh: 这次宣传活动声势很大。
example.en: This publicity campaign has tremendous momentum.

gloss: to ban; to outlaw; to suppress
meanings: to suppress; to crack down on; to prohibit

example.zh: 这些无证经营的小摊已经被取缔了。
example.en: These unlicensed stalls have been banned.

example.zh: 闻到烤鸭的香味，我馋得直流口水。
example.en: Smelling the roast duck, my mouth was watering with craving.

gloss: to prevent and cure; prevention and treatment
indonesian: mencegah dan mengobati; pencegahan dan pengobatan

example.zh: 医院开展了感冒防治的宣传活动。
example.en: The hospital launched a campaign on preventing and treating colds.

gloss: to seek; to strive for; to pursue

example.zh: 两家公司希望谋求长期的合作。
example.en: The two companies hope to seek long-term cooperation.

gloss: to implement; to carry out; to ensure; practicable

example.zh: 这个计划什么时候能落实？
example.en: When can this plan be implemented?

gloss: to put an end to; to eliminate; to stamp out

example.zh: 我们要杜绝浪费粮食的现象。
example.en: We must put an end to wasting food.

example.zh: 今年公司的经济效益明显提高了。
example.en: The company's economic returns have clearly improved this year.

gloss: to levy; to collect (taxes); to expropriate

example.zh: 政府决定对进口汽车征收更高的税。
example.en: The government decided to levy higher taxes on imported cars.

example.zh: 过多使用化肥会破坏土壤。
example.en: Using too much chemical fertilizer can damage the soil.

gloss: to explore; to survey; to prospect (for minerals)

example.zh: 专家们正在这一带勘探石油。
example.en: Experts are prospecting for oil in this area.

gloss: to check and accept; to inspect before acceptance; acceptance inspection
indonesian: memeriksa dan menerima; serah terima setelah pemeriksaan

example.zh: 新教学楼已经通过了验收。
example.en: The new teaching building has passed its acceptance inspection.

example.zh: 她在一所聋哑学校当老师。
example.en: She teaches at a school for the deaf and mute.

gloss: to pay (fees, taxes); to hand in

example.zh: 请在月底前缴纳本学期的学费。
example.en: Please pay this term's tuition before the end of the month.

example.zh: 台湾和香港现在仍然使用繁体字。
example.en: Taiwan and Hong Kong still use traditional characters today.

example.zh: 这座立交桥大大缓解了交通压力。
example.en: This flyover has greatly eased traffic pressure.

gloss: to consult; to negotiate; to discuss seriously

example.zh: 经过多次磋商，双方终于达成了协议。
example.en: After several rounds of negotiation, the two sides finally reached an agreement.

example.zh: 熊猫是一种珍稀动物。
example.en: The panda is a rare and precious animal.

gloss: to influence gradually; to nurture; edifying influence
indonesian: mempengaruhi secara bertahap; membentuk; pengaruh positif

example.zh: 在父亲的熏陶下，他从小就爱上了音乐。
example.en: Under his father's influence, he fell in love with music as a child.

gloss: water conservancy; irrigation works; water resources
indonesian: pengairan; irigasi; pengelolaan sumber daya air

example.zh: 政府投入大量资金修建水利工程。
example.en: The government has invested heavily in building water conservancy projects.

gloss: to popularize; to spread widely; widespread; universal

example.zh: 如今智能手机已经非常普及了。
example.en: Nowadays smartphones have become extremely widespread.

gloss: eager for quick success and instant benefit; short-sighted
indonesian: ingin cepat berhasil dan untung; berpikiran pendek
meanings: seeking instant benefit (idiom); shortsighted vision, looking only for fast return

example.zh: 做学问不能急功近利。
example.en: In scholarly work you can't be eager for quick success.

gloss: to proceed step by step; to advance gradually
indonesian: bertahap; selangkah demi selangkah; secara berangsur-angsur
meanings: in sequence, step by step (idiom); to make steady progress incrementally

example.zh: 学外语要循序渐进，不能着急。
example.en: Learning a foreign language must be done step by step; you can't rush.

gloss: to emerge one after another; endless; never-ending
indonesian: terus bermunculan; tiada habisnya; silih berganti

example.zh: 网络上的新词层出不穷。
example.en: New words keep emerging on the internet one after another.

gloss: nearby; in the neighbourhood; without going far
indonesian: di dekat; terdekat; tanpa pergi jauh

example.zh: 孩子们可以就近上学，非常方便。
example.en: The children can go to school nearby, which is very convenient.

gloss: to be practical and realistic; to seek truth from facts
meanings: lit. to seek truth from facts (idiom)
fig. to be practical and realistic

example.zh: 写报告要实事求是，不能夸大。
example.en: A report must stick to the facts, without exaggeration.

meanings: to leave nothing to be desired

example.zh: 这家医院的设备十分完备。
example.en: This hospital is very well equipped.

example.zh: 我宁肯自己多干点，也不想麻烦别人。
example.en: I'd rather do more myself than trouble others.

gloss: family happiness; the joy of family life
indonesian: kebahagiaan keluarga; kebahagiaan berkumpul dengan keluarga

example.zh: 退休后，爷爷在家享受天伦之乐。
example.en: After retiring, Grandpa enjoys the happiness of family life at home.

gloss: to bear hardships; to suffer; to endure difficulties
indonesian: menanggung kesusahan; bersusah payah; tahan menderita

example.zh: 年轻人应该能吃苦，多锻炼自己。
example.en: Young people should be able to endure hardship and push themselves.

example.zh: 儒家思想对中国文化影响深远。
example.en: Confucian thought has had a profound influence on Chinese culture.

gloss: to propose; to initiate; proposal; initiative

example.zh: 学生会倡议大家节约用水。
example.en: The student union is calling on everyone to save water.

example.zh: 养成规律的作息习惯对身体有好处。
example.en: Developing a regular routine of work and rest is good for your health.

gloss: to strive to be first; to scramble; to vie with one another
indonesian: berebut ingin menjadi yang pertama; berlomba-lomba
meanings: striving to be first and fearing to be last (idiom); outdoing one another

example.zh: 老师一提问，同学们争先恐后地举手。
example.en: As soon as the teacher asked a question, the students vied to raise their hands.

gloss: to look around; to glance about in all directions
indonesian: menoleh ke sana ke mari; celingak-celinguk

example.zh: 上课时别东张西望，要认真听讲。
example.en: Don't look around in class; listen carefully.

example.zh: 他是我们部门的业务骨干。
example.en: He is the backbone of our department's operations.

gloss: isolated; remote; ill-informed; to block up

example.zh: 以前这个山村交通闭塞，消息不灵通。
example.en: This mountain village used to be cut off, and news was slow to arrive.

example.zh: 他的文章内容贫乏，缺少新意。
example.en: His article is thin on content and lacks fresh ideas.

example.zh: 城市扩张占用了大量耕地。
example.en: Urban expansion has taken over a large amount of farmland.

example.zh: 这个省的矿产资源非常丰富。
example.en: This province is very rich in mineral resources.

gloss: to look at with reverence; to pay one's respects (to)
indonesian: memandang dengan hormat; berziarah; memberi penghormatan

example.zh: 每年都有很多游客来这里瞻仰名人故居。
example.en: Every year many visitors come here to pay their respects at the former residence.

example.zh: 四川盆地夏天又闷又热。
example.en: The Sichuan Basin is hot and humid in summer.

gloss: good quality and inexpensive; good value for money
indonesian: bagus dan murah; berkualitas dengan harga terjangkau

example.zh: 这家超市的商品物美价廉。
example.en: The goods in this supermarket are good quality and cheap.

gloss: to be convinced; to accept (a defeat) willingly

example.zh: 输给这么强的对手，我很服气。
example.en: Losing to such a strong opponent, I accept it wholeheartedly.

example.zh: 这条河是长江的一条支流。
example.en: This river is a tributary of the Yangtze.

gloss: to suddenly realize; to suddenly see the light

example.zh: 听了老师的解释，我才恍然大悟。
example.en: Only after hearing the teacher's explanation did it suddenly dawn on me.

gloss: aesthetic; aesthetic sense; appreciation of beauty

example.zh: 每个人的审美标准都不一样。
example.en: Everyone's aesthetic standards are different.

gloss: to lay (a foundation); to establish; to settle

example.zh: 大学的学习为他今后的工作奠定了基础。
example.en: His university studies laid the foundation for his future career.

gloss: to urge repeatedly; to exhort; to remind (someone to do something)

example.zh: 医生叮嘱他按时吃药，多休息。
example.en: The doctor reminded him repeatedly to take his medicine on time and rest more.

example.zh: 我们在湖边的亭子里休息了一会儿。
example.en: We rested for a while in the pavilion by the lake.

example.zh: 这一带是丘陵地区，适合种茶。
example.en: This area is hilly and suitable for growing tea.

gloss: to kill two birds with one stone; to gain two ends at once
indonesian: sekali dayung dua pulau terlampaui; satu tindakan dua manfaat
meanings: one move, two gains (idiom); two birds with one stone

example.zh: 骑车上班既省钱又锻炼身体，一举两得。
example.en: Cycling to work saves money and gives you exercise: two birds with one stone.

gloss: experienced and knowledgeable; well-travelled and well-informed

example.zh: 他去过很多国家，见多识广。
example.en: He's been to many countries and is very experienced and knowledgeable.

meanings: piece of writing submitted for publication

example.zh: 编辑部每天都会收到大量稿件。
example.en: The editorial office receives a large number of manuscripts every day.

gloss: to ruin something by adding something superfluous; to overdo it
indonesian: melakukan hal berlebihan yang justru merusak; berlebihan
meanings: lit. draw legs on a snake (idiom); fig. to ruin the effect by adding sth superfluous

example.zh: 文章已经很好了，再改就画蛇添足了。
example.en: The essay is already good; changing it further would just spoil it.

gloss: to settle; to precipitate; sediment; to accumulate (experience)

example.zh: 把水放一会儿，让杂质沉淀下来。
example.en: Let the water stand for a while so the impurities settle.

gloss: to invite bids; to invite tenders

example.zh: 这个工程将通过公开招标选择施工单位。
example.en: The contractor for this project will be chosen through open tender.

example.zh: 这孩子太娇气了，一点苦都吃不了。
example.en: This child is too pampered and can't bear the slightest hardship.

example.zh: 苏州的园林在世界上很有名。
example.en: The gardens of Suzhou are world-famous.

gloss: worries about things back home; fears of trouble behind
indonesian: kekhawatiran akan urusan di rumah; beban pikiran
meanings: fears of trouble in the rear (idiom); family worries (obstructing freedom of action)
often in negative expressions, meaning "no worries about anything"

example.zh: 公司解决了员工孩子上学的后顾之忧。
example.en: The company solved employees' worries about their children's schooling.

meanings: an instant (Sanskrit: ksana); split second; the twinkling of an eye

example.zh: 看到他的那一刹那，我高兴得哭了。
example.en: The instant I saw him, I cried with joy.

gloss: in high spirits; full of enthusiasm
meanings: to become exhilarated (idiom); in high spirits

example.zh: 孩子们兴致勃勃地参观了动物园。
example.en: The children visited the zoo full of enthusiasm.

gloss: to total; to add up to; in total

example.zh: 这次活动共计花费两万元。
example.en: This event cost a total of twenty thousand yuan.

indonesian: tidak dapat menahan diri; mau tak mau; tanpa sadar

example.zh: 想起小时候的事，她不由得笑了。
example.en: Thinking of her childhood, she couldn't help smiling.

gloss: I don't deserve it; you flatter me; I'm not worthy
indonesian: tidak berani menerima; terlalu memuji; saya tidak pantas
meanings: lit. I dare not (accept the honor); fig. I don't deserve your praise

example.zh: 您太过奖了，我实在不敢当。
example.en: You're praising me too much; I really don't deserve it.

gloss: rosy clouds; morning or evening glow
indonesian: awan merah; cahaya fajar atau senja
meanings: rose-tinted sky or clouds at sunrise or sunset

example.zh: 傍晚时分，天边布满了彩霞。
example.en: At dusk, the horizon was covered with rosy clouds.

example.zh: 东部沿海地区人口稠密。
example.en: The eastern coastal region is densely populated.

gloss: to fell (trees); to cut down; to log

example.zh: 禁止在这片森林里乱砍伐树木。
example.en: Indiscriminate felling of trees in this forest is prohibited.

gloss: it is reported that; according to reports

example.zh: 据悉，这部电影将于下月上映。
example.en: It is reported that this film will be released next month.

gloss: tall and straight; upright and strong

example.zh: 路边的白杨树又高又挺拔。
example.en: The poplars along the road are tall and straight.

gloss: to sigh with emotion; to be filled with emotion; emotional reflection
indonesian: terharu; merenung penuh perasaan; berkeluh kesah
meanings: to sigh with sorrow, regret etc

example.zh: 回到母校，他感慨万千。
example.en: Back at his old school, he was filled with all sorts of emotions.

example.zh: 奶奶的一些想法比较封建。
example.en: Some of Grandma's ideas are rather old-fashioned.

gloss: to rely on; to depend on; support; backing
indonesian: bersandar pada; bergantung pada; landasan; dukungan

example.zh: 这个小镇依托旅游业发展经济。
example.en: This small town relies on tourism to develop its economy.

gloss: year by year; year after year
indonesian: dari tahun ke tahun; tahun demi tahun

example.zh: 这里的游客人数逐年增加。
example.en: The number of tourists here increases year by year.

gloss: virtuous; kind and considerate (of a woman); good-natured

example.zh: 他的妻子又贤惠又能干。
example.en: His wife is both virtuous and capable.

gloss: to concentrate one's attention; to be absorbed

example.zh: 学生们聚精会神地听老师讲课。
example.en: The students listened to the teacher with complete concentration.

gloss: to budget carefully; to calculate meticulously; thrifty
indonesian: berhitung cermat; hemat; mengatur keuangan dengan teliti

example.zh: 妈妈过日子总是精打细算。
example.en: Mum always budgets very carefully in daily life.

example.zh: 春天来了，田野里一片欣欣向荣的景象。
example.en: Spring has come, and the fields are a picture of flourishing growth.

example.zh: 祝愿我们的祖国繁荣昌盛。
example.en: May our motherland be prosperous and flourishing.

gloss: to change with each passing day; rapid progress
indonesian: berubah dengan cepat setiap hari; kemajuan pesat

example.zh: 科学技术的发展日新月异。
example.en: Science and technology are developing rapidly day by day.

gloss: to check; to control quality; to guard a pass

example.zh: 产品出厂前，质检员要严格把关。
example.en: Before products leave the factory, inspectors must check them strictly.

gloss: the gains do not make up for the losses; not worth it
indonesian: lebih banyak ruginya daripada untungnya; tidak sepadan
meanings: the gains do not make up for the losses (idiom)

example.zh: 为了省钱而累坏身体，真是得不偿失。
example.en: Wearing yourself out to save money really isn't worth it.

example.zh: 学校门口贴出了放假的布告。
example.en: A holiday notice was posted at the school gate.

gloss: extremely urgent; to brook no delay

example.zh: 保护环境已经刻不容缓了。
example.en: Protecting the environment is now extremely urgent.

gloss: demand exceeds supply; in short supply

example.zh: 这款新手机一上市就供不应求。
example.en: As soon as this new phone went on sale, demand exceeded supply.

example.zh: 做完饭后，记得把炉灶擦干净。
example.en: After cooking, remember to wipe the stove clean.

example.zh: 服务业在经济中所占的比重越来越大。
example.en: The service sector accounts for an ever larger share of the economy.

gloss: to be lost in thought; to be spellbound; to be in a trance

example.zh: 她望着窗外出神，连我进来都没发现。
example.en: She was gazing out of the window, lost in thought, and didn't even notice me come in.

gloss: survival of the fittest; the strong win and the weak are eliminated
indonesian: yang kuat bertahan, yang lemah tersingkir; seleksi alam

example.zh: 市场竞争遵循优胜劣汰的规律。
example.en: Market competition follows the law of survival of the fittest.

gloss: notice; guidelines; instructions; one should know that
indonesian: hal yang perlu diketahui; petunjuk; ketentuan
meanings: it must be borne in mind

example.zh: 考试前请仔细阅读考生须知。
example.en: Please read the candidate instructions carefully before the exam.

example.zh: 他大学毕业后去边疆当了老师。
example.en: After graduating, he went to the border region to be a teacher.

example.zh: 这份文件是公司未来五年的发展纲领。
example.en: This document is the company's guiding programme for the next five years.

gloss: first month of the lunar year; first lunar month
indonesian: bulan pertama kalender imlek; bulan satu imlek
meanings: first month of the lunar year

example.zh: 正月十五是元宵节，要吃汤圆。
example.en: The fifteenth day of the first lunar month is the Lantern Festival, when people eat tangyuan.

gloss: to revitalize; to promote vigorously; to revive
meanings: Zhengxing district of Dandong city 丹东市, Liaoning
to revive; to revitalize; to invigorate; to re-energize

example.zh: 政府出台政策振兴乡村经济。
example.en: The government introduced policies to revitalize the rural economy.

gloss: to forget to eat and sleep; to be totally absorbed (in work)
indonesian: lupa makan dan tidur; tenggelam dalam pekerjaan

example.zh: 为了完成研究，他废寝忘食地工作。
example.en: To finish the research, he worked so hard he forgot to eat and sleep.

example.zh: 雨季来临前，工人们加固了堤坝。
example.en: Before the rainy season, the workers reinforced the dyke.

indonesian: tidak rata; bergelombang; cekung dan cembung

example.zh: 这条小路凹凸不平，走路要小心。
example.en: This path is bumpy and uneven, so watch your step.

example.zh: 很多乡镇企业发展得很快。
example.en: Many township enterprises have developed very quickly.

indonesian: tidak terhindarkan; mau tidak mau; pasti

example.zh: 第一次上台演讲，他不免有些紧张。
example.en: Giving a speech on stage for the first time, he was inevitably a bit nervous.

indonesian: langka dan patut dihargai; sangat terpuji

example.zh: 他这么年轻就这么懂事，真是难能可贵。
example.en: It's truly remarkable that he's so sensible at such a young age.

gloss: to persevere; to keep at it; unflagging
meanings: to chip away at a task and not abandon it (idiom); to chisel away at sth

example.zh: 只要锲而不舍，就一定能学好汉语。
example.en: As long as you persevere, you will definitely master Chinese.

example.zh: 我们要辩证地看待这个问题。
example.en: We should look at this problem dialectically.

indonesian: mempengaruhi secara diam-diam; pengaruh tak kasat mata

example.zh: 父母的言行会潜移默化地影响孩子。
example.en: Parents' words and deeds subtly influence their children.

example.zh: 学校食堂专门设有清真窗口。
example.en: The school canteen has a dedicated halal counter.

gloss: off season; low season; slack season

example.zh: 旅游淡季的机票比较便宜。
example.en: Flights are cheaper in the off season.

meanings: qigong, a traditional Chinese system of cultivating vital energy 气 through coordinated breathing, movement and meditation

example.zh: 每天早上公园里都有人练气功。
example.en: Every morning there are people practising qigong in the park.

indonesian: dengan tegas; tanpa ragu; dengan mantap

example.zh: 他毅然放弃了高薪工作，回乡创业。
example.en: He resolutely gave up a high-paying job and returned home to start a business.

example.zh: 他为人正直，一身正气。
example.en: He is an honest man, full of integrity.

example.zh: 唐朝是中国历史上最繁荣的朝代之一。
example.en: The Tang was one of the most prosperous dynasties in Chinese history.

indonesian: tegas dan pasti; tanpa ragu; mantap
meanings: lit. to chop the nail and slice the iron (idiom)
fig. resolute and decisive; unhesitating; categorical

example.zh: 他斩钉截铁地拒绝了这个要求。
example.en: He flatly refused the request.

example.zh: 这门课主要研究微观经济学。
example.en: This course mainly studies microeconomics.

gloss: honest and clean; incorruptible; free of corruption

example.zh: 老百姓希望官员廉洁奉公。
example.en: Ordinary people hope officials will be honest and serve the public.

example.zh: 这本书的序言是一位著名作家写的。
example.en: The preface to this book was written by a famous author.

example.zh: 政府加强了对经济的宏观调控。
example.en: The government has strengthened macro-level regulation of the economy.

gloss: successive dynasties; past generations; through the ages

example.zh: 博物馆收藏了历代名人的书法作品。
example.en: The museum holds calligraphy by famous figures from successive dynasties.

gloss: local customs and conditions; local conditions and customs
indonesian: adat istiadat dan kondisi setempat; budaya lokal

example.zh: 旅游可以让我们了解各地的风土人情。
example.en: Travel lets us learn about local customs in different places.

indonesian: gagah berani; berjiwa besar; lapang hati

example.zh: 他说话的语气非常豪迈。
example.en: He speaks in a very bold and heroic tone.

gloss: what one sees and hears; knowledge; experiences
indonesian: apa yang dilihat dan didengar; pengalaman; wawasan
meanings: what one has seen and heard

example.zh: 他把旅途中的见闻写成了一本书。
example.en: He wrote what he saw and heard on his travels into a book.

example.zh: 港口每天有上百艘船舶进出。
example.en: Over a hundred vessels enter and leave the port every day.

gloss: courtesy demands reciprocity; to return a favour
indonesian: kesopanan harus dibalas; saling membalas kebaikan

example.zh: 他送了我礼物，礼尚往来，我也要回送一份。
example.en: He gave me a gift; courtesy demands reciprocity, so I'll give one back.

gloss: provincial capital; capital of a province
indonesian: ibu kota provinsi; pusat pemerintahan provinsi

example.zh: 广州是广东省的省会。
example.en: Guangzhou is the provincial capital of Guangdong.

gloss: to seize; to track down and confiscate; to ferret out
meanings: to track down and seize (a criminal suspect, contraband etc)

example.zh: 海关查获了一批走私手机。
example.en: Customs seized a batch of smuggled mobile phones.

gloss: full of youthful vigour; energetic; vibrant

example.zh: 校园里到处都是朝气蓬勃的年轻人。
example.en: The campus is full of energetic young people.

example.zh: 这种教育方法有不少弊病。
example.en: This teaching method has quite a few drawbacks.

example.zh: 大人尚且搬不动，何况孩子呢？
example.en: Even adults can't move it, let alone children.

example.zh: 她性格外向，很容易交到朋友。
example.en: She is outgoing and makes friends easily.

example.zh: 诗歌和小说是两种不同的文学体裁。
example.en: Poetry and fiction are two different literary genres.

gloss: to shoulder heavy responsibilities over a long road; a long way to go
indonesian: tanggung jawab berat dan jalan masih panjang
meanings: a heavy load and a long road
fig. to bear heavy responsibilities through a long struggle (cf Confucian Analects, 8.7)

example.zh: 保护环境任重道远，需要大家共同努力。
example.en: Protecting the environment is a heavy, long-term task that needs everyone's effort.

example.zh: 本想出去散步，不料下起了大雨。
example.en: I meant to go out for a walk, but unexpectedly it started pouring.

gloss: absolute silence; not a sound to be heard

example.zh: 考试开始后，教室里鸦雀无声。
example.en: Once the exam began, the classroom fell completely silent.

example.zh: 您过奖了，我还差得远呢。
example.en: You flatter me; I still have a long way to go.

gloss: after hardship comes happiness; the bitter is past and the sweet arrives
indonesian: setelah susah datang senang; berakit-rakit ke hulu, berenang-renang ke tepian
meanings: bitterness finishes, sweetness begins (idiom); the hard times are over, the good times just beginning

example.zh: 他们夫妻俩终于苦尽甘来，过上了好日子。
example.en: After all their hardships, the couple finally have a good life.

gloss: to strive for perfection; to keep improving
meanings: to perfect sth that is already outstanding (idiom); constantly improving

example.zh: 他对自己的作品总是精益求精。
example.en: He always strives for perfection in his work.

gloss: place of origin; native place; ancestral home

example.zh: 填表时，请写清楚你的籍贯。
example.en: When filling in the form, please clearly write your place of origin.

example.zh: 秋天到了，田里的稻谷金黄一片。
example.en: Autumn has come, and the rice in the fields is a sea of gold.

example.zh: 下过大雨以后，河水变得很混浊。
example.en: After the heavy rain, the river water became very muddy.

gloss: sheer cliffs; precipice; steep cliff face
meanings: sheer cliffs and precipitous rock faces (idiom)

example.zh: 山上到处都是悬崖峭壁，十分危险。
example.en: The mountain is full of sheer cliffs and very dangerous.

gloss: never-ending flow; continuous stream (of people or traffic)
indonesian: mengalir tiada henti; arus yang tak putus-putus
meanings: the stream flows without stopping (idiom); unending flow

example.zh: 马路上的车辆川流不息。
example.en: There is a never-ending stream of traffic on the road.

gloss: New Year money (given to children); lucky money
indonesian: angpau Tahun Baru Imlek; uang hadiah Imlek untuk anak
meanings: money given to children as a gift on Chinese New Year's Eve

example.zh: 过年时，孩子们最盼望的就是压岁钱。
example.en: At New Year, what children most look forward to is their lucky money.

gloss: to attract worldwide attention; to be the focus of world attention
indonesian: menarik perhatian dunia; menjadi sorotan dunia

example.zh: 这座大桥的建成取得了举世瞩目的成就。
example.en: The completion of this bridge was an achievement that drew worldwide attention.

gloss: in successive years; year after year; for years running

example.zh: 这个地区连年丰收，农民的收入提高了。
example.en: This region has had good harvests for years running, and farmers' incomes have risen.

gloss: birthday (of a respected person); anniversary of birth
indonesian: hari lahir (tokoh terhormat); peringatan hari lahir

example.zh: 今年是这位作家诞辰一百周年。
example.en: This year marks the hundredth anniversary of this writer's birth.

gloss: in an endless stream; continuous; one after another

example.zh: 节假日，来这里参观的游客络绎不绝。
example.en: On holidays, visitors come here in an endless stream.

gloss: contentment brings happiness; to be content with what one has
indonesian: bersyukur membawa kebahagiaan; puas dengan apa yang dimiliki

example.zh: 奶奶常说，做人要知足常乐。
example.en: Grandma often says that being content with what you have brings happiness.

gloss: with relish; with great interest; with gusto
indonesian: dengan lahap; dengan penuh minat; dengan asyik

example.zh: 孩子们津津有味地听爷爷讲故事。
example.en: The children listened to Grandpa's stories with great interest.

gloss: to pay a New Year call; to wish someone a happy New Year
indonesian: berkunjung saat Tahun Baru; mengucapkan selamat Tahun Baru
meanings: to pay a New Year call
to wish sb a Happy New Year

example.zh: 大年初一，我们去亲戚家拜年。
example.en: On the first day of the New Year, we visit relatives to wish them a happy New Year.

gloss: impatient for success; overly eager for quick results
indonesian: terburu-buru ingin berhasil; tidak sabar menunggu hasil
meanings: anxious for quick results (idiom); to demand instant success

example.zh: 学习要一步一步来，不能急于求成。
example.en: Learning should be done step by step; you can't be impatient for results.

gloss: third place; second runner-up; bronze medallist

example.zh: 我们队在这次比赛中获得了季军。
example.en: Our team came third in this competition.

gloss: to act in a way that defeats one's purpose; to go in the opposite direction
indonesian: tindakan yang bertentangan dengan tujuan; berlawanan arah

example.zh: 想减肥却天天吃夜宵，简直是南辕北辙。
example.en: Wanting to lose weight but eating late-night snacks every day is completely self-defeating.

meanings: public security bureau (government office similar in function to a police station)

example.zh: 办理护照需要到公安局去申请。
example.en: To get a passport, you need to apply at the public security bureau.

example.zh: 小女孩有一头乌黑的长发。
example.en: The little girl has long jet-black hair.

example.zh: 我最喜欢吃白菜猪肉馅儿的饺子。
example.en: My favourite dumplings are the ones with cabbage and pork filling.

gloss: to have a get-together; to celebrate together; social gathering
indonesian: pesta bersama; berkumpul merayakan; acara keakraban

example.zh: 新年前，公司举办了一场联欢晚会。
example.en: Before New Year, the company held a party for everyone.

gloss: to complement each other; to supplement one another

example.zh: 学习和休息是相辅相成的。
example.en: Study and rest complement each other.

gloss: animal husbandry; livestock farming; to raise livestock

example.zh: 草原上的居民主要从事畜牧业。
example.en: The grassland residents are mainly engaged in animal husbandry.

example.zh: 我的生肖是龙，你呢？
example.en: My zodiac sign is the dragon. What about you?

gloss: confident because one is in the right; with justified confidence
indonesian: yakin karena merasa benar; percaya diri karena di pihak yang benar
meanings: in the right and self-confident (idiom); bold and confident with justice on one's side
to have the courage of one's convictions

example.zh: 明明是他错了，他却说得理直气壮。
example.en: He was clearly in the wrong, yet he spoke as if fully justified.

gloss: leading authority; master; giant (in a field)

example.zh: 他是中国医学界的泰斗。
example.en: He is a leading authority in Chinese medicine.

gloss: to benefit from association with someone; to bask in reflected glory
meanings: fig. to benefit from association with sb or sth

example.zh: 哥哥考上了名牌大学，全家人都跟着沾光。
example.en: My brother got into a top university, and the whole family shared in the glory.

gloss: positive and negative; plus or minus

example.zh: 这次实验的误差在正负一度以内。
example.en: The error in this experiment was within plus or minus one degree.

example.zh: 她穿着一件红色的旗袍参加婚礼。
example.en: She wore a red qipao to the wedding.

gloss: everyone expresses their own views; to air one's views freely
indonesian: masing-masing menyampaikan pendapat; bebas mengemukakan pandangan

example.zh: 会上大家各抒己见，讨论得很热烈。
example.en: At the meeting everyone gave their own views, and the discussion was lively.

example.zh: 老师勉励我们要继续努力。
example.en: The teacher encouraged us to keep working hard.

gloss: to speak with ease and confidence; to talk freely
indonesian: berbicara dengan lancar dan percaya diri; berbicara panjang lebar

example.zh: 面试时，他在考官面前侃侃而谈。
example.en: In the interview, he spoke with ease and confidence in front of the examiners.

gloss: to increase progressively; to rise steadily

example.zh: 公司的销售额每年以百分之十的速度递增。
example.en: The company's sales increase by ten percent every year.

gloss: eager; enthusiastic; vying with one another

example.zh: 同学们踊跃报名参加志愿者活动。
example.en: Students eagerly signed up for the volunteer activity.

example.zh: 北方冬天很冷，一定要带件羽绒服。
example.en: Winters in the north are cold, so be sure to bring a down jacket.

gloss: longitude and latitude; warp and weft; main threads
indonesian: garis bujur dan lintang; lungsin dan pakan; garis besar

example.zh: 地图上的经纬线可以帮助我们确定位置。
example.en: The lines of longitude and latitude on a map help us pinpoint locations.

example.zh: 会后请把会议纪要发给每个人。
example.en: After the meeting, please send the minutes to everyone.

gloss: smoke from kitchen chimneys; cooking smoke
indonesian: asap dapur; asap dari cerobong dapur

example.zh: 傍晚，村子里升起了袅袅炊烟。
example.en: At dusk, wisps of cooking smoke rose over the village.

indonesian: zona beriklim sedang; daerah beriklim sedang

example.zh: 北京位于北温带，四季分明。
example.en: Beijing lies in the northern temperate zone and has four distinct seasons.

example.zh: 他恳切地请求大家原谅他。
example.en: He earnestly asked everyone to forgive him.

gloss: richly endowed by nature; blessed with unique advantages
indonesian: dianugerahi keunggulan alam; memiliki keunggulan istimewa

example.zh: 这里气候温暖，发展旅游业得天独厚。
example.en: With its warm climate, this place has unique advantages for developing tourism.

gloss: popular; loved by the people; a pleasure to see and hear
indonesian: digemari; disukai masyarakat; menyenangkan untuk ditonton
meanings: to love to hear and see (idiom)

example.zh: 相声是老百姓喜闻乐见的艺术形式。
example.en: Crosstalk is an art form loved by ordinary people.

gloss: broad and profound; extensive and deep (knowledge, culture)

example.zh: 中国文化博大精深，值得慢慢学习。
example.en: Chinese culture is broad and profound and worth studying slowly.

gloss: hardworking and thrifty; industrious and frugal

example.zh: 父母从小就教育我们要勤俭节约。
example.en: Since childhood, our parents taught us to be hardworking and thrifty.

example.zh: 中秋节是农历八月十五。
example.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival falls on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month.

meanings: official host (e.g. venue for games or a conference)

example.zh: 作为东道主，我们要热情接待各国客人。
example.en: As hosts, we should warmly welcome guests from every country.

gloss: to have experienced many vicissitudes of life; weather-beaten
indonesian: telah mengalami banyak pasang surut kehidupan; kenyang pengalaman

example.zh: 老人那饱经沧桑的脸上露出了笑容。
example.en: A smile appeared on the old man's weather-beaten face.

indonesian: burung dan binatang buas; satwa liar
meanings: the beasts of the field and the birds of the air

example.zh: 这片森林里生活着各种飞禽走兽。
example.en: All kinds of birds and animals live in this forest.

indonesian: Festival Perahu Naga; Hari Raya Peh Cun
meanings: Dragon Boat Festival (5th day of the 5th lunar month)

example.zh: 端午节的时候，人们会吃粽子、看龙舟比赛。
example.en: At the Dragon Boat Festival, people eat zongzi and watch dragon boat races.

indonesian: persahabatan yang mendalam; kasih sayang yang tulus

example.zh: 我永远不会忘记你们的深情厚谊。
example.en: I will never forget your deep friendship.

gloss: wuxia; martial arts hero; martial arts (fiction genre)
meanings: martial arts chivalry (Chinese literary, theatrical and cinema genre)

example.zh: 他从小就爱看金庸的武侠小说。
example.en: He has loved reading Jin Yong's martial arts novels since childhood.

gloss: to make do with; to put up with; to settle for

example.zh: 房间有点小，你就将就住一晚吧。
example.en: The room's a bit small, but just make do with it for one night.

indonesian: sajak berpasangan; bait berpasangan (ditempel di pintu)
meanings: pair of lines of verse written vertically down the sides of a doorway

example.zh: 春节前，家家户户都会在门上贴对联。
example.en: Before Spring Festival, every household puts couplets on their doors.

indonesian: perantau Tionghoa; warga Tionghoa di luar negeri
meanings: (in a restricted sense) Chinese emigrant who still retains Chinese nationality

example.zh: 他的爷爷是印尼华侨，几十年前回过中国。
example.en: His grandfather was an overseas Chinese in Indonesia who went back to China decades ago.
